description: Peppery berry fruit is the joyful, dominating factor here. Nose and palate simply burst with spicy fruit. There is some grippy tannin as a counterweight. Wonderful freshness against oaky vanilla provides a subtle, understated nuance. There is absolute elegance despite the exuberance.
title: Markowitsch 2013 Rosenberg Red (Carnuntum)

description: Perfumed and floral, crisp and modulated in acidity, this is an exuberant expression of the variety. Ample acidiy and cherry and orange flavors unfold on the palate, followed by a brisk finish that's laced in spicy nuance.
title: Lawer 2016 Estate Vineyard Rosé of Syrah (Knights Valley)

description: The Roserock cuvée is notably dark and concentrated, with loads of ripe black cherry fruit. The nose is spicy, and flavors are saturated with luscious mocha. This is a fine example of the vintage, ready to enjoy immediately.
title: Rex Hill 2012 Roserock Vineyard Pinot Noir (Willamette Valley)

description: This is a very pale rosé from a relatively high elevation site, so it shows ample crispness and elegance. Delicate aromas of herbs and citrus lead into flavors of peach and lime, with a bit of wet stone on the long, refreshing finish. This is well balanced and long, not a simple fruity rosé.
title: Chêne Bleu 2013 Grenache-Syrah-Cinsault Rosé (Ventoux)

description: This rosé gets its pretty eye-of-the-partridge color from having undergone cold soaking. Dry, soft and subtle, it shows peach, vanilla and spice flavors. Great with cioppino or grilled salmon.
designation: Avila Beach Sunset Dry Rosé of
title: Morovino 2011 Avila Beach Sunset Dry Rosé of Pinot Grigio (Santa Barbara County)

description: A huge wine, massively extracted with raspberry and cherry jam fruit, with complex hints of mocha, cola, vanilla, buttered toast and wood spice. The richness is balanced by firm acidity, smooth tannins and a stony minerality. Seems to be offering its best now and over the next 3–4 years.
title: Siduri 2011 Rosella's Vineyard Pinot Noir (Santa Lucia Highlands)

description: Here's a simple, easy sparkling wine with some sweet flavors of peach and apricot backed by drying mineral tones and chopped garden herbs. The quality of the perlage is foamy and soft.
title: Costaruél NV Le Dolcirive Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This is a very likeable and approachable Prosecco with bright aromas of white flower, citrus and peach. The wine is tonic, crisp and balanced and because this is a Brut expression, the wine is dry and fresh.
title: Dal Din NV Brut Perlé  (Prosecco)

description: Bold proportions of Pinot Noir and Pinot Meuniere in this traditional-method sparkling lend sweet-tart bursts of raspberry and blackberry from nose to palate. It's a deeply concentrated wine, with fine, piercing bubbles and a lingering finish.
title: Sparkling Pointe 2014 Topaz Impérial Rosé  (North Fork of Long Island)

description: Oxidized cherry and strawberry aromas settle on heavy and candied upon airing. This is thick and plump stuff, with sweet red-fruit flavors and seemingly a lot of residual sugar. This needs more spine and structure.
title: Hacienda La Lomita 2012 Cursi Rosé (Valle de Guadalupe)

description: Lightly sweet, this is a soft, gently fruity wine with a prickle on the tongue and fruit-drop acidity. Screwcap.
title: Aveleda 2012 Casal Garcia Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: Here's a foamy, frizzante rosato made with organically-farmed fruit from a little-known wine region in northern Italy. Wild berry and raspberry open the bouquet and although there is a trace of sweetness the wine could otherwise be classified as dry.
title: Tenuta Villa Tavernago 2012 Querido Rosé Frizzante Pinot Nero (Colli Piacentini)

description: This is a very simple Prosecco brut with straight lines of citrus and peach backed by foamy perlage. The wine opens with a bright, luminous color and fresh acidity.
title: Zonin NV Brut  (Prosecco)

description: Made from organic grapes, this is a cheerful Prosecco with apricot, honey and butterscotch delivered in a simple and uncomplicated manner. The mouthfeel is thin and sharp.
title: Pizzolato NV Fields Brut  (Prosecco)

description: Pretty dark for a rosé, and heavy and rich, too. Tastes like a raspberry Newton cookie.
title: Loken Cellars NV Reserve Lot 14 Grenache Rosé (California)

description: Once past a distracting note of tire rubber, this rosé of Grenache offers aromas of wet stone and watermelon rind. Berry fruit emerges on the palate, while the dry finish picks up hints of chocolate. Drink now, but maybe give it a quick splash into a decanter to see if that improves it.
title: Schwarz Wine Company 2015 Rosé (Barossa Valley)

description: Made from the Négrette grape found in Fronton near Toulouse, this wine has a light structure to balance its dry acidity and citrus crispness. It's packed with clean, forward red currant fruit, ready to drink now.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2016 Villa la Vie en Rose Rosé (Vin de France)

description: Deep pink in color, this warm and rich rosé is touched with spice and tannin as well as red currant fruits and a crisp acidity on the finish. The wine could improve further with some bottle age.
title: Forget-Brimont NV Grand Rosé  (Champagne)

description: The onion-skin pink color sets the stage for an off-dry, just-sweet wine, that is crisp, yet soft and rounded. It has good weight, fresh raspberry flavor, and delicate sweetness, resulting in a wine that's crisp and textured.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte NV D'Luscious Demi-Sec Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Marianne's is made from Syrah grapes grown in the vineyard of the same name, the grapes pressed and resulting juice fermented on its own, making for a relatively meaty style of rosé, dry, with aromas of tart raspberry and an almost apricot fuzz, Sauvignon Blanc quality. Pair with stinky cheeses.
title: Six Sigma Ranch 2012 Marianne's Rosé (Lake County)

description: This wine is from Alain Dominique Perrin's Lagrézette estate in Cahors, although it is not labeled as such because the Cahors AOP is only red wine. Made from Malbec, it has the palest rosé color and elegant texture, with strawberry fruitiness and lively final acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Lagrézette 2014 Le Rosé de Julie Rosé (Côtes du Lot)

description: Bubble gum and cotton candy aromas come across as slightly confected at the moment, but they should settle down into cherry-berry notes after 6–9 months of cellaring. Like most Tavels, this should be at its best about 18 months after the vintage.
title: Prieuré de Montézargues 2013  Tavel

description: Dusty cherry and red-plum aromas are simple and clean. A fresh, tight, normal feeling palate gets the job done, while flavors of cantaloupe, red plum and nectarine wrap up with pithy citrus notes and a hint of bitterness. Drink this year.
title: Marqués de Cáceres 2014 Rosado (Rioja)

description: Restrained aromatics slowly release notes of strawberry cheesecake in a soft, light and mellow body. It carries enough heft to pair with food allied with lovely, fresh acidity.
designation: Gemischter Satz aus Merlot, Syrah & Zweigelt
title: Weixelbaum 2013 Gemischter Satz aus Merlot, Syrah & Zweigelt Rosé (Niederösterreich)

description: Sweet and tart notes—think maraschino cherry and citrus—start this opulent sip. Sweet-tasting cherry and strawberry flavors follow. Not overly complex, but a fun summer wine.
title: Skouras 2011 Zoë Rosé (Peloponnese)

description: Flavors of rose petal, cherry and a touch of spice characterize this rosé. A backbone of lively spice carries the sweet-tasting cherry flavors on the palate. Pair this with fruit salads or creamy cheeses.
title: Tselepos 2011 Driopi Agiorgitiko Rosé (Peloponnese)

description: The palest color leads to a perfumed, very ready-to-drink wine. It is crisp with fruit that is now softened by a year's aging, offering a touch of caramel along with crushed strawberry flavors. Drink now.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2013 Les Belles Vignes Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Aromatically appealing, this suggests black raspberries, tart cherries and herbs, with light citrus and barrel accents. It's tart and quite restrained for the variety with plumy fruit flavors and a slightly chalky feel to the tannins that may resolve with some additional time in the bottle.
title: Wind Rose 2012 Stone Tree Vineyard Primitivo (Wahluke Slope)

description: A little soft and one-dimensional, with raspberry and cherry cola flavors. Lacks the liveliness that a rosé needs. No oak on this dry wine.
title: C.G. di Arie 2009 Rose 'Di Arie Rosé (Sierra Foothills)

description: This sparkling rosé opens with a pretty pink color and golden peach highlights. The soft foaming is steady and tonic and the sparkler moves smoothly over the palate with plush, creamy effervescence: There's a simple, sweet personality at the core with pink grapefruit and raspberry.
title: Cantina Caorsa NV Graffio Spumante Rosé  (Bardolino Chiaretto)

description: A pink sparkling wine that opens with vibrant tones of cranberry, raspberry and red rose. The feminine, floral side is indeed intense although the wine shows much more simplicity in the mouth.
title: Bortolotti NV Lagrein Brut Rosato Sparkling (Veneto)

description: Warm and rounded, this is a soft, ripe rosé. The flavors of plums and red berries roll easily around the mouth, producing a wine that is full, rich and soft.
title: Château Briot 2011 Red (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Red fruits and light acidity are paired in this simple, fresh rosé. It is light and bright with just a touch of warmth to bring out the sunshine. Drink now. Screwcap.
title: Laroche 2013 Rosé de la Chevalière Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Scents of plum, orange rind, banana and a touch of mentholated herb unfold on the nose, while the palate offers fruit-skin flavors of plum and cherry, lending a slightly tannic structure.
title: Le Cirque 2013 Rosé (Côtes Catalanes)

description: A fruity and fragrant selection, with upfront aromas of ripe strawberries, banana and peaches and cream. There's a bit more tension on the palate, with bracing acidity and flavors of small, tart red berries and white cherry.
region_1: Vin de Pays Cité de Carcassonne
title: Vignobles Sarrail 2013 Esprit de Sarrail Rosé (Vin de Pays Cité de Carcassonne)

description: Pale and refined, with elegant flavors of raspberries, strawberries, vanilla and yeasty lees. With a slightly sweet finish, balanced with crisp coastal acidity, it's a beautiful sparkling wine.
title: Scharffenberger NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Mendocino County)

description: The aromas are of smoky bottle age and this translates into the flavors, with a light rancio character giving complexity to a finely made, rich, raspberry-flavored wine. It is full-bodied in the Charles Heidsieck style, a definite food wine.
title: Charles Heidsieck NV Rosé Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: Cherries and strawberries abound in this elegant wine. Old-vine fruit was fermented and briefly aged in neutral barrels that somehow lend a subtle hint of apple-pie spices to the wine. A perfect late summer sipper.
title: The Eyrie Vineyards 2013 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Willamette Valley)

description: Brilliant pink with a touch of orange, this refreshing and light-bodied wine tastes fresh and strawberrylike. It has an appetizingly crisp texture and clean fruity finish.
title: Lusso Della Terra 2013 Rose of Merlot (California)

description: A rare rosé made from Malbec grapes, this fresh, lively and well-structured wine has a pale peach color backed by significant fruit aromas and flavors. Great acidity balances out medium body and livens up the mouthfeel.
title: Boatique 2016 Estate Grown Rosé (Red Hills Lake County)

description: Light, subtle pink color echoes this wine's subdued nature on the palate, which reveals whispers of orange peel, strawberry and rose as it opens.
title: C R Graybehl 2016 Grenache Rosé (Sonoma Valley)

description: Seductively tart in lemon pith, cranberry and pomegranate, this refreshing, light-bodied quaff is infinitely enjoyable, both on its own or at the table. It continues to expand on the palate into an increasing array of fresh flavors, finishing in cherry and orange.
title: Ousterhout 2014 Woods Vineyard Rosé of Pinot Noir (Russian River Valley)

description: A nice, easy blush wine, slightly sweet and balanced in acidity. It offers pleasant flavors of raspberry and strawberry candy, vanilla and cinnamon.
title: Pali 2008 Sunset Rosé (California-Oregon)

description: Shades of earth and mineral take center stage in this dry, refreshing Pinot Noir rosé. It's delicately concentrated, just barely kissed by tart red cherry and strawberry flavors, but a zesty, fresh summer pick-me-up.
title: Thirsty Owl Wine Company 2014 Plane Vineyard Pinot Noir Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: Ripe, fruity and full of spice, this is a fresh wine. With its light color, it is a perfect summer quaff, crisp with red currants and with a light, fragrant aftertaste.
title: Winenot 2014 Les Jolies Filles Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Named after an 18th-century French admiral, this wine is made by the Gilardi family. It's a ripe, dry and sustaining wine that has ripe spice and pepper, fresh red fruits and a keenly refreshing aftertaste. It is ready to drink.
title: Bailli de Provence 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Pale orange-pink in color, this is a lightly fruited wine on the palate. Soft acidity, orange and lime fruits and a smooth, rounded texture all contribute to this open wine.
title: Château la Tour de l'Evêque 2014 Pétale de Rose Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This ripe wine is smooth and creamy, fresh with acidity and rich with red fruits. Open and generous, it will make a great apéritif.
title: Domaine du Grand Cros 2014 Jules Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Deliciously tangy as well as ripe, this is a textured, red fruit and vanilla-flavored wine that also has a touch of tannin. Acidity and a rounded aftertaste make this instantly drinkable. The blend is Syrah (40%), Grenache (30%), Cinsault (20%) and Cabernet Sauvignon (10%).
title: Domaine Jacourette 2014 L'Ange et Luce Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a perfectly formed rosé, from its pale-pink color to its crisp acidity and light tannins. It is balanced and delicious to drink now.
title: Estandon 2014 Terres de Saint-Louis Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: The perfect picnic wine? Bold, floral and berry aromas, black cherry fruit, and some light tannins will make this the most versatile wine in your hamper this summer. This blend of Nero d'Avola and Nerello Mascalese is grown specifically for rose production--it is not a saignee used to increase the concentration of the estate's reds.
title: Tasca d'Almerita 2001 Rose di Regaleali Rosé (Sicilia)

description: Very smooth in the nose, with fragrant, fresh aromas of flowers, lemon and lime. The dry citrusy palate and soft mouthfeel work perfectly together, while the finish is long, fruity and very pleasant. Quite a tasty sparkler with pure fruit. Its quality is obvious.
title: Canella NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Conegliano)

description: Big, fruity wine, with layers of fruit, earth, toast and oak. Spicy cranberry/raspberry fruit leads into toasty, dry tannins. There is a lovely density, buttressed with new oak, but anchored with ripe, firm fruit. Lovely winemaking.
title: Rosenblum 1998 Alegria Zinfandel (Russian River Valley)

description: Old vine clone, with brambly, gamy notes throughout. Lifts up the palate with lively, bright flavors. Good concentration, balance and follow-through.
title: Rosenblum 1998 Rockpile Road Zinfandel (Dry Creek Valley)

description: Full bodied and well-oaked, this full-throttle Zin comes on with intense blackberry and vanilla aromas and flavors accented by cinnamon and chocolate notes. Ripe and even on the palate, the handsome fruit plays out on the lengthy finish with tart, dark berry and pepper notes.
title: Rosenblum 1998 Hendry Vineyard Reserve Zinfandel (Napa Valley)

description: This is a crisp, high-wire-walking wine, just so poised. Its youthful red fruits, laced with citrus, taste so fresh, with a strawberry bite. At this stage, it is intensely enjoyable as young Champagne, but it does need to age for several years.
title: Louis Roederer 2005 Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: With a pretty pink-salmon color, this Pinot Noir-based blush is rich and full-bodied. It has considerable weight for a bubbly, but the acidity and freshness and yeasty tang lift it up to Champagne elegance. Impossible not to fall in love with this raspberry-scented beauty, but why wouldn't you want to?
title: Schramsberg 2007 Brut Rosé Sparkling (North Coast)

description: The beauty of Krug's rosé is the sense of bottle age, of that extra richness. That means the wine is not just the sum of its delicious red berry fruits. It's also the way the wine is rounded out, filled with secondary flavors, toast and almonds and a taut minerality. The aftertaste is taut, dry, seamless, complex.
title: Krug NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A beautifully balanced wine, with bitter cherries in a core of dry toast. It is already mature, its freshness transformed into a rich texture. Like many rosé Champagnes, this is made for food.
title: Moët & Chandon 2000 Dom Pérignon Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Here's a Prosecco Brut that stands tall in this category of sparkling wine thanks to the pristine and intense nature of its bouquet. You'll get dusty mineral, fruit and flowers and the mouthfeel is exceedingly crisp and clean.
title: Bortolomiol NV Prior Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Cuvée di Boj offers distinctively herbal characteristics such as cut grass and dried basil leaf. The mouthfeel is smooth and creamy and there's a touch of sweetness here that adds to the overall softness of this cheerful sparkling wine.
title: Valdo NV Cuvée di Boj  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Here's a special sparkling wine from Villa Sandi with intense notes of peachy fruit, sweet apple and pear. This Dry style wine tastes extra sweet and would make an excellent pairing partner with any fruit-based dish, whether sweet or salty (like prunes wrapped in prosciutto).
title: Villa Sandi NV Oris Cuvée Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: The Rollier is a bird found in warm, dry places in southern Europe, just like Provence. Fresh, light and fruity, the wine certainly flies into the glass. It is dry, with bright red currant fruits and attractive acidity.
title: Château la Martinette 2013 Rollier de la Martinette Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a fine entry-level rosé from this Provence classed-growth estate. It has fresh red fruits and a light texture that is rounded out with some concentration and almond flavors. Drink now.
title: Château Minuty 2013 Prestige Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Crisp and fruity, this wine demands to be drunk this summer. With bright red fruits, a light smoky texture and lime zest flavor, it is light, fresh and fragrant at the end.
title: Château Pas du Cerf 2013 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: While the wine is full bodied and rich, it is also deliciously fresh and with lively fruitiness. There is great acidity here, a bright layer of red currant fruits and wild strawberries, making it a good food rosé.
title: Château Thuerry 2013 Le Château Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A fresh and crisp wine, it is softly fruity with intense layers of acidity. It's immediately appealing with red fruits and crisp citrus at the end.
title: Domaine Saint-André de Figuière 2013 Cuvée Signature Magali Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Deep ruby pink in color, this wine begins with a nuanced nose, mixing the fun of grape soda with the elegance of purple flowers. On the palate, it's a tad boozy for pink wine, but the flavors of cherry and currant stand out in front of the alcohol. It would make a nice companion for a dish with ample flavors and actual warmth, such as chicken soup or a tuna melt.
title: Tre Anelli 2012 Rosé Grenache (Santa Barbara County)

description: Light salmon in color, this herbal rosé dances on the palate with a slight effervescence and 5% residual sugar. It offers a bouquet of robust red fruit and rose petal aromas, and saw no oak.
title: Ty Caton 2013 Rosé of Syrah (Sonoma Valley)

description: Packed with acidity as much as fruit, this is a tight, intensely fresh wine. There are some hints of tannins from the Pinot Noir as well as raspberry fruits, although the crisp acidity shows most strongly.
title: Domaine de Savagny NV Rosé Brut Pinot Noir (Crémant de Jura)

description: Between Nantes and Angers, the small appellation of Coteaux d'Ancenis hugs the banks of the Loire. This rosé, with its fresh while also ripe strawberry fruits, is subtly textured with attractive acidity and lightly perfumed. Drink now.
title: Alliance Loire 2014 Cour de Rohan Rosé (Coteaux d'Ancenis)

description: This ripe, crisp and intensely fruity wine does have a touch of tannin, inevitable with Cabernet Franc, but it is really all about red fruits and refreshing acidity. Drink now.
title: Alliance Loire 2014 Réserve des Vignerons  (Cabernet de Saumur)

description: This salmon-pink-colored wine is refreshingly fruity, with attractively crisp acid offsetting the bright red fruit and apple flavors. Drier than in past vintages, it still has a ripe, soft finish.
title: G. H. Mumm NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Fresh and fun with a nose of rhubarb and spice. On the palate, strawberry and spice is delicate with a touch of tartness. A great go-to summer sip that will pair nicely with salmon, grilled meats.
title: Sheldrake Point 2008 Dry Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: Attractive and finely balanced, this has red cherry and strawberry flavors, which come wrapped in soft tannins and crisp acidity.
title: Domaine du Vissoux 2011 Les Griottes Rosé Gamay (Beaujolais)

description: This is Primitivo-Barbera blend with dabs of Nebbiolo and Dolcetto in the mix. It's light and youthful, with cranberry fruit and the sort of juicy acidity that freshens the palate. Not especially concentrated, but crisp and clean, with a bracing minerality.
title: Wind Rose 2009 Bravo Rosso Red (Washington)

description: This bright, ruby-colored rosé opens with lively tones of cranberry, raspberry and white almond. It's soft and creamy with a touch of sweet berry or ripe cherry on the close.
title: Cantina Santadi 2009 Tre Torri  (Carignano del Sulcis)

description: Almost dark enough, as well as fruity enough, to be a red wine, this tastes fresh and has a touch of candied character. The wine is medium bodied, resembles cherries and raspberries in flavor and carries enough acidity for good balance.
title: V. Sattui 2014 Dry Rosato (North Coast)

description: Strawberry, herb, orange peel and mocha aromas are subdued and show some reduction. The palate possesses tart acidity and chalky tannins with a mocha and citrus-filled finish.
designation: Sangio Red Wine Lonesome Springs Ranch
title: Wind Rose 2013 Sangio Red Wine Lonesome Springs Ranch Sangiovese (Yakima Valley)

description: Making wine since 1936, Marsuret's San Boldo Brut opens with sharp notes of white pepper and dried hay followed by citrus, peach and white flower. The wine shows thin lines with a watery consistency.
title: Marsuret 2012 San Boldo Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Fermented in stainless steel barrels, this wine is a vibrant red hue, with strong dried cherry, cranberry and orange aromas. Full-bodied and concentrated, it's a dry and substantial rosé.
title: K Squared Cellars 2016 Rosé (Russian River Valley)

description: An appetizing touch of red currant and cranberry plays on the nose of this vividly colored rosé. The palate is fruit-forward with subtle shades of berry and citrus. The finish is refreshing and berry-laden.
title: Markus Huber 2016 Zweigelt Rosé (Weinland Österreich)

description: This is both fruity and deliciously crisp. It has the light touch of the vintage—red fruits attractively balancing with the acidity and the tangy lemon edge. The aftertaste is both fruity and herbal. Drink now.
title: Mas de Cadenet 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: This is the third release of the rosé produced by Mathilde Chapoutier, whose father, Michel, runs the famed Hermitage-based M. Chapoutier. It is a light-colored wine, a typical Provence blend with the addition of Cabernet Sauvignon. Fruity and with great acidity, it is light in texture, just hinting at minerality. Drink now.
title: Mathilde Chapoutier Sélection 2016 Grand Ferrage Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Rich aromas of vanilla custard, raspberry sauce and strawberries and cream immediately waft from the glass and continue through to the round, lush palate. The mouthfeel is a bit flat, begging for more acidic lift to keep the ripe flavors in balance.
title: Domaine Vaquer 2013 L'Ephémère Rosé (Côtes du Roussillon)

description: This is light in color, with minerally aromas and a hint of tropical fruit on the nose. A shearing palate overwhelms with acidity, while flavors of zesty citrus and pink grapefruit create leftover sizzle on a tangy, scouring finish.
title: Calcu 2013 Rosé (Colchagua Valley)

description: On the dry side, this is a fruity wine that goes towards raspberries and loganberries. It's fresh and crisp; drink now.
title: Casa Santos Lima 2013 Portuga Rosé (Lisboa)

description: Light cherry and raspberry aromas come with a note of apple skins. The feel is plump but midland, with mealy notes. Flavors of cherry and plum are bland, while overall this wine is decent but lacking in personality.
title: Estampa 2013 Estate Rosé (Colchagua Valley)

description: Made from the Spanish grape Tempranillo, this is light salmon in color, restrained in style and just slightly sweet. Fruit nuances do come out on the palate and finish, adding interest.
title: Matchbook 2013 Estate Bottled Rosé of Tempranillo (Dunnigan Hills)

description: Clean and fresh with medium-intense aromas and flavors of watermelon rind, carnation, red cranberry and a touch of green banana. Balanced and straightforward, and easy to find with 5,000 cases imported.
title: Les Jamelles 2010 Cinsault Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: A dark pink color, this rosé promises rich, dark fruit notes of ripe cherry and muddled strawberry with a slightly medicinal edge. The medium weight mouth falls a bit flat, and closes abruptly on the finish. Drink now.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2010 Syrah-Grenache Rosé (Languedoc)

description: Ferrari's rosé sparkler offers distinctive aromas of freshly baked bread and yeast followed by wild berries, stone fruit and citrus. The mouthfeel is intense and generous and this wine boasts a particularly creamy, full and satisfying mouthfeel.
title: Ferrari NV Rosé Sparkling (Trento)

description: Here's a beautifully pale and delicate rosé sparkler from Franciacorta that offers compelling aromas of wild berry, cranberry and cinnamon spice. There are citrus and pink grapefruit tones at the back and the wine is silky smooth in the mouth.
title: Montenisa NV Brut Rosé Pinot Nero (Franciacorta)

description: A shock of sour cherry and pink grapefruit flavors penetrates through this revitalizing dry rosé. A blend of Cabernet Franc, Gamay and Pinot Noir, it carries out a fine balancing act between fruit forwardness and elegance.
title: Bellwether 2014 Dry Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: This wine is soft and rich with dense apricot and red berry fruits over a spice layer. That gives the wine a tangy character, textured with minerality. A bite at the end comes from the pepperiness.
title: Château du Galoupet 2014 Le Galoupet Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The wine is rich, ripe with delicious red fruits and a touch of attractive acidity. The aftertaste is soft, full and fruity. The wine comes from the small appellation of Coteaux Varois in the heart of Provence.
title: Chateau La Calisse 2014 Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: A soft, full-bodied wine, this has touches of caramel and ripe strawberry flavors. It is rounded, smooth and rich, while the acidity adds the essential freshness.
title: Château Rimauresq 2014 Rimauresq Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: An inaugural release, this blend of Mourvèdre (85%) and Cinsault is pale copper with salmon tinges. Aromas of strawberry and rose petal lead to dry, full-feeling fruit flavors that linger.
title: Coral Wines 2014 Rosé (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Crafted from Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, in almost equal parts, this delicately tinted wine is subtle with flavors of strawberries, peaches and oranges. It has a honeyed finish, making it slightly off-dry. The acidity is pitch perfect and the mousse is fine and silky.
title: Mumm Napa 2007 DVX Rosé Sparkling (Napa Valley)

description: Just what you want a blush bubbly to be. The color is a pretty orange-copper, with glints of gold. The aromas of oranges, peaches, Meyer lemons, limes, strawberries and brioche are enticing. Once in the mouth, the wine is softly crisp and silky, finishing with a touch of honey. The blend is 92% Pinot Noir and 8% Chardonnay.
title: Gloria Ferrer 2008 Brut Rosé Sparkling (Carneros)

description: A blend of Cabernet and Merlot, this has red fruit notes, a light structure and plenty of final acidity. It finishes with caramel as well as freshness.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2013 Colombelle L'Originel Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Clean, fresh and fruity, this is soft and off dry, with red fruits and the softest texture. A fresh shot of acidity marks the end.
title: Marquis de Goulaine 2013 La Roseraie  (Rosé d'Anjou)

description: Creamy, almost mellow notes of Red Delicious apple pervade nose and palate. The mousse is very fine and creamy, heightening the beautifully pure fruit notes as well as a rounded autolytic note of brioche. This is light bodied but full of flavor, dry and creamy with a lovely long finish.
title: Cave de Hunawihr NV Rosé Calixte Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Fragrant and refined, this elegant sparkler offers enticing scents of hawthorn, wild flower and sliced pear. The vibrant balanced palate doles out citrus, crisp apple and a hint of ginger set against firm acidity and a soft, foaming mousse. It has clean dry finish.
title: Mongarda 2016 Vigneto Rive Alte Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: From a site in Green Valley, this crisp, light-bodied offering has a dusty rose aroma and a meaty consistency the provides body without weight. Cranberry and cherry notes form its fruit core, accompanied by a tease of grapefruit.
title: Ousterhout 2015 800 Vines Vineyard Rosé of Pinot Noir (Russian River Valley)

description: This bright, light and acid-driven wine is juicy and fresh—a full embrace of tart lemon and tangerine flavors. Its liveliness is long-lived and welcome.
title: Ousterhout 2016 Woods Vineyard Rosé of Pinot Noir (Russian River Valley)

description: Tight aromas of citrus and red fruits aren't expressive but at least they're crisp. Same goes for the palate, which is tight and juicy as it offers flavors of pink grapefruit, citrus and burnt grass/hay. Good as value-priced quaffers go.
region_1: Vino de la Tierra de Castilla
title: Dominio de Eguren 2010 Protocolo Rosé (Vino de la Tierra de Castilla)

description: Fresh crushed strawberries combine with a ripe and sweet texture to give a delicious, glowing rosé. It is full in the mouth, with a touch of sweeter fruits, although acidity does give the wine a final lift.
title: Laurent-Perrier NV Cuvée Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Light mousse and a soft texture give this wine an attractive berry-flavored freshness. A touch of light sweetness finishes the wine attractively.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de Saint-Louis NV Estandon Brut Rosé Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: Coppery pink highlights and light hints of citrus are coupled with wonderfully refreshing acidity and some richer yeast notes in the background. An enlivening, zippy apéritif, with subtle strawberry hints.
title: Szigeti 2011 Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Österreichischer Sekt)

description: There's a bitter apricot pit flavor to this blush Pinot Noir. It's dry and crisp with acidity that brightens peach and citrus flavors.
title: Dunstan 2012 Durell Vineyard Rosé (Sonoma Coast)

description: Citrusy aromas revolve around pink grapefruit and rose blossom. In the mouth, this is a bit flat for such a young rosé, with pithy and bitter flavors and notes of red plum and red-apple skins.
title: El Coto 2012 Rosado (Rioja)

description: Pale copper colored, this wine is more focused on mineral than fruit expression, with aromas of wet stone out in front of citrus rind. The medium-bodied flavors dance lightly on the palate but still show concentration, texture and balance.
title: Cayuse 2013 Edith Grenache Armada Vineyard Rosé (Walla Walla Valley (WA))

description: This dry Merlot rosé is the benchmark from which to compare each of Channing Daughter's seven rosato wines this vintage. It's elegantly framed, perfumed with waxy-white florals and crisp strawberry and cherry notes. Dry and crisp, yet luscious in body with a lingering touch of bramble on the finish.
title: Channing Daughters 2014 Rosato (Long Island)

description: Domaine de la Mordorée's 2014 rosés are fitting tributes to proprietor Christophe Delorme's final vintage (he died in June 2015). This blend of 50% Grenache, 30% Syrah and 20% Cinsault is weighty and rich, blending raspberries and white chocolate into a wine that could be served as a light red wine, with grilled meats or poultry.
title: Domaine de la Mordorée 2014 Le Dame Rousse Rosé (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This crisp, lively and dry rosé is made from Mourvèdre and Grenache grapes. it shows great acidity and a rather lean and thirst-quenching texture that carries the vibrant raspberry and apple flavors right along. The color is a pale salmon, the body is light, and the finish fresh and clean. It's a perfect lunch wine for salads, seafood and grilled fare.
title: The Withers Winery 2014 Rosé (El Dorado)

description: Deeply orange-mauve in color, this wine tastes much like the Pinot Noir it came from, with rich aromas of buttered cherries, clove and allspice. A similar familiarity carries through the sip, with dark raspberries, red cherries, brown spice and sandalwood elements, perfect for Pinot-philes.
title: Kessler-Haak 2013 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Sta. Rita Hills)

description: This revitalized négociant has bottled a fine rosé that's showing its best in 2015. It's deep pink in color, with perfumed aromas of rose petals and cracked pepper. It's ample in body, picking up hints of cardamom, cinnamon, watermelon and red berries on the palate, before finishing long and refreshing. Drink now.
title: Lavau 2013  Tavel

description: Aromas of wild berry, rose, citrus and savory herbs lead the nose of this Sicilian sparkler. The vibrant, savory palate offers crushed strawberries, sour cherries, pastry, nectarine, wild mint and mineral alongside a soft, persistent mousse and lively acidity.
title: Murgo 2011 Brut Rosé Metodo Classico Nerello Mascalese (Vino Spumante)

description: Coming from seven vineyards and showing more yellow, orange and tan than pink in the glass, this blend of 80% Grenache, 17% Mourvèdre and 3% Counoise suggests orange and lemon peels, just-sliced melon and frozen strawberries on the nose. The palate is more about great acidity and a stony minerality, along with some watermelon elements and orange rind.
title: Tablas Creek 2014 Patelin de Tablas Rosé (Paso Robles)

description: Aromas of dark-skinned berry, French oak, clove and a whiff of aromatic herb lift out of the glass. The structured palate offers black cherry, cinnamon, licorice, menthol and chopped mint alongside vibrant acidity and youthfully assertive, fine-grained tannins that grip the finish. Give this time to fully develop and unwind. Drink 2020–2029.
designation: Feudo di Mezzo Il Quadro delle Rose
title: Tenuta delle Terre Nere 2014 Feudo di Mezzo Il Quadro delle Rose  (Etna)

description: Chalky accents add character to the red berry and white strawberry aromas and flavors of this wine. It's fresh and clean in the mouth with zippy acidity and an easy finish. Drink now.
title: Galil Mountain 2010 Rosé (Upper Galilee)

description: This Provençal-style blush is made from Syrah, Mourvèdre and Grenache. It's a good wine, dry and crisply acidic, but not without its faults. The main problem is a streak of green mint and vegetables. But there's enough sweet raspberry and cherry fruit to get by.
title: Lasseter 2010 Enjoué Rosé (Sonoma Valley)

description: A lean, toasty style that pairs dried spices—cinnamon and ginger—with zesty citrus fruits. The toast and vanilla battle green and lime flavors from the nose all the way through the finish.
title: Rosemount 2001 Hill of Gold Chardonnay (Mudgee)

description: Fits the big-production Aussie recipe to a T, blending tropical fruit, vanilla, apple and citrus flavors. It's just a little lighter than expected and finishes short.
title: Rosemount 2001 Diamond Label Chardonnay (South Eastern Australia)

description: This is a crisp, 90% Pinot Noir-based wine with a light tannic edge from the red wine used to give color. It also has ripe red-berry fruits as well as acidity giving it dryness. It is fruity, steely and ready to drink.
designation: Lady de N. Cuvée Rosé Brut
title: Le Brun de Neuville NV Lady de N. Cuvée Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: This rosé brings extra levels of finesse and detail along with the expected burst of fresh fruit. Elegant and sophisticated, it offers tart cherry fruit, some peppery herb and a hint of fresh-ground coffee. Barrel fermented in neutral oak, it's smooth as silk.
title: Alexana 2016 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Willamette Valley)

description: Beautifully pure and creamy notes of golden apple dominate the nose. The palate has a similarly gentle apple note that harmonizes perfectly with the light, dry body and the fine bubbles. This elegant pink sparkler will give lots of pleasure before and during a meal.
title: Bestheim NV Anne de K Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This is a pleasant, no-fuss sparkler with textbook aromas of peach, flowers and citrus fruit. Overall, it lacks intensity but its crisp, lean mouthfeel helps it end on a high, zesty note.
title: Zardetto NV Zeta Dry  (Prosecco di Conegliano)

description: Cavit is relatively new to the Prosecco genre and this sparkler provides all the fresh fruit flavors you'd expect from this popular category of Italian wine. It's a low-intensity wine, with notes of peach, honeydew kiwi and white peppercorn. There's also a slightly soapy-musky tone at the back.
title: Cavit NV Lunetta Prosecco (Italy)

description: Made mistelle fashion, with fortification taking place prior to fermentation to help preserve the variety's citrus and tea-leaf aromas and flavors. Honeyed orange and lemon flavors take on a leafy edge, showing a hint of bitterness on the finish.
title: Chambers Rosewood Vineyards NV Muscadelle Tokay (Rutherglen)

description: This is a creamy, sweet Prosecco with fragrant aromas of peach, apricot and citrus that you can expect from this kind of informal sparkler. It has a tonic, soda-like like feel in the mouth and clean freshness on the close.
title: Maccari Spumanti 2006 Dry Millesimato  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: The wine opens with a foamy, fun personality but does not ultimately provide that extreme vibrancy you usually get with Prosecco. This is a chewy, broad and opulent wine with mature fruit and a dusty quality.
title: Carmina NV Brut  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: Floral aromas, white peach and mineral tones make for a harmonious and elegant sparkler with a pretty, vibrant appearance in the glass. Fruity, nutty flavors add sophistication and elegance in the mouth.
title: Carmina NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: This sparkler opens with a pretty, foamy crest and medium intensity of aromas: stone fruit, talc powder, dried sage and crushed white pepper tones are subdued but intricate. It ends on a creamy, sweet note.
title: Carpenè Malvolti NV Dry Cuvée Oro Conegliano  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: Despite its name, Hi! is actually an understated Prosecco with elegant qualities that translate into delicate tones of lemongrass, white stone and peach. It boasts bright acidity and medium intensity and is very refreshing overall.
title: La Riva dei Frati NV Hi!  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: Lively perlage and measured aromatic intensity set the stage for this friendly, no-fuss sparkler. It offers caressing effervescence and fresh tones of white peach, melon and lime.
title: Le Colture NV Cruner Dry  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: An easy-going, simple Prosecco with drying notes of talc powder, kiwi fruit and fresh lime. It's light and buoyant in the mouth with good freshness on the close.
title: Maccari Spumanti NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: This is our first peek at MacPhail's 2012 Pinots, and to judge by it, they'll be pretty good. The wine is dark in color and full-bodied for a rosé, with the weight and texture of Chardonnay. It's enormously flavorful in raspberries, vanilla, honey and spices.
title: MacPhail 2012 Rosé of Pinot Noir Rosé (Sonoma Coast)

description: Another satisfying Rosé from Horse & Plow, which uses organically grown Carignane, Syrah and Grenache grapes for this wine. With refreshing acidity, it's dry, bright in lime and grapefruit with spicy layers of strawberry and orange.
title: Horse & Plow 2012 Rosé (North Coast)

description: An easy, fun rosé, with apricot, peach, orange and melon flavors, brightened with crisp acidity. The finish is nice and dry.
title: Stepping Stone by Cornerstone 2012 Corallina Rosé of Syrah Rosé (Napa Valley)

description: This salmon-colored rosé is made from the País grape, a.k.a. the Mission Grape. On the nose, it's a cypher with weak fragrances of peach and mango. The palate is cidery and hard in feel, while briny, tart citrus flavors are pithy and fail to evolve or improve on the finish.
title: Viña Bisquertt 2013 Missing Rosé (Curicó Valley)

description: There's a green, brambly quality to this rosé that is enhanced by powdered licorice, dried mint, green tea and cassis. The wine is nice and refreshing but slightly disjointed in places. Made from a 70-30 blend of Refosco and Merlot.
title: Masi 2006 Modello delle Venezie Rosato Rosé (Venezie)

description: A light, bright and fresh wine, the epitome of a fruity rosé, this is made from Moscatel Roxo, a pink-skinned grape. It has plenty of lively acidity, a lightly perfumed character and a final burst of red fruits.
title: José Maria da Fonseca 2014 Colecção Privada Roxo Rosé (Península de Setúbal)

description: Touches of bramble and smoke meander curiously amid sweet strawberry and cherry in this off-dry rosé. While a bit candied on the palate, it's a juicy approachable wine for casual imbibing.
title: Gaul 2013 Rosé (Pfalz)

description: Rosy pink and good for warm-climate getaways this winter. Bright, candied aromas are controlled and don't veer into bubblegum land, while the palate is medium soft and has just enough acid to prop up nectarine and citrus flavors. Won't last long but showing well in its early days.
title: Doña Paula 2009 Los Cardos Rosé Malbec (Mendoza)

description: A bit heavy for a rosé, without quite the liveliness you want. It's a very fruity wine, with forward raspberry, vanilla, cocoa and spice flavors.
title: Buena Vista 2008 Rosé of Syrah Rosé (Carneros)

description: Fresh, floral, citrusy aromas precede a well-balanced palate. Sleek, dry raspberry and plum flavors are fresh and forward, while the finish on this sparkling Mourvèdre is salty, genuine, elegant and stylish.
title: Alta Alella 2014 Privat Reserva Brut Nature Rosé Sparkling (Cava)

description: Pretty dark for a rosé, and heavy in the mouth, with the density almost of a red wine. Shows soft cherry and spice flavors.
title: Mosby 2009 Rosato Rosé (Santa Barbara County)

description: Attractive crisp raspberry fruits, with a creamy texture, but spoilt by a sweet caramel edge.
title: Borges NV Fita Azul Passion Rosé Bruto Sparkling (Vinho Espumante de Qualidade)

description: Albeggio is a Syrah-based rosato that offers accents of cranberry, cassis and blueberry, backed by fresh acidity and medium density. It would pair well with roasted eggplant in yogurt sauce.
title: Fattoria Lavacchio 2011 Albeggio Rosato (Toscana)

description: Fresh, floral and lively, this bright wine offers tones of wild berry, pink grapefruit and crisp green apple. There's enough acidity to balance fried appetizers or cheese-topped pastas.
title: Giorgio Meletti Cavallari 2011 Rosato (Bolgheri)

description: This Sangiovese-based rosato is vinified solely in stainless steel in order to preserve the freshness of its forest berry and cranberry flavors. A touch of bitter almond adds brightness to the finish.
title: L'Antica Fornace di Ridolfo 2011 Cantalici Petali di Rosé Sangiovese (Toscana)

description: This is a crisp, Syrah-based rosé, with some passion fruit on the nose, but then ripe berry flavors on the palate. It's plump and medium-bodied, yet finishes with a zing of refreshing acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Beaubois 2010 Expression Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This aromatic rosé is a lovely shade of pale salmon, and has mashed apple and yeasty, almost hoppy notes. Flavors are bracing and lively, hinting at pretty cherry fruit.
title: Abacela 2011 Rosé Grenache (Umpqua Valley)

description: A dry, lively, raspberry-flavored wine, with a light mousse. Fruity, fresh and streaked with lemon-zest acidity, it has just the right texture and balance.
title: Bründlmayer NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Österreichischer Sekt)

description: Light and fruity, this is full of refreshing red berry fruits, making this a clean, forward apéritif. It has fragrant acidity on the finish.
title: Domaine des Nugues 2011 Gamay (Beaujolais Rosé)

description: This is a really fruity, fresh strawberry-flavored wine. Remarkably pale in color, it expertly balances a dry profile with brisk natural acidity and bright, fresh fruitiness. It's ready to drink now. Screwcap.
title: Weszeli 2012 Rosé (Niederösterreich)

description: Sweet and sour, with cherry and raspberry jam flavors finished with acidity that stings the palate, like vinegar.
title: Sunstone 2007 Syrah Rosé (Santa Ynez Valley)

description: A subtle, pretty nose of vanilla, cherry and strawberry is backed up by bigger flavors of sour cherry, spice and vanilla. Fun and exuberant but not terribly delicate. A good match with meats and poultry.
title: Red Tail Ridge 2008 Dry Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: A lively wine, layering wild strawberry and vanilla flavors with a light spritz and sweetshop candy. The acidity is crisp, apple skin fresh.
title: Château Cahuzac 2008 Rosé Red (Fronton)

description: This is a soft, fruity wine with a lively creamy mousse. Red fruits are cut with acidity that is still young. The wine really needs more time in bottle before it is drunk to allow the super-fresh character and final bitterness to soften. Palmer is the brand name for a grouping of seven growers.
title: Palmer & Co NV Rosé Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: Bright pink in color, this is a soft, ripe and fruity wine. It has a light texture that supports the raspberry flavors. A delicate cut of acidity comes through at the end. Drink now.
title: Pelvillain Frères 2014 Zee Original Rosé (Côtes du Lot)

description: This wine is bone dry, very crisp and fruity. It presents a bright and lively character plus orange peel tang. The acidity at the end is very fresh, with just a touch of caramel.
title: Château de l'Aubrade 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Touches of red fruits give this soft and creamy wine attractive acidity. Pepper and spice lead to a bitter aftertaste.
title: Château de Piote 2010 Perles Rosé  (Crémant de Bordeaux)

description: A bold pink color suggests the richness of this vanilla-flavored wine that misses out on a truly refreshing character. It is full and soft, with a touch of bitter acidity at the end.
title: Château des Antonins 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This caramel-flavored, lightly pink wine is soft and full in the mouth, with a light touch of tannin in the background. Drink now.
title: Château Maison Noble 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Deep pink in color, this gently fruity wine has too much caramel flavor. It offers red currant fruit at the end and attractive acidity.
title: Château Ramage la Batisse 2014 La Rosée de Ramage Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a soft wine, fruity without great definition. A ripe, red fruit character contrasts with a bitter acidity. It is ready to drink. The blend is 50/50 Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon.
title: Château Taussin 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine is rich while also crisp. Refreshing red fruits are laced with a touch of orange peel and spice. A blend of the local Nieullucciu and Sciaccarellu, it is fruity and very ready to drink.
title: Domaine Vico 2015 Rosé (Corse)

description: Pale peach in color, this wine offers pleasing aromas of watermelon and strawberry. It drinks just a hair off dry, with a light spritz that perks up the interest.
title: Anew 2015 Rosé (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Mainly Pinot Noir with a touch of Gamay, this is a crisp red-currant flavored wine. It comes from northern Burgundy giving a cool character to this fruity wine. The acidity and the orange zest at the end are really refreshing.
title: Bailly-Lapierre NV Rosé Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Aromas of apple and pear are followed by dry, medium-bodied fruit flavors, dipping a bit in the middle before coming back together.
title: Wind Rose 2015 Dry White Wine Pinot Grigio (Yakima Valley)

description: Aromas of powdered bubble gum, plum and chlorine aren't great, nor is the clamping, gritty feeling palate. With flavors of tart citrus and not much more, this is a limited but decent South American rosé.
title: Piattelli 2014 Premium Rosé of Malbec (Luján de Cuyo)

description: Made from 50% Syrah and 50% Mourvèdre, this rosé offers direct notes of red cherry, currant and raspberry on the nose and mouth. Hints of savory herbs and underbrush add depth to the palate, finishing short and slightly bitter. Drink up.
title: Domaine Cazes 2014 Le Canon du Marechal Rosé (Côtes Catalanes)

description: This is a soft, fresh wine, with attractive red-berry fruits. It has little character, simply fresh fruit and acidity. Drink now.
title: Dona Maria-Júlio Bastos 2014 Dona Maria Rosé (Alentejano)

description: Orange pink in color, this is a fat wine. It has acidity and red berry fruits although they are surrounded by a plump texture. It is ready to drink.
title: Adega Cooperativa do Cartaxo 2014 Bridão Classico Rosé (Tejo)

description: This is a fresh but also full and rich wine with ripe pear and raspberry fruits. The wine is balanced and ready to drink.
title: Château Fonfroide 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is as fine a rosé sparkling wine as has ever been produced in California. Almost 50-50 Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, it has rich flavors of cherries, raspberries, vanilla, toast and creamy lees, in the style of Champagne, and is completely dry and very crisp in acidity. Fabulously drinkable now, it should develop well over the next 6–8 years.
title: Roederer Estate 2003 L'Ermitage Brut Rosé Sparkling (Anderson Valley)

description: There's a strong nose on this single-vineyard from a reliable appellation in the middle of Monterey County, with white floral, crispy apple and light honey aromas. It's zesty with tongue-singeing acidity, showing flavors of dried apples, lime juice and honeydew melon.
title: Joullian 2013 Roger Rose Vineyard Chardonnay (Arroyo Seco)

description: This attractive sunset-pink colored wine has light acidity along with its rich, structured fruit. This is as serious as rosé gets, with red plum and berry fruits supported by a concentrated texture and acidity. It could age, so drink towards the end of 2015.
title: Mas de Cadenet 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: Refreshingly mineral, yet deeply concentrated in red fruit, this wine is a standout amidst a growing contingent of quality New York rosé. It's revitalizing in acidity and nuanced, showcasing hints of bramble against a backdrop of deep cherry and berry flavors. Dry, elegant and quaffable, it's an ideal summer staple.
title: Kelby James Russell 2014 Nutt Road Vineyard Dry Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: Dry and delicious, this lightly colored rosé opens with a compelling waft of rose water and exudes copper-pink color. A refreshingly searing acidity maintains vibrancy from start to finish, accented in grapefruit. This quaff is great on its own or throughout a meal.
title: Bodkin 2014 Hotspur Rosé of Zinfandel (Russian River Valley)

description: Crisp and fresh, a well-balanced wine that shows vivid fruit, acidity as well as weight. The crispness at the end gives a delicious final burst.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2009 La Cave de Saint-Roch-les-Vignes Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This Brut style Prosecco from Gancia (one of the most historic producers of this popular Italian sparkling wine) offers fresh floral aromas backed by drying mineral tones and pulpy notes of peach and apricot. The finish is crisp, cleansing and tonic.
title: Gancia NV Brut  (Prosecco)

description: This is a very mineral-driven pink wine, with aromas of wet rocks, chalk and even steel giving way to the slightest hints of orange and strawberry. The flavors are very delicate and refreshing on the palate, with melon and red pear, rounded out by a key lime acidity.
title: Robert Renzoni 2016 Lyric Rose of Syrah (Temecula Valley)

description: The cooler northern part of Burgundy is not far from southern Champagne, so it's unsurprising that this is the source of much sparkling Burgundy. This pale colored rosé is soft and fruity, with a hint of red cherry and plenty of fine, crisp acidity. Drink now.
title: Simonnet-Febvre NV Brut Rosé  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Bright and perfumed while also rich, this is a full-bodied wine. It has spice and pepper that come from its alcohol although everything is kept fresh by the red-currant fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Château d'Azur 2015 Jardin du Soleil Cuvée Prestige Rosé (Bandol)

description: The Mourvèdre in this ripe wine lends a wonderful spice and herbal character. While the wine is full and rich, it also has a fine refreshing line of raspberry fruit. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château d'Azur 2015 Tradition Rosé (Bandol)

description: This pale peach, lightly bricked wine brings aromas of strawberry and melon rind. It drinks dry with a broad feel and fruit flavors that linger.
title: Fielding Hills 2015 Estate Riverbend Vineyard Cabernet Franc Rosé (Wahluke Slope)

description: Blended from 70% Syrah, 18% Mourvèdre and 12% Grenache, this concentrated refresher offers light, crisp waves of vanilla-cherry, grapefruit and orange. It will remain restrained in the glass if not revelatory in ripe fruit.
title: Lasseter 2015 Enjoué Estate Grown Rosé (Sonoma Valley)

description: A pretty pale peach color, this wine has aromas of cherry, herbs and mineral. It drinks dry with generous, mouthwateringly tart cherry and watermelon flavors.
designation: And Why Am I Mr. Pink Rosé of
title: Underground Wine Project 2015 And Why Am I Mr. Pink Rosé of Sangiovese (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Produced close to the sea at Bandol, this wine has a good proportion (20%) of Mourvèdre in the blend. That adds to the richness and brings out a fine aromatic floral character. Wild strawberries flavors give a rich ready-to-drink aftertaste.
title: Le Charmel 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Made from Negroamaro, this opens with aromas of red berry, apple and a whiff of wild flower. It's bright and refreshing, offering raspberry notes and a hint of white pepper alongside crisp acidity.
title: Masseria Altemura 2016 Rosato (Salento)

description: This is a refreshingly fruity wine with a fine balance between acidity and ripe red-currant and raspberry fruits. The wine is crisp, clean and full of fruitiness with a bright fresh aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Estandon 2016 Lumière de Provence Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: This is a pale-colored wine—lightly fruity and with a crisp clean texture. It is balanced with acidity and orange-zest flavor, giving the wine a refreshing lift at the end. This is an apéritif style, ready to drink now.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2016 Les Jolies Flles Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A perfect balance of watermelon and strawberry fruit flavors introduce this lovely rosé. It's bone dry and as perfect a companion to your holiday turkey as your mid-summer picnic.
title: Dusted Valley 2009 Ramblin' Rosé (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: With 45% Mourvèdre and 35% Cinsault this has turned into a highly flavored and aromatic wine. It has great fruits and a rich texture that has a herbal edge. It is certainly a food rosé and with its up-front fruit, it could do with a few months to calm down. Drink from late 2017.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2016 Cuvée G Rosé (Bandol)

description: With a high proportion of the local Rolle grape in the blend, this is a lightly perfumed wine with a strong herbal element. It is a ripe finely structured wine, with great acidity and orange flavors. A style of wine that will be better for a few more months, it should be drunk from late 2017.
title: Bernard Magrez 2016 Château des Muraires Séduction Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is the latest wine from the same producer as the popular Whispering Angel rosé. It has a wonderful herbal character that lifts the bright red-currant fruit. Acidity and fruit are allied with the mineral texture to create a wine that will be just right for food.
title: Château d'Esclans 2016 Rock Angel Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: An eclectic range of grapes including Tibouren and Rolle go into this harmonious wine. The Provence cru classé estate has made a rich wine, full with red fruits as well as intense acidity and a tight structure. The wine is ready to drink, although it will be better from 2018.
title: Château du Galoupet 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Organically grown grapes from one of the top Provence estates have produced this light grey-pink colored wine. It is a delicious fruity confection of bright red berries and tangy acidity. There is an attractive touch of minerality to give the wine structure. Drink now.
title: Château Gassier 2016 Le Pas du Moine Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: This is a beautifully structured ripe wine that is full of dense red fruits and tightly wrought acidity. Crisply textured raspberry flavors dominate. This is a rich wine that can be kept for a few months. Drink at the end of 2017.
title: Château la Mascaronne 2016 Quat'Saisons Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is the ripest wine in the Béatrice range. With generous red fruits and balanced acidity it has weight and richness alongside the crisp, tangy fruitiness. This is a textured wine with spice and pepper flavors to add complexity to the fruit. Drink the wine from late 2017.
title: Château Sainte-Béatrice 2016 Cuvée Vaussière Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Located at the base of the Sainte-Victoire mountain, this vineyard, owned by the Dragon family for four generations, has produced a ripe wine, full-bodied and with concentration. It has raspberry flavors and a touch of spice that gives the wine extra richness. Drink this dense wine from late 2017.
title: Domaine Dragon 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: This is a pristinely fruity yet vivacious sparkling rosé. It's deft in body and scintillatingly crisp, offering layers of tart red-apple and raspberry flavors. Fine delicate froth and persistent bubbles set it apart, as does its long sugar-cookie finish.
title: Bedell 2015 Sparkling Rosé Sparkling (North Fork of Long Island)

description: This simple sparkler opens with fresh citrus and peach followed by bright acidity and smooth effervescence. Those easy-drinking and refreshing qualities make this Prosecco the perfect summer sipper.
title: Enza NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Very fresh and crisp, with yeasty aromas and delicious red currant flavors. The acidity is well integrated with the red fruits, giving crispness as well as a light, delicate character. The aftertaste shows some more sweetness, but the wine balances well.
title: Charles Orban NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Raspberry and cherry aromas are light and pleasing, while the palate exhibits those same friendly and inviting raspberry flavors along with some citrus. A fresh and clean wine, nothing more or less. But it manages to rise above the masses via its focus, length and purity.
title: Melipal 2008 Rosé Malbec (Mendoza)

description: A joint venture between Champagne de Sousa and Burgundy's Olivier Leflaive, this rosé is deliciously bright with red fruit. It has a weighty, vinous character with just an edge of tannin to give it extra richness. Hints of toastiness and fine acidity cut through its fruit core. Drink now.
title: Valentin Leflaive NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This is a strongly flavored blush, packing a punch of raspberry, fig, sweet tea and rose flavors. It's dry and very crisp in acidity. Give it a chill and enjoy with salted, smoked meats, or a nice fish stew.
title: VML 2011 Rosé of Pinot Noir Rosé (Russian River Valley)

description: This is bone dry, complex and warm in alcohol. The flavors include blackberries, currants, black pepper and sandalwood, with a meaty, leathery note of beef jerky. Drink up.
title: Rosenblum 2010 Fran's Reserve Syrah (Rockpile)

description: This old favorite has an excellent new release. A classic style of Zin, it surrounds generous fruit and spice flavors with a firm texture and appetizing tannins. It starts with light black pepper and sage aromas to complement the rich blackberry and raspberry fruit, and finishes with lingering nuances of spice and berry.
title: Rosenblum NV Vintner's Cuvée XXXVIII Zinfandel (California)

description: A blend of 75% Pinot Noir and 25% Chardonnay, this conveys a subtle fragrance of rose, apple and a whiff of toasted hazelnut. The savory palate offers Marasca cherry and strawberry alongside a note of pastry cream backed up by crisp acidity and a lively perlage. It's a great deal at this price point.
title: Rotari NV Rosé Sparkling (Trento)

description: Apples and strawberry combine easily in this soft, fresh rosé. It's fruity, light, with a slight prickle in the mouth.
title: Aveleda 2010 Casal Garcia Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: Stony aromas of minerally citrus and nectarine are clean and upright. This Garnacha rosé is simple but good in feel, with generic but clean flavors of stone fruits. Bitter, pithy flavors rise up to dominate the finish.
title: Las Rocas de San Alejandro 2013 Rosé (Calatayud)

description: Pink lemonade and cherry pie mesh together into a strong, slightly boozy aroma on this adventurous blend of 30% Petite Sirah, 30% Syrah, 30% Grenache and 10% Tannat from Matt Villard's Petite Sirah-focused project. Cherry and orange juice dominate the palate.
title: MCV 2013 Pink Rosé (Paso Robles)

description: Sourced from Saralee's Vineyard-Matthew Station, it offers indelible savory and herbal notes, a chewy sense of wild strawberry and a drying finish for a curious, more thirst-quenching take on Tannat.
title: Y Rousseau 2013 Rosé of Tannat (Russian River Valley)

description: Fresh, light and fruity, it has ripe strawberry flavors, bright acidity and just a touch of caramel. It is full in the mouth, with a rounded feel and a soft texture at the end.
title: Château Tour de Guiet 2013 Rosé de Guiet Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Clean, fresh and inviting aromas are simple as rosé should be. Plum, raspberry and other red-fruit flavors are full and tight, with ripeness, acidity and just a hint of sweetness.
title: Coto de Hayas 2013 Garnacha-Cabernet Sauvignon Rosado (Campo de Borja)

description: Made with Cabernet and Sangiovese, this pale simple rosato offers subdued aromas of dried red berry, scorched earth and an unusual hint of paraffin that eventually burns off. The aromas carry over to the ripe, informal palate along with a touch of toasted nut. Drink now.
title: Terre di Talamo 2015 Rosato (Toscana)

description: A classic of the genre, this combines a deep color with luscious fruit character and spicy accents on a velvety texture. Firm tannins lend an appetizing grip, while the fresh ripe blackberry, clove and cedar flavors seem to melt on the tongue and linger on the finish. It shows great complexity and balance in a traditional dry style.
title: Rosenblum 2011 Carla's Vineyard Zinfandel (Contra Costa County)

description: Made from Zinfandel, this wine has dark color and an intensity of weight, but also enough of a high-toned taste of fresh tangerine to remain captivating in the glass, refreshing and substantial.
title: Gracianna 2015 Arozza Rosé (Russian River Valley)

description: Crisp raspberry, red-cherry and blossom notes lend exhilarating freshness to this Cabernet Franc rosé. Dry in style yet concentrated and juicy, it's an irresistible quaffer that you'll want to keep drinking long after the summer's end.
title: Sheldrake Point 2015 Dry Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: The latest vintage of Roederer Rosé shows all the finesse of which this producer is capable. It has fruit and the merest touches of bottle age. Red berries shine alongside the mineral texture and the pure line of crisp acidity. It's a beautiful Champagne that could age longer.
title: Louis Roederer 2009 Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Full bodied, rich and thickly textured, this is just a bit earthier and chunkier than Chambers' Rare bottling, while still remaining an outstanding sweet wine. The flavors are dark, earthy and intense, with lots of candied date notes and a lingering finish of molasses.
title: Chambers Rosewood Vineyards NV Grand Muscadelle (Rutherglen)

description: Pungent tones of almond skin and peanut disturb this Prosecco Brut that otherwise shows bright luminosity and persistent perlage. The sparkler has sour notes on the close and lingering nutty flavors.
title: Le Vigne di Alice 2007 Millesimato Doro Brut  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: This mature generous wine is perfectly ready to drink. Its red fruits are now balanced by a toasty character as well as ripe acidity and a touch of tannin. This is a very fine wine, balanced and rich. Drink now.
title: Louis Roederer 2012 Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Kathleen Inman has gained such a following with her Rosé that she's given it a special designation, a nod to her happy marriage. Made in a direct-press style, the dry, refreshing wine is light salmon in color and marked by aromatic grapefruit and strawberry, mouthfilling and juicy as a slice of watermelon in summer.
title: Inman Family 2013 Endless Crush Rosé of Pinot Noir (Russian River Valley)

description: Whispers of cherry blossoms and briar patch add flair to the sweet black-cherry and blackberry flavors. Dry in style, with notes of fresh and dried herbs, it's a perfect pairing for an elegant late-summer barbecue.
title: Channing Daughters 2011 Rosato Cabernet Sauvignon Mudd Vineyard Rosé (North Fork of Long Island)

description: There are notes of wild berry and rustic game that add a shadow of darkness to this refreshing, cherry-laden rosé made from the Italian Refosco grape. It's bone dry and vivacious with acidity.
title: Channing Daughters 2011 Rosato Refosco Home Farm Vineyard Rosé (The Hamptons, Long Island)

description: Made entirely with Pinot Nero, this salmon-colored sparkler opens with aromas of toasted nut, McIntosh apple and red berry. The creamy palate delivers ripe red cherry, raspberry, toasted hazelnut and a hint of cake spice alongside a soft mousse.
title: La Valle 2011 Brut Rosé Pinot Nero (Franciacorta)

description: Named after Madeleine Herbeau, co-owner of the estate, this wine is a balanced, clean and crisp. It has intense red currant acidity allied to warmer strawberry flavors. The aftertaste is packed with bright fruit.
title: Château Barbebelle 2015 Cuvée Madeleine Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: The entry-level wine in the Esclans range, this is as fresh and fruity as possible. Juicy red currant and tangy acidity combine in this delicious blend of Grenache, Cinsault and Syrah. The wine is dry while showing exuberant fruit. It can be drunk either as an apéritif or with food.
title: Château d'Esclans 2015 Whispering Angel Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The estate wine of Sainte Roseline has a pale color and perfumed, lightly herbal fruit. It has structure from the Mourvèdre that also perfumes the riper Grenache and Syrah in the blend. This concentrated wine is destined to go with food.
title: Château Sainte Roseline 2015 Cuvée Lampe de Méduse Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wine is named “the three brothers” after the owner's siblings. It is a tight, mineral-driven wine, although the citrus and apple fruit flavors are not far behind. With acidity and spice, the wine is rich and ready to drink.
title: Domaine des Aspras 2015 Les Trois Frères Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Concentrated berry aromas meet with bubblegum and hibiscus on the simple and pleasant nose of this pink bottling from the winery's Los Alamos Ranch, which Louis Lucas planted decades ago. The palate shows tart pink grapefruit juice, but is rounded out by a soft texture.
title: Lucas & Lewellen 2016 Rose of Pinot Noir (Santa Barbara County)

description: From one of the small outliers in the Loire valley, this crisp wine made from Pineau d'Aunis is bright and lively. It has fresh acidity, red currant flavors and a light, tight aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Cave Cooperative du Vendômois 2014 Lieu-dit Cocagne Rosé (Coteaux du Vendômois)

description: This classic blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir from Savoie has resulted in the palest rosé that rivals only Provence in color. It has a touch of tannin, plenty of red-fruit acidity and a soft, creamy aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Les Rocailles NV Brut Rosé  (Vin de France)

description: Aromas of red berry, apple and a whiff of bread dough lead the nose. The lively palate offers sour cherry, nectarine and bread crust alongside firm acidity and a vivacious perlage.
designation: Giovanni Galliano Brut Rosé Metodo Classico
title: Borgo Maragliano 2012 Giovanni Galliano Brut Rosé Metodo Classico Sparkling (Vino Spumante)

description: A pale-colored wine that has an attractive yeasty character that matches well with the crisp red fruits. It has a hint of tannin as well as red berries. The wine is fruity and ready to drink.
title: Caves Transmontanas 2013 Vértice Rosé Bruto Sparkling (Douro)

description: Pink in color, a smooth wine, layered in caramel, missing real fruit.
title: Borges 2010 Lello Rosé (Douro)

description: Darker in color than normal rosé, Bordeaux Clairet also has more richness. This wine is concentrated with vanilla and sweet strawberry flavors, although with a lack of freshness. Treat this as a red wine.
title: Château de Parenchère 2010 Rosé (Bordeaux Clairet)

description: 94–96. Barrel sample. This is a big, powerful, fruity wine that has restraint from its dense tannins. It's foursquare, chunky in character, already balanced, the tannins merging with the acidity. There is great aging potential.
title: Château Montrose 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: As reliable as the first flowers of spring, this perennial best-of-show winner offers lovely scents and flavors of fresh-picked strawberries. Subtle suggestions of rose water and orange peel can be found, along with some precise fruit-skin flavors.
title: Barnard Griffin 2013 Rosé of Sangiovese (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Now sourced from the estate vineyard on Red Mountain, this exceptional rosé includes portions of Counoise, Cinsault and Grenache. Though the pale, coppery pink shade suggests a light wine, this is fragrant and full-bodied, with salmonberry and strawberry fruit, light spice and excellent length.
title: Tranche 2013 Blackrock Vineyard Pink Pape Rosé (Yakima Valley)

description: In its tall square bottle, this makes a striking presentation. The wine inside has the same sense of presence, with a ripe, full-bodied structure that's full of red fruits with only light acidity. Fruitiness makes it delicious as an apéritif.
title: Château de Berne 2013 Terres de Berne Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Quat' Saisons, meaning four seasons, suggests that this wine isn't just for summer. It is certainly a food wine with its dry, full-bodied character and ripe caramel and red plum flavors. Lively and fresh at the end, it's ready to drink.
title: Château la Mascaronne 2013 Quat' Saisons Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The heavy bottle indicates the importance attached to this wine by its producer. Structured and full bodied, it bursts with crisp fruits, mineral acidity and a touch of herbaceousness. Keep it until late 2014 to broaden out.
title: Domaine Saint-André de Figuière 2013 Première de Figuière Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Hydropathe means someone who reacts against water, presumably preferring wine. From hard against the slopes of Mount Sainte-Vicoire, this is a structured, rich and fruity wine. It reveals a strong citrus element as well as red fruits and a strongly mineral texture.
title: Domaine Sainte Lucie 2012 L'Hydropathe Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: A new addition to Boschendal's line-up, The Rose Garden Rosé pays tribute to the estate's iconic grounds and garden. Fresh aromas and flavors of raspberry, strawberry hull, white cherry and melon rind recall sunny days spent outside. Light sweet-spice accents carry through the refreshing finish, ending clean and mouthwatering.
title: Boschendal 2013 The Rose Garden Rosé (Coastal Region)

description: Rich in style, this full-bodied rosé boasts ripe red fruits and a rounded, smooth character. The lift from acidity gives essential freshness at the end.
title: Château de la Galinière 2013 Le Cengle Vieilles Vignes Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Close to Saint-Tropez the vineyards of the Massif des Maures have produced an attractively fruity wine that has an unusual blending including the rare Caladoc grape. Raspberry fruits are right up front, giving a bright, ripe character.
title: Domaine d'Astros 2013 Cuvée Prestige Rosé (Vin de Pays des Maures)

description: Properly light in color, this is crisp, fruity and deliciously fresh. Some weight comes from ripe strawberry fruits as well as touches of vanilla. The acidity at the end brings refreshment.
title: Les Quatre Tours 2013 Classique Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Dusty cherry aromas are basic but also clean. In the mouth, this is fresh, citrusy and whole, with orange, tangerine and pink grapefruit flavors that finish dry and slightly bitter, like licking a nectarine pit.
title: CVNE 2013 Cune Rosado (Rioja)

description: Made with organically farmed Nero d'Avola, this opens with aromas of toast, oak-driven spice and blackcurrant. The palate offers up prune, anise, oak extract and coffee alongside drying, fleeting tannins.
title: Masseria del Feudo 2012 Rosso delle Rose Nero d'Avola (Sicilia)

description: High-altitude vines yielded this full while also crisp wine. It is fruity, touched by caramel and spice and some toast flavors from wood aging. This is a rosé style that goes with food.
title: Muxagat 2013 Rosé (Douro)

description: This is an onion-skin-colored wine, ripe and showing some maturity as well as rich red and citrus fruits. It is beautifully balanced, the pure, crisp fruit elegantly integrated into the lightly mineral texture. This stylish bottling is ready to drink.
title: Krug NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Produced from Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, this balances ripe red berry and citrus fruits with more mature spice and vanilla. With this development has come depth, concentration and richness. It is a wine to drink with food, ripe and finishing with crisp, dry acidity.
title: Billecart-Salmon 2006 Cuvée Elisabeth Salmon Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A blend of grapes from Cumières in the Marne Valley and the Côte des Blancs, this is a rich, well-balanced and very young brut rosé. It is ripe, while keeping an almost austere texture and acidity that will soften and broaden out as it ages. Drink now for the lively red fruits, but better to wait until 2019.
title: Louis Roederer 2011 Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: The whole world of apricots is represented here: fresh, candied and dried. The concentration on the palate is immense, the scent is disarming, the sweetness is beyond luscious. Aromatic blood-orange peel and flesh provide an equally fragrant counterbalance. Irresistible now but of such richness and concentration that time will have nothing on it. Drink now and through 2030 at least.
title: Rosenhof 2013 Ausbruch Traminer (Burgenland)

description: Reminiscent of a good southern French rosé, this blush of Syrah, Grenache, Mourvèdre and Cinsaut is dry, crisp and minerally. It has subtle, complex flavors of rose petals, herb tea, cherry skins, anise, cloves and lavender, and is quite complex, especially considering the price.
title: Robert Hall 2007 Hall Ranch Rosé de Robles Rosé (Paso Robles)

description: This wine's inviting aromas of tar, menthol and rose take shape in the glass. The elegant palate doles out red cherry, cranberry and dried herb flavors set against a backdrop of refined tannins and bright acidity. Drink 2021–2028.
title: Bric Cenciurio 2013 Coste di Rose  (Barolo)

description: This bright wine has red fruits, citrus and a light minerality, finishing crisply. Wait until late 2014 for it to open up.
title: Château les Valentines 2013 Le Caprice de Clémentine Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Warm while also fresh, this rounded wine is full of red fruits, lit up by a touch of spice and freshened with acidity. Clean and crisp, it's just bursting with fruit at the end.
title: Château Montaud 2013 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A warmly perfumed wine, it has all the aromatic characters of Pinot Gris, rounded and soft with only a few hints of acidity. Off-dry, it is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Albert Mann 2011 Rosenberg Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: The simplest wine from La Sanglière is as attractive as the rest of the range. It has a tangy, bright texture, very crisp with raspberry fruits and bone-dry acidity. It is ready to drink.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2013 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
