description: Packed with fruit, this is a ripe, rich wine. Red berries are cut with attractive citrus flavors. Full in the mouth and with a good tannic character, this is a wine for food, especially spicy dishes.
title: Château La Croix de Queynac 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Lightly tannic and packed with raspberry flavors, this delicious wine has just the right balance between the ripe fruits and bright acidity. The wine is totally ready to drink.
title: Château Les Hauts de Palette 2015 Château du Barail Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a clean and vibrant rosé, with upfront notes of lavender, menthol and bay that frame red cherry and berry tones. The palate is fleshy and fruit-forward, with bold flavors of peach and strawberry that transition seamlessly into the citrus-zest finish.
title: Hecht & Bannier 2015 Rosé (Languedoc)

description: Intense baked plum and black cherry aromas meet with vanilla, caramel and sagebrush on the nose of this bottling from one of the appellation's most coveted vineyards. The tangy, energetic and grippy palate offers crushed cranberry flavors, more black plum, gingerbread and exotic Indian spice on the finish.
title: Loring Wine Company 2015 Rosella's Vineyard Pinot Noir (Santa Lucia Highlands)

description: Ripe fruit flavors and an easy but refined foamy texture make this light salmon-colored bubbly taste generous, complete, fruity and fresh. A touch of sweetness in the cherry and berry flavors keep the impression smooth and the flavors fruity through the finish.
title: McFadden NV Cuvee Brut Rosé Sparkling (Potter Valley)

description: This is a fresh, strawberry-flavored wine with a crisp, dry aftertaste. An attractive tangy character gives life and brilliance. Ready to drink, it is a real apéritif wine.
title: Château Grand Boise 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: The use of 100% Syrah gives a deep pink color that borders on purple. Aromas are rather strong too, with the flaky, buttered crust of a hot cherry pie running into the more bitter elements of citrus rinds. Those characters play leading roles on the palate as well, cherry candy toying with just-ripe grapefruit, providing tensions that keeps the sipping interesting. Just 72 cases produced.
title: Solminer 2013 Linus Rosé (Santa Ynez Valley)

description: Picturesque with a crystalline salmon color, it begins with the scent of just-bitten nectarine. The following flavors of tart apple and a slightly bitter salinity ensure the uniqueness of this wine. Mourvèdre (57%) is in the lead, followed closely by Grenache (28%) and Counoise (15%), all coming from the original cuttings of the Château de Beaucastel. This age-worthy blend will be fun to track 2017–2019.
title: Tablas Creek 2013 Dianthus Estate Mourvèdre-Grenache-Counoise Rosé (Paso Robles)

description: This very fresh wine from the Ducourt family is all crisp, crushed berry fruits and tight acidity. The 100% Cabernet Sauvignon is tangy, very dry and steely in character, with equal parts acidity and fruit. The aftertaste is lively, poised and refreshing.
title: Château Larroque 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This totally refreshing wine is crisp, lively and packed with acidity as well as red currant fruits. It's a delicious wine and a fine apéritif from the Doublet family in Entre-deux-Mers.
title: Château Vignol 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Attractively pink in color, this has a touch of caramel as well as ripe strawberry fruit flavors. It has a rich side, but is bright and fruity with lively acidity at the end. It will be great as an apéritif.
title: Château Vircoulon 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This blend of 75% Grenache and 25% Syrah is a well-made rosé at a realistic price. Scents of crushed stone and bubble gum emerge from the glass, followed by medium-bodied strawberry and cherry flavors and a faintly chalky finish.
title: Saveurs du Temps 2014 Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: Delicious, fruity rosé, and as befits the vintage, with some weight and richness as well. The red berry flavors are overlaid with caramel and cinnamon. Great final acidity.
title: Roger et Didier Raimbault 2009 Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Yeasty aromas of bread crust and mature white stone fruit lift out of the glass. Rounded and refreshing, the vivacious palate shows ripe yellow apple and Bartlett pear alongside bright acidity and a firm perlage.
title: Canevel 2016 Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Aromas evoking spring wild flower and ripe orchard fruit open on the nose while the vibrant straightforward palate offers green apple and a citrusy note. Bright acidity and a soft persistent perlage provide the backdrop.
title: Case Bianche 2016 Vigna del Cuc Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Citrus, orchard-fruit and spring-blossom aromas float out of the glass. Mirroring the nose, the slightly sweet, creamy palate tastes of white peach, apple and candied citrus peel offset by fresh acidity and a foaming perlage.
title: Drusian 2016 Millesimato Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Yeast, apple and red-berry notes constitute the rustic nose of this pink pét nat. The fruit of the palate is juicy and fresh, recalling apple and berry coolers with a tinge of yeast. Light but full flavored, the body is supported by fine fizz. The wine finishes bone dry.
title: Fuchs und Hase 2015 Pét Nat Rosé Sparkling (Weinland Österreich)

description: Made with skins to add color, this dark-orange-pink wine has fine red-berry aromas. It is dry and crisp with lively acidity as well as red-currant flavors. Drink this attractive wine now.
title: Vollereaux NV Brut Rosé de Saignée  (Champagne)

description: A curious rosé that relies on a touch of Tempranillo to color the Chardonnay, Pinot Grigio and Symphony grapes, this shows sour orange and light plum on the nose. Dried strawberry and orange rind appear on the sip, which is framed by decent acidity and light tannins.
title: Reyes 2016 Renaissance Rosé (California)

description: Strawberry aromas follow through to the soft, red berry fruit flavors of this wine. The blend of 60% Merlot and 40% Cabernet Sauvignon gives both richness and structure. Drink now.
title: Rosé de Guiet 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This pretty wine, with its pale pink color, is soft and fruity. Strawberry flavors give it a ripe character that's reflected in the light acidity on the finish. Drink now.
title: Château l'Orangerie 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a soft wine, a blend of Aragonez and Merlot. It has a ripe rounded character that is lightly cut with acidity. It is an easy wine, perfumed and ready to drink.
title: Cortes de Cima 2016 Rosé (Alentejano)

description: This fresh, lively and assertive wine comes off as a touch sweet but it has such tangy acidity that it stays well balanced. Bright cherry and raspberry flavors have a big impact on the palate and will help it pair nicely with strong foods.
title: Navarro 2016 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Anderson Valley)

description: It's hard to believe it's possible to buy this quality rosé for so little money. Mouthwatering scents of raspberry, stone fruit and crushed stone emerge from the glass, followed by rich, ripe fruit flavors balanced by just-enough citrusy acidity. It's full-bodied and plush, yet vibrant and long on the finish.
title: Domaine des Carteresses 2016  Tavel

description: Unusually complex for a rosé, this medium- to full-bodied wine offers a mix of red berries and melon, hints of cinnamon and clove, richness reminiscent of white chocolate and even a tinge of mocha on the lengthy finish. Drink now–2018.
title: Château la Genestière 2016  Tavel

description: This is a full in the mouth, forward and fruity rosé, that is all fresh acidity and lively, crisp flavors. It has a light, zesty texture and the merest hint of toastiness. Drink now or give it a year's bottle aging.
title: Dampierre NV Cuvée des Ambassadeurs Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A majority Pinot Noir (54%), this brut rosé has a healthy head of mousse followed by succulent strawberry flavor, bright acidity and a smooth finish. Dark golden-peach in color, it is layered and well-made, and a great value for the quality.
title: Scharffenberger NV Brut Rosé Excellence Sparkling (Mendocino County)

description: Made from Cabernet Sauvignon, this is a soft, rounded rosé, with red fruits right to the fore. With its attractive acidity, it is dry and very food friendly. Ready to drink.
title: Château Thieuley 2011 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah, this offers dainty aromas of peony, nectarine and white strawberry. Fresh and bright, this has a lively mouthfeel and a zippy finish.
title: Odem Mountain 2011 Volcanic Dry Rosé (Galilee)

description: This deep rosé—made from 70% Barbera and 30% Merlot—exhibits intense aromas of red plum and strawberry, along with a hint of pomegranate. Light weight but fruit forward, this has assertive flavors of red cherry and berry that show good length on the finish.
title: Recanati 2010 Rosé (Galilee)

description: This is an intense crisp and red-fruited wine. Clean and clear, this is delicious to drink now with its lively freshness on the finish. Screwcap.
title: Joseph Mellot 2011 Le Rabault Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Made from 90% Sangiovese plus other grapes, it opens with subtle aromas of blue flowers, black berries and toasted sensations. The juicy, dense palate offers ripe black cherry and raspberry spiced up with notes of black pepper and clove. Polished and extremely friendly, this is ready to be enjoyed soon.
title: Val delle Rose 2010 Riserva  (Morellino di Scansano)

description: This is an exceptionally rich wine, its fruit exploding from the glass. The richness gives a spicy, peppery edge to the ripe white fruit, and its acidity is almost an afterthought in this mélange of full-bodied fruit and texture.
title: Domaine Barmès-Buecher 2010 Rosenberg Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Dusty cherry and plum aromas are nothing special. The palate is similarly just OK, with stalky flavors of citrus and red fruits. This is lightly oxidized and pithy tasting on the finish.
title: Pushpin 2011 Global Garnacha Rosé (Campo de Borja)

description: A little too heavy and full-bodied for a blush, this wine has flavors of melted cherry jam, vanilla, oatmeal cookies and pepper. It's a good wine, but could use greater delicacy and charm.
title: Lavender Ridge 2006 Grenache Rosé (Sierra Foothills)

description: Pretty in pink and orange hues, this stainless-steel-fermented charmer has a candied orange flavor that's delicious, followed by fresh, crisp strawberry and tangerine-laced acidity. Medium bodied, it ends with a burst of peach.
title: Rodney Strong 2014 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Sonoma County)

description: Quite a deep color for a rosé—easily confused with a light Pinot Noir—this shows blackberry, black raspberry, hibiscus and fruit punch on the nose. For such a ripe nose, the palate is quite fresh and energetic, with black-plum skins, red-apple flesh and grippy cherry-pit flavors.
title: Sofia 2014 Rosé (Monterey County)

description: Delicately fresh wine, its fruit directed towards a crisp, bright character. It is soft, with red berry flavors and tight final acidity. Screwcap.
title: François Lurton 2010 Fumées Blanches Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: An attractively fresh rosé, full of red fruits laced with enticing acidity. The wine is light, fresh, a dry rosé great for food.
title: Château Laulerie 2010 Rosé (Bergerac)

description: This is made from 80% Cinsault, 10% Grenache and 10% Carignan. It has a deep pink hue and smells more like a red wine than many rosés, with hints of smoked meat, bold notes of garrigue and just a bit of berry-like fruit. It's full bodied, complex and savory—a fine rosé to serve with grilled meats.
title: Laurence Féraud 2016 Pink Pégau Rosé (Vin de France)

description: This full-bodied, richly textured rosé is wonderfully aromatic and floral, with dried spices, plums and cherries all mingling on the nose. Made from 80% Mourvèdre, it behaves almost like a good red wine, but with extra zest and freshness. You could sip it on its own, with white meats or even burgers or steaks.
title: Domaine Saint-André de Figuière 2007 Réserve Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is light, fruity and just off dry. It has bright red fruits and crisp acidity, softened by a gentle aftertaste. The wine, pure Gamay, is ready to drink.
title: Vinovalie 2016 Tarani Gamay Rosé

description: This is a lightly fruity wine with attractive acidity and citrus and apricot flavors. It is light and lively, fresh and crisp. There is a just a touch of spice and pepper at the end. Drink now.
title: Château de Brigue 2016 Brigue Vin de Provence Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a soft pretty wine with a light fruity character. It is gently fruity, finishing with a peppery edge and crisp acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Sainte-Béatrice 2016 Cuvée des Princes Rosé (Var)

description: This mild-tasting and light-bodied wine has a transparent pink color, muted fruity aromas and generic flavors. The texture is smooth and rather soft.
title: McManis 2016 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Lodi)

description: Candied fruit-punch aromas lead to a chunky palate that's low on finesse. Mildly bitter flavors of grape skins and red fruits finish similar, meaning O.K. but dull and heavy.
title: Otazu 2016 Merlot Rosado (Navarra)

description: This wine is so soft, rounded and fat. It has hints of red fruits and acidity with a herbal edge. But with the soft texture of the wine, it is misses out on fruit and acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Lauzade 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a soft simple wine, full of ripe red fruit. It has a lightly structured edge from the Syrah in the blend while keeping plenty of bright acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Virant 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is an attractive, herbal wine. It has light spice and touches of cilantro as well as crisp red fruits. The wine is bright and ready to drink.
title: Château Coussin 2016 La Croix du Prieur Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wine is on the pale side for this vintage. There is a yeasty character that comes across as bitterness. By contrast, the acidity and the crisp fruits are fine, light and delicate. Drink now.
title: Château de Brigue 2016 Fleur Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Fresh and fruity, light and fragrant, a wine with citrus flavors over red currants, spoilt by a metallic aftertaste.
title: Barton & Guestier 2012 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Even in a challenging year like the cool and rainy 2014 vintage, this dynamic firm has made a stunning sparkler thanks to rigorous grape selection. Refermented in the bottle, it offers aromas and flavors of white spring flowers, lemon-lime, green apple and peach. Vibrant acidity and a foaming mousse offset the linear palate while a mineral note backs up the finish.
title: Ca' dei Zago 2014 Col Fondo  (Prosecco)

description: Aromas of pressed yellow flowers, Bartlett pear and a hint of citrus lead the nose. The bright, savory palate doles out creamy white peach, green apple, pear and a mineral note alongside vibrant acidity and a frothy mousse.
title: Montesel 2014 Vigna del Paradiso Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This luminous sparkler opens with aromas of jasmine, orange blossom and white peach. The crisp, refreshing palate doles out green apple, Bartlett pear and white almond alongside vibrant acidity and a silky mousse.
title: Nino Franco NV Rustico  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This attractive wine, fresh with crisp apple as well as red fruit flavors, seems drier than in the past. That gives a tight, bright character that allows room for some tannins. The wine is fruity, attractively textured and ready to drink.
title: Perrier Jouët NV Blason Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Aromas of wisteria, young Bartlett pear and citrus lead the nose on this quenching sparkler. The racy, elegant palate offers grapefruit, green apple and lime alongside tangy acidity and an energized perlage. An almond note closes the finish.
title: Marchiori NV Profili Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Here's an easy-drinking, inexpensive rosé that's perfect for summer occasions. Made from an unusual blend of Sangiovese, Zinfandel, Carignan and Grenache, it's dryish, crisp and clean, with berry and spice flavors.
title: Bonterra 2009 Rosé (Mendocino County)

description: The sparkling wine opens with luminous perlage but the nose is a bit thorny and pungent with aromas of almond, peanut and pear that tickle the nose. It has direct citrus flavors and a long mineral finish backed by creamy froth.
title: Carmina NV Brut  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: This new release from Melrose fills the mouth with flavor; it runs from orange blossom to Meyer lemon to candied pineapple, finally settling into a strong citrus/tropical blend of delicious fruit flavors. It seems to strike a perfect balance, staying lively and well-defined, without becoming hot or bitter.
title: Melrose 2009 Viognier (Umpqua Valley)

description: Strained, funky aromas of corn chips don't include much fruit. This is mostly acid on the palate, while it tastes raw, choppy and citric. A tart finish fails to rescue this substandard rosé.
title: Alta Vista 2015 Malbec Rosé (Mendoza)

description: Soupy, horsey citrus and red-berry aromas precede a flabby palate with herbal red-berry flavors that upon inspection taste both sugary and green.
title: Bodega Renacer 2015 Punto Final Malbec Rosé (Mendoza)

description: This red-tinged rosado hits the nose with sharp and herbaceous scents. A drawing palate with sour citrus flaand pyrazines ends equally raw, tart and green.
title: Val de Los Frailes 2015 Rosado (Cigales)

description: Elegant and almost ethereal, this wine is tantalizing and irresistible. It shows sophistication, from the mysterious, earthy bouquet to the complex, well-aged brioche and peach flavors, as well as the almost gentle texture and refined finish. While full bodied, the wine has great balance, as all the tasty components join together to weave their magic.
title: Schramsberg 2007 J. Schram Brut Rosé  (North Coast)

description: Tart, sugar-frosted fruit comes to mind—candied red-currant and passion-fruit preserve. This is a wine on a tight-rope walk between tropical richness and lively tartness—it is thus just made for desserts that put equally tart fruits center stage. Alluring and different, with a lifted edge of pine resin, this is certainly a wine for felicitous experimenting.
title: Rosenhof 2012 Eiswein Blaufränkisch (Burgenland)

description: A blend of Grenache, Cinsault and Carignan, this offering is very citrusy upfront, filled with grapefruit aromas. It's light to medium in weight, with flavors reminiscent of tangerines and hints of strawberries and something vaguely vegetal on the finish.
title: Jules 2007 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Made from Grenache, Malbec, Pinot Noir and Tempranillo, this is a light, zesty and dry wine. Light copper-pink in color, it is high-toned in grapefruit, plum and peach, completely bright and refreshing. Easy to love from start to finish, it finishes with a twist of tart lemon.
title: Angels & Cowboys 2014 Rosé (Sonoma County)

description: This lively wine revels in its red fruits. It is tight, tangy and packed with fresh flavors, with just the right amount of weight and dryness to put it firmly on the table with food.
title: Château Boisson 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: A whiff of raspberry perfume trails through deep layers of wet rock and dusty mineral on the nose of this dry Spätburgunder rosé. While restrained in style, its fresh-cut red apple and pear flavors make a zesty year-round accompaniment to light chicken and fish dishes. Drink now.
title: Nauerth-Gnägy 2014 Ng.2 Schweigen-Rechtenbach Spätburgunder Trocken Rosé (Pfalz)

description: Medium-pink in color, this looks immediately vibrant and fruity. Scents of mealy plum, berry and watermelon fill the bouquet, while the palate offers more austere flavors of red currant and sour pomegranate. Tart and sharp in acidity, the finish is short and brisk.
title: Hecht & Bannier 2013 Rosé (Languedoc)

description: Soft and fruity, this is a ripe style of rosé. It's dry and peppery, with fresh acidity cutting through its rounded texture. It's a rosé for food, with a full aftertaste.
designation: Casa Ermelinda Freitas Monte de Baía
title: Wines & Winemakers 2013 Casa Ermelinda Freitas Monte de Baía Rosé (Península de Setúbal)

description: This wine is made from California's historic Mission grape variety, which winemaker Kevin Riley found planted as part of a field blend in his vineyard. The result is subtle aromas of lemon tart and night jasmine, followed by nectarine and bubble gum flavors, with a bit of tannins to hold it altogether. Check in on this wine in 2015 to track its evolution.
title: Proulx 2013 Rosé Mission (Paso Robles)

description: Fresh and fruity, this is a crisply made, drink-it-now rosé. With freshly crushed raspberries and light acidity, it's perfect for an apéritif.
title: Falua 2013 Tagus Creek Rosé (Tejo)

description: This light-hued, coppery-tinged rosé features delicate aromas of crushed stone and stone fruit. It's medium bodied and crisp, with peach and melon fruit that finishes dry and refreshing. Drink now.
title: Spy Valley 2015 Rosé Pinot Noir (Marlborough)

description: This pale-hued blend of Grenache and Syrah starts off a bit confected, offering up scents of cotton candy. Yet it's less so on the palate, where the fruit resembles underripe melon and the finish is stony and less generous.
title: Marrenon 2015 Grande Toque Rosé (Luberon)

description: Savory smoked-nut notes juxtapose ripe red cherry and strawberry in this full-bodied rosé. While quite substantial in mouthfeel, it has bright citrus acidity that lends some refreshment on the finish.
title: Mattebella 2014 Rosé (North Fork of Long Island)

description: This wine bursts with the scents and flavors of fresh strawberries. It's soft and fruity but finishes dry, with flavors gently turning from berry to cherry candy.
title: Acrobat 2012 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Oregon)

description: This is a lively, ripe, fruity wine that has both richness and freshness in equal measure. The wine is warm, but with delicate fruitiness from crisp red fruit. Drink this wine soon.
title: Mas de Gourgonnier 2012 Rosé (Les Baux de Provence)

description: This pours such a pleasing, vibrant pink color, with a fruity nose of fresh strawberries. It's like eating strawberries dressed in lemon juice: refreshing, deceptively easy and simple. If you are looking for refreshment and charm, this is your wine.
title: Pratsch 2012 Rosé Zweigelt (Niederösterreich)

description: Based on Loire Valley grapes, this wine is crisp and cleanly fruity. It has pleasant red berry fruit and a cool draft of acidity. Drink now.
title: Bougrier 2016 Alain de la Treille Le Rosé (Vin de France)

description: This is a lightly off-dry rosé, with a soft texture and strawberry flavors. The wine is easy to drink now, bright with acidity and smoothly finished.
title: Monte da Ravasqueira 2016 Rosé (Alentejano)

description: This sweet rosé is light and crisply fruity. Strawberry flavors make it an immediately refreshing and enjoyable apéritif wine.
title: Casa de Vilacetinho 2016 Escolha Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: A simple, fruity and caramel-flavored blend of Touriga Nacional and Aragonez, this is soft and smooth. Just enough acidity keeps it clean and crisp.
title: Quinta da Lapa 2016 Nana Rosé (Tejo)

description: An intensely orange-pink-colored wine, this is a blend of the local Castelão with Touriga Nacional and Syrah. Its acidity is filled out with ripe red-berry fruits and a smooth texture of vanilla. The wine is soft and ready to drink.
title: Wines & Winemakers 2016 Monte de Baía Rosé (Península de Setúbal)

description: This perfumed, spicy wine has crisp red fruit and acidity. Light and with a soft aftertaste, it's attractive and ready to drink.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2016 Syrah Rosé (Vin de France)

description: This ripe, strawberry-flavored blend of Touriga Nacional, Aragonez and Merlot is soft and smooth. It is rounded with an almost-sweet fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Casa Cadaval 2016 Vinha Padre Pedro Rosé (Tejo)

description: This remains a richly textured and weighty rosé, despite the fact that its color seems lighter than previous vintages. It's almost entirely Grenache, with bits of Shiraz (4%), Cabernet Sauvignon (2%) and Dolcetto (1%) filling out the blend. Hints of berries, ripe melon and white chocolate end on a mouthwatering citrus note, but this is built for the beefy side of your grilling menu.
title: Turkey Flat 2014 Rosé (Barossa Valley)

description: Made from Roussanne and Grenache Blanc, this is an undeniably delicious, rather sweet white wine. This is so huge in orange, guava and nectarine flavors, but it's also a bit high in alcohol, which gives it a jalapeño-like heat.
title: Adelaida 2010 The Glenrose Vineyard Version White (Paso Robles)

description: Lots of ripe raspberry, strawberry and lime flavors are found in this sweetish blush bubbly. It's brisk in acidity, with a nice doughiness, although it could be smoother.
title: Chandon NV Étoile Rosé Sparkling (North Coast)

description: This estate-grown Syrah brings forward red fruits and a wash of chocolaty barrel, simple, round and appealing.
title: Melrose 2006 Syrah (Umpqua Valley)

description: The price of this entry-level cuvée has crept up over the years, but it remains a very good wine at a realistic price point. Crushed stone on the nose leads into dusty cherry flavors with hints of garrigue. Medium-bodied yet refreshing on the finish. Drink now and over the next 6–9 months.
title: E. Guigal 2010 Rosé (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A light-colored rosé, this is fresh, soft and fruity. It has attractive raspberry and flaked apple flavors, with well-integrated acidity. It makes a good apéritif style of Champagne with its gentle, warm aftertaste.
title: Henri Abele NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Champagne producers pick Pinot Noir for sparkling wines less than fully ripe. In this wine, there are some attractive yeasty, bread-dough aromas, but it shows too many of the green herbal and stemmy flavors of unripe Pinot.
title: Laurent-Perrier NV Cuvée Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This grower in Aÿ on the Montagne de Reims has produced a rich style of rosé. It emphasizes red fruit, soft acidity and creamy texture. Ripe and full, it's ready to drink.
title: Brimoncourt NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Like a Beaujolais Nouveau, this is a lively, grapey wine, with fresh-from-the-fermenter flavors of raspberries, red cherries, cinnamon and pepper.
title: Frog's Leap 2008 La Grenouille Rouganté Rosé (Napa Valley)

description: With light flavors of ripe red fruits balanced by fresh acidity, this rosé sparkler is full in the mouth and deliciously fruity. A lively mousse gives lift to the fresh aftertaste.
title: Domaine Rolet Père et Fils NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant de Jura)

description: A blend of two local grapes, Niellucciu and Sciaccerellu, this wine is pale—almost white in color. It has delicious crisp acidity, a light texture and a fine, perfumed aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Les Vins Bréban 2016 Alivetto Rosé (Ile de Beauté)

description: One of a range of wines produced by the Bordeaux-based Despagne family, this is a blend of Bordeaux grape varieties. It's attractive and fruity, with crisp red currant notes and a refreshing layer of acidity. Drink now.
title: Vignobles Despagne 2016 Le Mythe d'Amphorie Rosé (Vin de France)

description: Electric pink in color, this wine brings pungent notes of flowers, green herbs, peach and lychee. It drinks off dry, with grapefruit, lychee and stone-fruit flavors that linger on the finish.
title: Eufloria NV Aromatic Rosé (Washington)

description: This assertive wine is one of the few rosés made from this bold grape variety. It has a medium red coppper color and vivid, tart cherry and rhubarb flavors. Meaty, spicy accents emerge on the finish, so it will add a little drama to any meal.
title: Theopolis 2014 Rosé (Yorkville Highlands)

description: A terrific California blush wine, rich and compelling, with a gorgeous color, sort of a salmon-koi gold. It's bone dry and crisply clean in acidity, with strong, but not heavy, flavors of strawberries and raspberries. There's a dusting of tannins that give the wine a solid structure.
title: Lynmar 2009 Rose of Pinot Noir Rosé (Russian River Valley)

description: Hints of overripe peach and mealy apple indicate a rich, ripe style of rosé, but are immediately followed by accents of green melon, plum and menthol, adding balance and tension. Medium weight, with ample acidity that keeps the ripe fruit flavors balanced and refreshing through the finish.
title: Pierre Qui Roule 2012 Rolling Stone Grenache Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Although this is almost red in color and entering its twilight, it's not bad for $8. Dusty berry aromas lead to a semifull palate with raspberry, cherry and plum flavors that end in chewy dryness.
title: Finca El Origen 2011 Malbec Rosé (Mendoza)

description: Plum and cherry aromas seem a touch oxidized. The palate holds it together but doesn't offer much, while flavors of chunky berry and plum are hollow and show additional oxidation. Like many inexpensive 2011 rosés, this is past its prime.
title: Bodegas Ontañón 2011 Mediel Rosé (Navarra)

description: There's a respectably complex nose on this pink wine, with lemonade and pressed plums blending into a wet cement minerality. The palate is very tasty, with flavors of pomegranate, dried rose petals, hibiscus, night jasmine and even a clove-laced mocha element proving quite intriguing.
title: HammerSky 2013 Rosé (Paso Robles)

description: Aromatic and drinking at its peak, this remains fresh, tart and tangy, with palate-penetrating boysenberry and blueberry fruit. Think Lemberger meets Pinot Noir and you have a sense of it, albeit with a slightly rustic edge.
title: Melrose 2010 Baco Noir (Umpqua Valley)

description: Made by the Pauillac cooperative, this is a pleasant, lightweight wine, a surprise considering the vintage. There are black currant flavors, but the wood element is too dominant for the fruit.
title: La Rose de Pauillac 2003  Pauillac

description: Informal and bright, this cheerful Prosecco offers subtle aromas of white flower and citrus with broader background notes of pear and dried hay. The bubbly wine shows easy, but sharp and refreshing perlage.
title: Gionelli NV  Prosecco

description: To call this rosé deep is an understatement. In color and body, it's almost a red wine. But it does have the silky delicacy of a blush wine, and is frankly delicious in cherry jam, red licorice and Dr. Pepper flavors. It finishes thoroughly dry, and the acidity is racy.
title: Isabel Mondavi 2011 Deep Rosé of Cabernet Sauvignon Rosé (Napa Valley)

description: This gets going with clean, light cherry and berry aromas that bring a citrus note to the fore. It feels crisp, dry and pure, with citrus, plum and dust flavors. An elegant rosé made from the Trepat grape, it finishes dry and spicy, with ample leftover fruit.
title: Mont Marçal 2009 Rosado Brut Sparkling (Cava)

description: Winemaker Hank Beckmeyer presses Syrah and Mourvèdre to make this rosé, hoping that in the process he'll best preserve the wine's aromas and also keep it tasting fresh. He's created a nutty wine that's dominant in strawberry and stone fruit flavors. It's very light and dry, leaving you with the impression of having just bitten into a piece of watermelon.
title: La Clarine Farm 2011 Syrah-Mourvèdre Rosé (Sierra Foothills)

description: Touches of caramel and bright red cherry fruit give this pink-colored wine a great lift. It's as fresh as possible for summer drinking.
title: Quinta da Alorna 2010 Rosé Touriga Nacional (Tejo)

description: Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend gives flavors of red cherry and some sweetness, the acidity missing that extra zing. It is soft, ripe, finishing gently.
title: Domaines de Provence 2010 Abbaye Sainte-Hilaire Tentation Rosé (Vin de Pays Var)

description: Aroma of red berry, pressed purple flower and a whiff of tilled earth lead the nose. The refreshing palate offers crushed blackberry and pomegranate alongside tangy acidity.
title: Masciarelli 2015 Villa Gemma  (Cerasuolo d'Abruzzo)

description: With up to seven years' bottle aging, this is at a fine point between crispness and a fuller, more mature style. It is ripe with red fruits, cut with acidity and a hint of toastiness. Drink now.
title: Jean de la Fontaine NV La Flatteuse Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Aromas of ripe pear and green apple follow over to the rich creamy palate along with notes of nectarine and glazed lemon drop. Bright acidity provides freshness while a soft mousse lends finesse.
title: Mionetto NV Luxury Dry  (Prosecco Superiore di Cartizze)

description: Made with organically farmed grapes, this opens with alluring scents of honeysuckle, hawthorn and white stone fruit. The silky palate delivers white peach, nectarine and green apple framed in bright acidity and a delicately foaming mousse.
title: Perlage 2016 Col di Manza Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Delicate, enticing scents of white stone fruit and spring flower drift out of the glass. Bright and creamy, the refreshing palate doles out green apple, white peach and lemon zest set against lively acidity and a silky mousse.
title: Spagnol 2016 Col de Sas Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Fermented in the bottle, this opens with inviting aromas of baked bread, citrus and orchard fruit. The dry linear palate delivers lime, green apple and mineral alongside refreshing acidity and a refined perlage. It closes crisp and clean.
title: Bellenda 2015 Rive di Carpesica Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Lifted cherry, mango and peach aromas lend a slightly candied note to this slightly off-dry rosé made from Cabernet Franc. It's unabashedly juicy and fruity on the palate, but balanced with brisk acidity. A fun, easy-drinking sip.
title: Lucas Vineyards 2012 Dry Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: With its bright pink color and fruity aromas of cherry, strawberry and raspberry, this wine is more good than bad. The palate feels fresh, balanced and juicy, while flavors of plum, cherry and red licorice finish clean.
title: Andeluna 2013 1300 Malbec Rosé (Uco Valley)

description: This blend of Aragonez and Syrah gives a wine that has a ripe crushed-strawberry flavor that is supported by a soft texture and a juicy aftertaste. It is dry, although its ripe fruit gives it a sense of sweetness.
title: Monte da Ravasqueira 2014 Rosé (Alentejano)

description: This is a fun, candy-pink colored wine that is off dry, with a light effervescent prickle on the tongue. It has a tangy character that brings out intense acidity, with crisp red-currant and raspberry flavors. Drink now.
title: Obrigado 2014 Vera Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: This unusual rosé is half Syrah and half Pinot Noir. Sometimes the combo works; here it seems like a mismatch. Tart and simple, it's bone dry and unfocused, with short, thin flavors of watermelon and strawberry that quickly fade.
title: Coeur de Terre 2014 Rustique Rosé (Willamette Valley)

description: This is a pale colored rosé, light and fruity. It has a touch of caramel to go with the ripe strawberry fruitiness. The finish is fresh and crisp. Drink now.
title: DFJ Vinhos 2014 Portada Winemaker's Selection Rosé (Lisboa)

description: Fleshy and lightly oxidized on the nose, this Pinot Noir and Chardonnay sparkler shows a seltzer-like palate with pulse-preserving acidity. The palate brings a mix of peach, yeast, spent lees and oxidized flavors.
title: Domaine Jean Bousquet 2014 Organic Brut Rosé Sparkling (Tupungato)

description: While the wine is clean, it tastes yeasty and heavy despite its low alcohol. There is strawberry fruitiness and final acidity, although the sweetness remains intrusive.
title: Aveleda 2014 Casal Garcia Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: Here is a lightly sweet, fresh wine that has crisp red-currant and raspberry flavors. It's bright, clean and ready to drink now.
title: Casa de Vila Verde 2014 Pluma Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: Wonderfully pure and mellow Red Delicious notes are displayed on the nose, promising pleasure. The palate has an even stronger impression of this vivid fruit as well as a superfine, tender and creamy mousse that counteracts the inherent freshness. This is dry and elegant and brimming with pure apple flavors. The finish is mouth-watering and utterly moreish with its clean long echo of red apple.
title: Domaine Charles Baur NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Creamy and delicious, this elegant off-dry sparkler doles out layers of sweet white peach, yellow apple, pear and a tangy note of candied lemon drop. A silky perlage gives it a smooth polished texture while bright acidity lifts the rich flavors.
title: Nino Franco 2016  Prosecco Superiore di Cartizze

description: This is a plump, medium-bodied rosé at a reasonable price. Pomelo or grapefruit notes combine with stone fruit, then finish stony-dry and tart.
title: La Châsse 2016 Prestige Rosé (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Aromas of grapefruit, orange peel and chewing gum feed into a wide palate with slightly flat acidity. Melon and papaya flavors finish a bit soft, with a note of stone-fruit pit.
title: Larchago 2016 Rosé (Rioja)

description: Passion fruit, kiwi fruit and hints of strawberry mark the nose of this wine. It's strident, intense and a bit one-dimensionally fruity, yet packs a lot of flavor into a refreshing, medium-bodied wine.
title: Les Dauphins 2016 Réserve Rosé (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Some appealing floral highlights rub against flavors of orange crush, cherry soda and toasted cracker. This young wine seems structured for early drinking.
title: Left Coast Cellars 2015 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Willamette Valley)

description: A soft shade of yellow pink, this wine shows red apple, nectarine and a shred of lime rind on the nose. The palate offers slightly sour lime and underripe raspberry flavors as well as a unique and intriguing touch of fresh herbs.
title: Chloe 2015 Rosé (Monterey County)

description: Tangy and textured, this is a wine that needs food. A tannic edge from the Cabernet in the blend gives the wine a tight, bright, refreshing aftertaste.
title: Dourthe 2015 La Grande Cuvée Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: A blend of half and half Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, this is a rounded, full wine. It has plenty of red-berry fruits along with spice, a tight texture and a crisp aftertaste. The wine offers a good reflection of the fruitiness of the year.
title: Château Brown 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Light and fruity, this has touches of spice as well as attractive red-fruit flavors. It is a refreshing, crisp wine—lively and only lightly structured.
title: Château la Moulinière 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Alluring aromas of violet, rose and dark-skinned fruit lead the way on this elegantly structured wine. The firm palate delivers young red cherry, white paper, grilled herb and pipe tobacco alongside fine-grained tannins.
title: Cascina delle Rose 2012 Tre Stelle  (Barbaresco)

description: A lean but crisp mouthfeel characterizes this vintage-dated Prosecco Superiore. The wine shows simple tones of white flower, crushed stone and white almond. The effervescence feels tight and clean.
title: Il Follo 2012 Villa Luigia Millesimato Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Ruio Brut is a simple and clean Prosecco Superiore that offers peach, citrus and crushed mineral. The effervescence is soft and foamy but the finish is dryer than most Italian sparklers from the general Prosecco category.
title: Malibràn 2012 Ruio Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Hints of savory herbs accent pretty peach and blossom aromas in this dry but fruity Merlot rosé. It's elegantly structured, with moderate alcohol and crisp acidity balanced out by a lush, rounded mouthfeel.
title: Palmer 2012 Merlot Rosé (North Fork of Long Island)

description: This elegant bottle (both in terms of content and presentation) would make an excellent option for an aperitivo or could pair with summer salads or seafood lunches. Citrus, drying mineral and honey make for textbook Prosecco perfection.
title: Conte Collalto NV Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Here's a well-focused and sharp Brut sparkler with tart citrus tones followed by white peach, dried sage and crushed white stone. It's an easy-going Prosecco Superiore with a firm, steely quality in the mouth.
title: Foss Marai NV Strada di Guia 109 Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Tightly linked to its territory of origin, this vineyard specific Extra Dry sparkler is fresh and zesty in the mouth with soft perlage and loads of melon and white peach to keep up the momentum.
title: Foss Marai NV Strada di Guia 109 Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This dry Prosecco Superiore opens with easy aromas of peach and white flower followed by sweet cream and fresh lemon or lime. The style dictates a touch of sweetness in the mouth and although this Italian sparkler does deliver that, the wine is light and refreshing overall.
title: Giavi 2012 Prima Volta Millesimato Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Menetou-Salon uses Pinot Noir for its rosés, like nearby Sancerre. The wine is in a fresh, crisp style, emphasizing acidity and red currant. It is light in feel and bright with red-fruit that lingers.
title: Isabelle et Pierre Clément 2015 Châtenoy Rosé (Menetou-Salon)

description: Fruity strawberry flavors lead this ripe and soft wine. It has a crisp side to it, with touches of orange zest. The aftertaste, light and delicate, brings a more mineral edge.
title: Jean-Noël Haton NV Extra Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Extremely fresh and lively aromas of soft strawberry and lime pith combine to make a very racy edge to the nose of this bottling from the pioneering property, which was founded as a bubbly house in the early 1980s. There is great energy to the sip, where somewhat sour flavors of Ruby Red grapefruit rind give the wine lots of acidic length.
title: Laetitia 2014 Brut Rosé Sparkling (Arroyo Grande Valley)

description: A sweet and fizzy wine, this is also tight with acidity and textured with tannins. It has a mineral edge along with the intense crispness that is really too much.
title: Casa de Vila Verde 2015 Pluma Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: This is a sweet, confected wine. It has sugary red fruits and just enough acidity. Made from the Vinhão grape, it is soft and ready to drink.
title: Quinta da Calçada 2015 Portal da Calçada Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: Bright pink in color, this looks and tastes like candy. There is the lightest touch of acidity to at least bring some crispness to this sweet wine.
title: Viniverde 2015 Estreia Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: Generic red berry flavors turn bitter and astringent, while a chemical plastic note marks the final blow.
title: Fall Creek 2015 Grenache Rosé

description: This radiates fragrance and spice: ferns and pepper, yeast and juicy, yellow pear, mirabelle plums and aloe vera. All of this is on both the nose and the palate and is combined in a harmonious, balanced parcel of rounded goodness. It treads a fine line between opulence and freshness but does not stray from its perfect high wire act.
title: Bernhard Ott 2015 Rosenberg Grüner Veltliner (Wagram)

description: This rosé is mouthfilling and round, with ample melon and berry fruit, a sprinkling of dried spices and minimal herb notes. It actually drinks almost like a red wine for its weight and berry-scented richness, but remains refreshing on the long, mouthwatering finish. Drink now.
title: Château de Ségriès 2015  Tavel

description: The vineyard-designated Grenache grapes are given a whole-berry press before fermenting in stainless steel, encouraging the lithe strawberry and watermelon essence of this wine to sing unabashedly, adorned by supporting minerality and an overall lightness of being. This is a lovely sipper for all manner of moments.
title: Kokomo 2014 Pauline's Vineyard Grenache Rosé (Dry Creek Valley)

description: Lightly pink in color with a hint of orange, this bottling, which includes 20% Grenache Blanc, shows rose petals and a touch of watermelon shaved ice on the shy nose. The palate is very steely, reserved and tense, with only hints of light strawberry emerging. The wine is more about texture than flavor.
title: J. Lohr 2015 Gesture Rose of Grenache (Paso Robles)

description: This is an attractive blend of Braucol and Syrah which gives a ripe spicy wine. Red-berry flavors dominate with a rich texture and light acidity. The wine is perfumed and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Rotier 2015 Les Gravels Rosé (Gaillac)

description: Full-bodied red fruits typify this deep magenta rosé from Thema. The palate offers ripe flavors with a spicy finish. Good with fuller-bodied fish or poultry dishes.
title: Ktima Pavlidis 2015 Thema Rosé (Drama)

description: The purest scent of fresh, ripe red cherries is the first pleasure to be encountered on this elegant wine. On the slender palate this lovely fruit expression is joined by earthier tones of undergrowth and peat. There is a central seam of freshness that pulls fruit, silky tannin and soft texture together. If there was just one attribute I could name it would be elegance. Lovely and fresh now but Rosenberg ages most gracefully. Drink 2016–2024.
title: Pittnauer 2013 Rosenberg St. Laurent (Burgenland)

description: This wine comes from one of Côtes de Provence historic cru classé estates. It is a ripe and smooth wine with crisp acidity and a fine bite of spice. The wine is packed with red fruits and finished with refreshing acidity.
title: Fabre en Provence 2016 Château de la Clapière Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A touch of strawberry streaks through this wine's lemon scent. The palate is slender, easy and fresh, making for an uncomplicated summer drink with a dry, taut finish.
title: Familie Zull 2016 Lust & Laune Rosé (Niederösterreich)

description: Fruity, crisp with red-currant and citrus flavors, this is a bright, vivacious wine. There is a tight mineral edge that contrasts with the fruitiness and turns this into a food friendly wine. Drink now.
title: Vignobles Raymond 2016 Elodie Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Despite a pale hue and only 12.5% abv, this is a fairly weighty wine on the palate. It's dry and silky in texture, with hints of mossy forest-floor complexity to go along with pear and melon fruit.
title: Wither Hills 2015 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Marlborough)

description: Whiffs of tea leaves and tobacco lend earthiness to this slightly savory but exotic appealing rosé. There's plenty of red-cherry and raspberry flavor, but it's slightly muted, embraced in shrouds of Cabernet Franc's brambly leafy character. It's a unique, full-bodied rosé to try over dinner with poultry or other white meats.
title: Adirondack Winery 2015 Island Sunset Cabernet Franc Rosé (New York)

description: From an estate close to Saint-Tropez, this wine brings plenty of sun and richness to an attractive tangy texture. It has a crisp peppery edge as well as bright acidity and a smooth, ripe aftertaste. It is ready to drink now.
title: Barton & Guestier 2016 La Villa Barton Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This pale pink wine presents light apricot and wet cement aromas. The palate sizzles with acidity, carrying citrus peel and earthy, clay-like flavors. It lacks only for a bit more fruit.
title: Center of Effort 2016 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Edna Valley)

description: The proximity of the vineyard to the sea gives this wine an almost salty, certainly tangy character. It also brings out acidity and a cool fruitiness. The wine is ripe, poised and balanced with a crisp edge of final acidity. Drink now.
title: Château du Carrubier 2016 Cuvée de Clara Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: For the vintage, this is a rich wine. It has spice, an herbal edge and a touch of pepper. Its red fruits are superripe with a bitter bite that masks the acidity. Let this settle for a few months and drink from 2018.
title: Château Maupague 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: This is the estate wine from this property named after the stag that was hunted by the French King Francis I in the 16th century. It is softly fruity with a balance between the ripe raspberry fruit and light acidity. Drink this summer.
title: Château Pas du Cerf 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A rounded style of rosé, this is ripe and soft, with acidity cushioned by the rich red fruits. The aftertaste with its lemon-zest touch makes this wine refreshing.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2015 Cuvée Spéciale Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: From clay and limestone soil, this wine is full bodied. It has both spice and a tight, nervy, mineral texture. Rich with a full mouthful of raspberry and red-currant fruits, it has a refreshing aftertaste.
title: Domaine du Dragon 2015 Grande Cuvée Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: From vineyards close to Saint-Tropez on the Mediterranean coast, this wine has swathes of ripe, sunny fruits with just a hint of cooler breezes to bring out the acidity. It's an immediately attractive, fruity wine, refreshing and packed with orange and raspberry flavors.
title: Domaine Sainte-Marie 2015 VieVité Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Named after the mother of the current grower, this wine is a Rhône-like blend of Syrah and Grenache. The result is a fresh wine with an edge of tannins that give it structure. A ripe wine, it has also preserved its crisp, bright fruitiness.
title: Domaine Terre de Mistral 2015 Simone Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Produced from organically grown grapes, this wine is full of fragrant, clean red-fruit flavors. It is ripe and full bodied—perhaps too full-bodied for a really fresh rosé. It does have all the fruit, generous and with a soft aftertaste.
title: Vignerons de Correns 2015 Croix de Basson Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Subdued lemon and forest fruit back up the bright, blush colour of this fruitful, almost fleshy rosé. While this is an easy-drinking party wine, it nonetheless finishes with real freshness and leaves you utterly quenched.
title: Weixelbaum 2015 Strassertaler Rosé (Niederösterreich)

description: Made entirely with Pinot Nero, this opens with delicate aromas of woodland berry, apple, Alpine herb and a whiff of bread crust. The creamy palate offers cherry, strawberry, candied nectarine zest and a note of baking spice alongside a soft, persistent perlage.
title: Cesarini Sforza 2009 Tridentum Rosé Metodo Classico Pinot Nero (Trento)

description: This is a concentrated, full-bodied wine, full of sweeps of red fruits that are beautifully balanced by the citrus acidity. It is an appealing Champagne to drink now, although with its youthful acidity it will age into a ripe, mellow wine.
title: Lallier NV Grand Rosé Grand Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: There are sweet-tasting notes of wild berry and raspberry at the front of this wine, followed by fresh touches of white flower and lemon blossom. Those feminine aromas are enhanced by an impression of soft sweetness.
title: Vigneti del Vulture 2011 Pipoli Rosato (Basilicata)

description: Made from Malbec, this is a ripe, tangy wine. It is dry and fresh, crisp with acidity and red currant fruits. There is a round, smooth aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Pelvillain Frères 2014 Albatros Rosé (Côtes du Lot)

description: A bright strawberry-flavored wine, this is fruity and fresh. It has crisp acidity to lift the fruit and a light pepper touch that adds interest and turns it into a fine food-friendly wine. It is ready to drink now.
title: Quinta da Alorna 2015 Rosé (Tejo)

description: Notes of rubber and matchbook are about all that stand out on the nose of this rosé of Pinot Noir. A harmless-feeling palate tastes snappy but generic, with hints of citrus and tropical fruits but nothing specific.
title: Quintay 2015 Clava Reserve Pinot Noir Rosé (Casablanca Valley)

description: This rusty colored rosado is flat and neutral on the nose. In the mouth, it's full but also flabby, while slightly bitter stone-fruit and melon flavors finish long but with a lashing of bitterness and burn.
title: Vivanco 2014 Rosado (Rioja)

description: A mostly neutral nose is devoid of fruit aromas and instead offers dusty notes of crushed rocks. This is a heavy rosé made from Garnacha, Syrah and Carignan. It's rather bitter and miserly in terms of fruit flavor, with a peppercorn finish.
title: Celler Bàrbara Forés 2014 Rosat Rosé (Terra Alta)

description: While a bit quiet on the nose, watermelon, white-peach and raspberry flavors explode on the palate of this lovely dry rosé. It's exuberantly fruity but neatly balanced, offering spry acidity and a long, floral finish.
title: Hosmer 2016 Dry Cabernet Franc Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: A deeper salmon color with elegantly lacy bubbles and a slight cloudy appearance, this sparkler by Norm Yost offers dessicated watermelon, dried orange blossoms, yeast, citrus rinds and fresher strawberry notes on the nose. Tart raspberry and yeasty melon show on the palate, which offers a salty component as well as a surprising but nice amount of grip.
title: Goat Bubbles 2013 Solomon Hills Vineyard Rosé Sparkling (Santa Maria Valley)

description: A subtle nose of strawberry and honey, followed by elegant but cheerful fruit flavors, makes this a fun everyday rosé. Acidity and a clean finish give it food-friendly panache. Not complex, but easy to like.
title: Chaddsford 2007 Rosé Chambourcin (Pennsylvania)

description: A heavy, full-bodied rosé with ripe, intense fruit flavors marred by a touch of nail-polish remover on the nose. It's still a decent drink with burgers, but it could have been so much better.
title: Château Vessière 2007 Rosé Grenache-Syrah (Costières de Nîmes)

description: Compact berry and plum aromas set up a solid, nice palate with nectarine and raspberry flavors. This is very drinkable and easygoing; the finish is mellow but propped up by core acidity.
title: Dinastía Vivanco 2013 Tempranillo-Garnacha Rosé (Rioja)

description: An ambitious and successful rosé made from 50% Gamay Noir and 50% Grenache, this light yellow-pink wine offers inviting pink grapefruit skin, Gala apple and green pear on the nose. The palate shows the tiniest bit of sweetness, which makes the Pink Lady apple and tangerine-led citrus notes all the more delicious. Beware: this goes down all too easy.
title: Joyce 2015 Rosé (Monterey)

description: This is an extremely fresh and thirst-quenching Rosé Pinot Grigio with delicate hues of pink and peach. The wine offers aromas of citrus and pink rose, a lean structure and lively acidity.
title: San Giuseppe 2008 Rosé Pinot Grigio (Veneto)

description: Here's an easy-going Nerello Mascalese-based rosé from Mt. Etna that offers piquant aromas of chopped mint, forest berry, gooseberry and cassis. The wine would pair well on informal occasions around a heaping bowl of fish soup.
title: Scilio 2008 Rosato Nerello Mascalese (Etna)

description: Here's a delicate-smelling Prosecco Cartizze with subdued tones of stone fruit and white mineral over a sweet, creamy filling. Soda-like intensity in terms of its effervescence crackles and fizzes in the mouth and keeps the palate refreshed.
title: Adami NV  Prosecco Superiore di Cartizze

description: Crede is a top-notch Prosecco Brut (with 10% Pinot Bianco and 5% Verdiso added to the blend for extra structure and crispness respectively) that offers generous fresh fruit tones followed by almond blossom, macadamia nut and Golden Delicious apple. The mouthfeel is streamlined and crisp with a creamy, frothy finish.
title: Bisol NV Crede  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: Mandrarossa is the flagship wine of the all-women team at Bortolomiol. This Extra Dry style strikes a perfect balance between fruit and floral sweetness and cleansing acidity. Serve this beautiful wine at cocktail hour.
title: Bortolomiol 2009 Bandarossa Millesimato Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Here's an Italian sparkling rosé with a peachy-pink color and a wide aromatic offering that includes hints of clove, peach, melon and toasted nut. The wine is smooth and slightly soft although those piquant bubbles give it a sharper edge.
title: Quadra NV Rosé Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: Cranberry, peach, raspberry and fresh fruit tones characterize this luminous rosé sparkler. The wine boasts persistent perlage and very good intensity of flavors and length.
title: Berlucchi NV Cellarius Rosé Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: Here's a very rich, full-bodied blush bubbly that really satisfies for sheer deliciousness. A blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, its creamy texture holds flavors of limes, raspberries, vanilla and yeasty lees. The price is not inexpensive, but it's a good value in a sparkling wine of this quality. From Schramsberg.
title: Mirabelle NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (North Coast)

description: You can't beat the price-versus-quality ratio of this lovely sparkling rosé from northern Italy. The wine is intensely fragrant and offers enduring tones of peach, almond and yeast. It has cooling freshness and a touch of spice on the finish.
title: Rotari NV Rosé Brut Talento Sparkling (Trento)

description: A delicate bouquet of white flower and talc powder gives this vineyard-designate Prosecco Superiore a very clean, sharp and fresh first impression. That enormous focus continues to the palate where the wine's fresh acidity and tight perlage does a great job of refreshing the mouth.
designation: Rive di San Pietro di Barbozza Millesimato Brut
title: Mionetto 2011 Rive di San Pietro di Barbozza Millesimato Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: A good rosé, crisp and light-bodied. It has rich strawberry, orange zest, vanilla and spice flavors. Nice and silky in the mouth, as a blush wine should be, but it's a little on the sweet side.
title: Birichino 2012 Vin Gris Rosé (California)

description: A pinkish copper color, light cherry and raspberry flavors and a smooth, rounded mouth-feel make this full-bodied wine easy to sip and enjoy.
title: Julietta 2015 Romeo's Rosé (California)

description: Relatively rich in character, with toast and yeast flavors offering a contrast to the more tropical fruit flavors. There is dry spice and finely balanced acidity that offer a further dimension to this full-bodied wine.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2010 Cuvée Spéciale Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Whiffs of brambly raspberry and fresh watermelon introduce this ripe full-bodied rosé made from almost equal proportions of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. It's moderately concentrated in red-fruit flavors but boasts bright acidity and a refreshing clean finish.
title: Heron Hill 2016 Eclipse Rosé (New York)

description: Ruby red in the glass, this bottling shows bright cranberry and boysenberry on the nose with a hint of rose petals. There is decent tension to the sip, where tart plum skins meet with graphite flavors.
title: Kessler-Haak 2016 Rose of Syrah (Sta. Rita Hills)

description: Whiffs of vanilla and strawberry entice on the nose of this full-bodied rosé made from a blend of Syrah, Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon. It's not a deeply concentrated wine but offers delicate shades of crisp red cherry and strawberry along with refreshing acidity.
title: Kontokosta 2016 Rosé (North Fork of Long Island)

description: A slightly orange shade of pink, this rosé offers faded notes of strawberry, cooked plum, melon and orange peel on the nose. The palate mingles light, tart red fruit and fresh citrus.
title: Orfila 2016 Rose of Pinot Noir (Santa Maria Valley)

description: It displays a very pretty pink color, but that's the showiest side of a rather reserved wine. The nose smells slightly of rosebush and the palate is a bit watery, with some stone fruit and noticeable tension.
title: Vino Vargas 2013 Costa Rosa Rosé (Paso Robles)

description: A concentrated and toasty raspberry flavor permeates the light- to medium-bodied palate, which is endowed with crisp acids.
title: Sutcliffe 2012 Rosé (Colorado)

description: This wine is so soft, gently fruity and easy to drink, but without much character or freshness. It's a gentle ramble that takes no effort.
title: DFJ Vinhos 2013 Portada Rosé (Lisboa)

description: This wine is fresh, with plenty of acidity. It also has delicious raspberry fruits, the ripeness well integrated into the wine. For immediate drinking.
title: Adega Cooperativa Ponte de Barca 2013 Hera Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: Aromas suggest pink watermelon and bubble gum ester, with an intriguing twist of licorice. It's high and tight on the palate with pink lemonade-driven acidity, offering strawberry fruit in the midpalate and more bubble gum on the finish.
title: Zaca Mesa 2014 Z Gris Rosé (Santa Ynez Valley)

description: This Prosecco Brut seems disjointed and unfocused because of the piquant soda and sharp citrus notes that define it. There's a touch of matchstick in there as well—that blows off eventually—yet the sparkler never fully recovers.
title: Carmina NV Brut  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: Raspberry and peach describe this sparkler's color and also its aromatic characteristics. There's a slightly oxidized note at the back that recalls almond or candied fruit.
title: Tenuta Santomè NV Santhomas Rosato Brut Sparkling (Veneto)

description: This wine is a very appealing pale bronze color with a light peach tinge. It brings bountiful aromas of wet rock, mountain strawberry and herb that lead to a dry, broad, flavorful palate, with mouthwatering fruit and stone flavors.
title: Cayuse 2015 Edith Grenache Rosé (Walla Walla Valley (OR))

description: A pretty shade of pale pink, this dry and spicy rosé has a boisterous personality. Its watermelon and strawberry flavors come with a kick, showing real depth. Juicy acidity keeps it fresh and forward.
title: Elizabeth Chambers 2016 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Willamette Valley)

description: Made from Cinsault grapes, this is a reductive, salty and somewhat intense wine at first, that settles nicely into developed flavors of ripe strawberry, peach and vanilla. With substantive weight and breadth, it offers a pleasing texture and body without ever getting bogged down. This is a fine wine for the table.
title: VGS Chateau Potelle 2016 Riviera Rosé (Sonoma County)

description: Very fruity, this is a ripe Merlot-dominated rosé with some Cabernet Franc. It is rounded, smooth, soft at the end with bright and crisp acidity. Wild strawberries and a rich aftertaste give extra weight.
title: Closerie du Bailli 2013 Tradition Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: An off-dry blend of Grolleau and Gamay, it's crisp and attractively fruity. Strawberries dominate this fresh and aromatic wine. It's a great rosé to drink now.
title: La Grille 2013  Rosé d'Anjou

description: This is a medium sweet rosé, fresh while having a riper core character. It's a fruity, lightly spicy and caramel flavored, with acidity and sweetness coming through strongly to finish.
title: Musset-Roullier 2013 L'Esquisse  (Cabernet d'Anjou)

description: Almost neutral aromas of cantaloupe and nectarine are dusty on the nose. This Carmenère-based dry rosé is citric, juicy and tight on the palate, with grapefruit and other citrus flavors adding life. Orange and citrus pith notes control the finish.
title: Apaltagua 2014 Carmenere Rosé (Central Valley)

description: Mellow peach and nectarine aromas come with a dusting of talcum powder. On the palate, this is citric and lemony, while a jumble of orange and stone-fruit flavors finish clean and crisp. Overall this is fine but undistinguished.
title: CVNE 2014 Viña Real Rosado (Rioja)

description: This bold and fruity rosé carries scents and flavors of cherry candy. It's a fine bottle for chilling and sharing with summer picnic foods.
title: Del Rio 2014 Rosé (Rogue Valley)

description: Adam Lee makes some concentrated wines each vintage, and this one shows cherry syrup, sandalwood and some smoke on the dense, layered nose. The palate is similarly deep, rich and complex, with tangy cherry, mulberry, dried ginger and mace flavoring, rising into a chorus of camphor on the finish.
title: Siduri 2014 Rosella's Vineyard Pinot Noir (Santa Lucia Highlands)

description: Nothing more than cherry soda aromas to get it going. It's highly confected, with decent acidity its only saving grace.
title: Finca Sophenia 2007 Altosur Rosé Malbec (Tupungato)

description: Strangely colored, with oyster shell aromas and weird orange-influenced flavors. Not exactly sweet but not dry either, this is borderline wine made from Cabernet and Malbec. Imported by North American Beverage Group.
title: Domaine Jean Bousquet 2007 Rosé Malbec-Cabernet Sauvignon (Tupungato)

description: This is a no-fussy, watery wine from the Forlì area of Italy (located on the Adriatic flank of the peninsula) that does a good job of washing down informal foods and keeping your palate refreshed. Its measured aromas include dried hay, soft yellow fruit with some nutty tones in the background for additional dimension. The mouthfeel is quick and lean.
title: Drei Donà Tenuta La Palazza 2006 Vigneti delle Rosenere Blanc d'R White (Emilia-Romagna)

description: The mountains rise quickly behind the French Riviera. They are the origin of this wine. It has an attractive cool feel, while keeping plenty of fruit and a ripe caramel character. It is bright with plenty of acidity at the end. Drink now.
title: Les Vins Bréban 2016 Les Hauts Plateaux Rosé

description: Made by a Rhône-based winery, this wine is smooth and ripe. It has generous strawberry and light spice flavors along with a rounded aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Louis Bernard 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This soft wine is easy and open. It has generous fruits and gentle acidity. The result is a smooth wine that is ready to drink now.
title: Bailli de Provence 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Fruity, floral aromas set the stage for rich watermelon and plum flavors in this medium-pink colored wine. The texture is soft, with a slight sweet-fruit flavor on the close.
title: Barra 2016 Estate Grown Rosé (Mendocino)

description: This is an attractive, fruity wine. It has a soft character from the ripe red-fruit flavors that are well balanced with herbal acidity and a crisp aftertaste. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château Maupague 2016 Cabaret Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Laced with really crisp fruits and red-currant flavors, this is a brightly fruity wine. Lively and with a tight texture, this is ready to drink.
title: Les Vins Bréban 2016 Villa Aix en Provence Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Light, bright and packed with delicious fruit, this is a refreshing, immediately drinkable wine. It has raspberry flavors and a crisp aftertaste that are all part of the fruity package.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2016 Gouleyant Malbec Rosé (Côtes du Lot)

description: This is a fruit-driven, medium-bodied rosé of Grenache (60%) and Mourvèdre (40%). While not the most complex rosé, the yellow-fleshed, red-skinned plum flavors are potent, lingering on the mouthwatering finish.
title: Château Signac 2013 Cuvée Dona Clara Chusclan Rosé (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: Raspberry and cherry aromas introduce this pink-tinted rosé. A chewy, full palate feels round and balanced, while flavors of briny berry and cherry finish bouncy and good, with a touch of residual sweetness. Drink now.
title: Inurrieta 2013 Mediodía Rosado (Navarra)

description: Peach, melon and brown sugar aromas make for a pleasant and full bouquet. This is plump and healthy on the tongue, with fleshy peach tones that finish dusty, round and a touch sweet in flavor. Drink now.
title: Borsao 2013 Rosé (Campo de Borja)

description: High acidity marks this wine, giving it a crisp character with subdued fruitiness. That should change over the next few months, so drink from late 2017.
title: Château la Verrière 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: With just a hint of a pink color, this is a crisp and fruity wine. Citrus, tangerine and lemon flavors carry a light touch of red currants. Drink this bright wine now.
title: Château Roquefort 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Soft, ripe and fruity, this lightly spicy wine is full of red fruits and crisp acidity. It balances between the fruit and the tangy, textured aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château Tassin 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Deep blush in the glass, this wine has aromas of white peach and rose petal. It is full in the mouth, with flavors of nectarine, clementine and lavender. Soft floral notes enhance the bright finish.
title: Schuchmann Wines 2015 Compass Rosé (Kakheti)

description: Fruity and fresh, this has aromas of red berry and pomegranate. The scents flow through to the easygoing palate along with raspberry and bright acidity.
title: Tenute Orestiadi 2016 Molino a Vento Rosato (Terre Siciliane)

description: This rich wine has plenty of spicy fruit and a tangy texture. With attractive nutmeg flavors and light touch of tannin, it's definitely a food wine. Drink now.
title: Château de Bonhoste 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This ripe and fruity wine is soft, rich and full of red berry fruit. Its acidity and tangy texture combine with the fruitiness to give a full, smooth-textured sip. Drink now.
title: Clos Alivu 2016 Rosé (Patrimonio)

description: With ripe fruit and caramel aromas, this is a rich wine (40% Grenache, 40% Syrah, 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Cinsault). The second rosé of Château Vignelaure, it's full of sunshine, with rich red berry flavors that are given a larger character by the touch of vanilla that makes it food-friendly.
title: Château Vignelaure 2014 La Source de Vignelaure Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This structured red opens with aromas of plum, underbrush, exotic spice and coffee. The palate offers black cherry, vanilla, toasted oak, anisette and espresso alongside bracing tannins that dry out the finish.
title: Trerose 2010 Simposio  (Vino Nobile di Montepulciano)

description: This beautifully balanced wine shows rich red fruits as well as crisp freshness. It has a mineral texture, aromatic fruitiness and a lightly peppery aftertaste. The blend is 40% Grenache, 40% Cinsault and 20% Syrah. Drink now.
title: Hecht & Bannier 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Light tones of citrus and peach color an easy Brut Prosecco Superiore that would work nicely with barbecue shrimp in sesame sauce. The acidity in this light sparkler keeps the palate clean.
title: Cà Vittoria NV Costa dei Peschi Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Simple lines of citrus and white flower define the one dimensional bouquet of this fresh and friendly Italian sparkler. The wine shows sharp, lively appeal with balanced acidity that feels fresh and bright in the mouth.
title: Colesel NV Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This simple Extra Dry Prosecco Superiore opens with peach, nectarine, simple lines and a watery mouthfeel. The sparkler's momentum is achieved mostly by the creaminess of its bubbles.
title: Terra Serena NV Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Talc powder and white pepper appear at first and the bouquet opens to include additional layers of citrus and stone fruit. The perlage is sharp and toned.
title: Terre di San Venanzio Fortunato NV Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This is a simple and fresh Italian sparkler that offers white flower and peach backed by citrus and almond. A touch of soft sweetness adds a chewy spot that is followed by creamy mousse.
title: Terre di San Venanzio Fortunato NV Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: There's a ripe, waxy quality to this wine that recalls apricot and honey. The fruit flavors are ripe and soft, with a smooth feel to the palate that is enhanced by the wine's natural acidity and its bright effervescence.
title: Perlage 2012 Animae Brut Millesimato  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Moondrops opens with aromas of cut grass and citrus followed by background tones of peach and melon. Sweet fruit and soft, creamy effervescence appear on the finish.
designation: Gocce di Luna Moondrops Extra Dry
title: Anna Spinato NV Gocce di Luna Moondrops Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: A little on the sweet side, but nicely crisp in acidity. The flavors offer generous notes of strawberries, orange zest, sugared tea,  vanilla and cinnamon.
title: Balletto 2012 Estate Rosé of Pinot Noir Rosé (Russian River Valley)

description: From a multitude of vintages, blending 59% Pinot Noir and 41% Chardonnay, this is a dry, high-acid wine mixing earthy flavors of cranberry, grapefruit and forest atop a thick mousse and long finish.
title: Longboard NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Russian River Valley)

description: Aromas of cranberry and berry are fresh and juicy. The flavors are tart and supple, showing depth and length. It's delicious in its own right but will shine on the dinner table.
title: Wind Rose 2012 Barbera (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Surprisingly lithe for a Napa rosé that's made from Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc. It's pretty dark in color, but feels fresh and clean, with penetrating raspberry jam, red currant and vanilla flavors. You could drink this on a hot summer evening with barbecued steak.
title: Blackbird Vineyards 2012 Arriviste Rosé (Napa Valley)

description: Some Pinot Noir rosés can be heavy, but this one's as light as silk. With a briskly tart, creamy texture framing strawberry and date nut candy flavors, it's an absolute delight.
title: J Vineyards & Winery 2012 Vin Gris Rosé of Pinot Noir (Russian River Valley)

description: The nose on this pink-tinted rosé is mostly fresh, with hints of talcum powder and strawberry. The palate is starting to fade a bit, with heft and grabbiness setting in. Cherry is the key flavor, while the finish is weighty. Drink immediately or wait for the 2013.
title: CVNE 2012 Cune Rosado Rosé (Rioja)

description: This blush tastes like a peaches-and-cream soda, with hints of strawberries and vanilla. It's soft and mellow, with a honeyed finish.
title: Denier-Handal 2012 Syrah Rosé (Alexander Valley)

description: A deep pink hue, this boasts aromas of chalk and mineral that accent the red berry and melon core. Flavors of red plum and cherry flesh unfold on the palate, but turn crisp and lifted on the close.
title: Goats do Roam Wine Co. 2013 Rosé (Coastal Region)

description: Whiffs of bramble and earth lend a savory tone to fresh red berry and apple flavors in this dry-style rosé. It's brisk with acidity and refreshingly quaffable.
title: Keuka Spring 2013 Wiltberger Vineyard Field Blend Dry Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: This immediately attractive fruity wine does everything a dry, fresh rosé should. With bright fruits, layered acidity and richness, it is very ready to drink with food.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2013 Saint-Roch les Vignes Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: Very rich, this perfumed wine has considerable weight. It is powerful, perhaps too powerful, and its dense fruits and structure don't fit the norm of Provence rosés.
title: Château Roubine 2013 Inspire Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Confusingly, in the world of Champagne, Extra Dry means slightly sweet. So this pale colored rosé is soft, treading a fine line between bright acidity and a riper, confected character. That sweetness is well integrated, though, in keeping with the crisp Gosset style. It's ready to drink.
title: Gosset NV Petite Douceur Rosé Extra Dry  (Champagne)

description: With vines in the Grand Cru village of Bouzy, this producer has a fine palette at its disposal. The rosé—crisp with Chardonnay yet bolstered with rich Pinot Noir—is full bodied and packed with raspberry and red currant fruit. Still young, it's lively with acidity and exuberant fruitiness. Drink from 2018.
designation: Cuvée Rosé Bouzy Grand Cru Brut
title: Camille Savès NV Cuvée Rosé Bouzy Grand Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: A heavy, sweet rosé, this is made from Mourvèdre, Cinsault and Grenache. The flavors are of raspberries, vanilla and toast.
title: Adelaida 2011 Version Rosé (Paso Robles)

description: This is so intense and fruit forward, the aromas are almost like those of Fruit Roll-Ups. Notes of strawberry, raspberry and peach abound on the nose and palate, with good acidic lift that just balances all of that fruity sweetness.
title: Saronsberg 2010 Provenance Shiraz Rosé (Tulbagh)

description: The cave cooperative in Tavel is the largest producer in the appellation, so it's reassuring that so many of its cuvées scored highly in this year's tastings. Cinnamon and clove notes accent vibrant red berries and citrus in this medium- to full-bodied wine that's long, intense and crisp on the finish.
title: Les Vignerons de Tavel 2016 Le Chant du Soleil  (Tavel)

description: Made entirely from Syrah grown on two vineyard sites, then fermented and aged in stainless steel, this wine is light pink-orange in color and begins with a robust flavor of hazelnut and savory lemon peel. Dry and crisp, it remains lighthearted in the glass, finishing with a tease of grapefruit.
title: Sidebar 2016 Syrah Rosé (Russian River Valley)

description: Pretty dark and full-bodied for a rosé, and too extracted and heavy in cherry-berry flavors to be considered elegant. It's almost a red wine you could drink at room temperature.
title: Little Black Dress 2006 Syrah Rosé (California)

description: Soft, sweet red cherries and berries contrast leafy green and peppery notes in this dry-style Cabernet Franc rosé. It's a bit candied and confected, yet green in character with a quickly dissipating finish.
title: Lucas Vineyards 2014 Dry Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: Made with 100% Pinot Nero, this delivers a fragrance of rose and perfumed red berry. The lively palate offers wild strawberry layered with raspberry, pink grapefruit, light spice and white almond alongside bright acidity and a persistent perlage.
title: Banfi 2010 Cuvée Aurora Rosé Pinot Nero (Alta Langa)

description: A really pale rosé with hints of onion skin, this tastes as light and delicate as its color. It has more citrus than red fruits, an ethereal line of acidity and a fresh character. The blend of this wine is gradually getting drier and crisper over the years.
