description: A very pale copper color, this wine is aromatically expressive with notes of strawberry and cherry bubblegum along with light herbal notes. The palate drinks dry with electric acidity that makes the fruit flavors snap, with citrus notes that persist on the finish.
title: Kerloo 2015 Rosé Painted Hills Vineyard Grenache (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Fresh and blossomy, this elegant medium-bodied rosé offers loads of raspberry fruitiness, but also a deeply mineral spine of chalk and sea breeze. Made predominantly from Merlot and Cabernet Franc, it holds smaller proportions of Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay that lend complexity and nuance.
title: Macari 2015 Rosé (North Fork of Long Island)

description: While delicate peach and berry aromas are subdued on the nose, crisp raspberry flavor exhilarates on the palate of this cutting, light-footed wine. Dry and refreshingly mineral, it's the perfect summer quaffer either with food, or just sipped on the porch.
title: Paumanok 2015 Dry Rosé (North Fork of Long Island)

description: Perfumes of cherry blossom and raspberry abound on this ethereally light-bodied rosé. Brisk mineral tones and citrusy acidity add to its thirst-quenching quality. The finish is elegantly herbaceous.
title: Pellegrini Vineyards 2015 Rosé (North Fork of Long Island)

description: A light orange-pink in color, this blend of 51% Grenache, 24% Carignan, 14% Cinsault, 5% Mourvèdre, 4% Counoise and 2% Syrah shows tangy peach, quince, red apple and tropical bubblegum on the nose. There is tremendous tension on the sip, with grippy cement minerality and fresh, brisk flavors of tangerine, light strawberry and lemon.
title: Adelaida 2015 Rosé (Adelaida District)

description: Stylish and fruity, this has red currant crispness and an attractive warm, ripe background. It's balanced and fresh, with intense fruitiness at the end.
title: Bernard Magrez 2014 Douce Vie Les Muraires Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The palest pink suggests the almost-weightless lightness of this refreshing wine. It would be an ideal, zippy and very slender apéritif. Drink soon.
title: Huber 2014 Zweigelt Rosé (Weinland Österreich)

description: Voiles (sails) seems an appropriate name for a wine that comes from near the resort of Saint-Tropez. This attractively packaged wine is soft and rounded, with just the right amount of acidity and red currant fruits to keep it fresh and fruity.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2014 Les Voiles de Saint-Tropez Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This textured wine is tight with layers of nervy acidity. It is crisp, with good amounts of acidity and flavors of red currants that add extra freshness.
title: Mas de Cadenet 2014 Arbaude Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Here's a brightly saturated Pinot Grigio with toasted notes of almond, freshly baked bread and creamy butter. You can taste the influence of oak here and the wine is rich in flavor and intensity. The mouthfeel is dense, creamy and long-lasting.
title: Josef Weger 2006 Maso delle Rose Pinot Grigio (Alto Adige)

description: This tastes a little sweet, in the Rosenblum style, with apricot, orange and pear flavors. But it's nicely crisp in acidity, which gives it a clean finish. Delightful now as a cocktail sipper.
title: Rose 'N' Blum 2011 Pinot Grigio (California)

description: Rose petals and sweet raspberry candy perfume this dry yet lusciously fruity rosé. It's easy-drinking, bearing generous black-plum and cherry flavors, with just a hint of ripe briar. This is a perfect apéritif or accompaniment to spicy Thai or Indian cuisine. Drink now.
title: Goose Watch 2011 Rosé Cabernet Franc (Finger Lakes)

description: From organic grapes, this is a soft, red-fruited wine. The tang of acidity is well balanced by the full fruit character. It's ripe and attractively structured.
title: Château Margüi 2011 Perle de Margüi Rosé (Coteaux Varois)

description: Smooth yet crisp, this has attractive acidity and strawberry fruit. It is poised and elegant, with just the right amount of acidity.
title: Les Quatre Tours 2011 Classique Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: The wine is crisp, full of red berry fruit and lively acidity, with a smooth texture. This is terrific as an accompaniment to a summer meal or as an apéritif. The finish is deliciously fruity. Screwcap.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de Saint-Louis 2011 Terres de Saint-Lion Rosé (Coteaux Varois)

description: Smoothly ripe and fruity, this wine charms with crisp apple acidity and a lively mousse. Clean, fresh and lightly perfumed, it's delicious
title: Frédéric Lornet NV Rosé Sparkling (Crémant de Jura)

description: Pretty in orange and pink, this sparkling Rosé is 75% Pinot Noir and 25% Chardonnay, creamy in texture with a pleasing taste of strawberries and cream atop a homemade biscuit. With solid acidity, it'll be both an attractive and effective addition to your springtime brunch or lunch table.
title: Rack & Riddle NV Sparkling Rosé Sparkling (North Coast)

description: Pale for a rosé, with a slight pink color. It's an enormously fragrant wine, brimming with peach, strawberry, smoke and vanilla notes. Lively and fresh in the mouth, with a creamy feel and the merest suggestion of strawberries. Finishes dry and elegant.
title: Roederer Estate NV Brut Rosé  (Anderson Valley)

description: Here is a very pretty pale-salmon-colored sparkling wine, with fine, zesty bubbles and an appealing whiff of Pinot Noir in the nose. The flavors are pure strawberry, a tiny bit sweet but not too much. This is the sort of sparkling wine even people who say they don’t like wine will fall in love with.
title: Iron Horse 1995 Brut Rosé  (Sonoma County)

description: This shows greater complexity than most rosés, with hints of leather and spice layered over cherry fruit. It's round in the mouth and rich in weight without beng heavy or warm. The spice-driven finish lingers a long time. Drink now and over the next year.
title: E. Guigal 2010  Tavel

description: This blend of Syrah, Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon offers up decadent juicy flavors of sun-kissed red cherries and watermelon. While dry in style, there's a slightly caramelized ripeness on the midpalate that balances out pertly against brisk grapefruit acidity. Enjoy now for its forward fruity exuberance.
title: Kontokosta 2015 Rosé (North Fork of Long Island)

description: Produced from organically grown fruit, this is a pure cleanly crisp wine. It has great acidity and generous red fruits that are shot through with acidity. The 50% of Mouvèdre in the blend gives the wine its perfumed, structured character. Drink now.
title: Figuière 2016 Première Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Light pink in color, this has chewing gum, watermelon and dust aromas. It is underwhelming on the palate, with a simple mouthfeel and flavors of cotton candy and cherry.
title: Llopart 2009 Rosé Brut Reserva Sparkling (Cava)

description: A typically heavy, ripe style of rosé, this does have some freshness and citrus acidity but it is put against ripe carmel, spice and a fat texture. Drink now.
title: Château Larroque 2013 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Does a good job of delivering Cabernet's personality at a decent price. Dry and softly tannic, this 100% Cab shows black currant, spicy plum and cedar flavors. Drink now.
title: Rosenblum 2006 Vintner's Cuvée Cabernet Sauvignon (California)

description: Latex, rubber band and other roasted, rubbery aromas send up the red flag, yet the palate and flavors are good enough even if they are already a little tired and rusty. Not really recommended given that rosé should be fresh and fun. This one veers to big berry fruit and softness. 100% Tempranillo. Imported by National Distributing Co., Inc.
title: Pinord 2007 Clos Torribas Rosé Tempranillo (Penedès)

description: Crisp, dry, caramel- and red berry-flavored wine that has some crispness as well as good strawberry softness. There is some spice to finish. Screwcap.
region_1: Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2007 Colombelle Rosé Red (Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is a really refreshing, crisp and fruity wine. It achieves a good balance between acidity and lively red berries and lime juice. The wine dances brightly in the glass and would make a good apéritif.
title: Campolargo 2011 Bruto Rosé Pinot Noir (Bairrada)

description: A very pretty wine, in scent and flavor, this estate-grown effort offers aromas of rose petals and cherry blossoms. Those floral notes continue into the palate, with light cherry fruit and citrusy acids.
title: White Rose 2014 White Rose Vineyard Pinot Noir (Dundee Hills)

description: Floral and inviting, this features 24% Chardonnay in an otherwise Pinot Noir-based sparkler. The two combine for an inviting nose of fresh wild strawberry jam amidst a smooth, silky texture and creamy mousse. The acidity is sharp and generous.
title: Chandon NV Brut Reserve Pinot Noir Rosé Sparkling (Sonoma-Napa)

description: This blush is made from Pinot Noir. Full-bodied in style, it's ripe with raspberries, strawberries and pink grapefruits, and a rich finish. Great with charcuterie.
title: Canihan 2012 Rosé (Sonoma County)

description: This is a Provençal-style blush made of Mourvèdre, Grenache, Cinsault and Syrah. It's a little sugary sweet, with raspberry, orange and vanilla flavors.
title: Curtis 2009 Heritage Rosé (Santa Barbara County)

description: Pink and light, with a sharp nose that's sweaty and sour. The palate is quite strong in acidity, so there's razor-like sharpness and spiky flavors of grapefruit and early season red plums. Overly zesty and tart; made from Malbec, Syrah and Petit Verdot.
title: Calcu 2010 Rosé (Colchagua Valley)

description: For a rosé, this wine is hefty and bold, with strawberry and plum flavors, with a dash of earthiness. One reviewer found it too creamy; another found lots to like about its spicy, fresh-herb finish. With such diverse evaluations, this is a wine to try for yourself.
designation: Edicion Limitada Rosé de Pinot Noir
title: Morandé 2001 Edicion Limitada Rosé de Pinot Noir Pinot Noir (Casablanca Valley)

description: Fresh and fruity rosé, full of wild strawberry flavors cut through with acidity. There is a light touch of tannin to give an extra texture.
title: Terra d'Alter 2010 Fado Rosé (Alentejano)

description: Blending Cabernet and Merlot, this is a caramel-flavored dry rosé, with good berry fruitiness. There's a fine final burst of acidity.
title: Château les Arromans 2010 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Fragrantly floral, this stunner offers delightful bursts of lemon, grapefruit and pomelo, as well as succulent raspberry. The acidity is persistent and tangy. Light-bodied and yet complex, it's easy to love and enjoy being just right for the table, beach blanket or kayak.
title: Kokomo 2015 Pauline's Vineyard Grenache Rosé (Dry Creek Valley)

description: Thin, simple and bright, this easy sparkling Prosecco Superiore opens with citrus, peach and white flower. Although the bottle does not specify the style, it feels like a Brut expression with very little residual sugar.
title: Valdellövo NV Bade  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This is a simple and straightforward expression of Prosecco with tight perlage and medium aromas of white flower and citrus. That subtle but soft sweetness you taste would pair nicely next to vegetable tempura.
title: Ornella Molon NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco Treviso)

description: This Extra Dry Prosecco opens with fresh citrus and peach at the forefront of white flower and crushed mineral. The wine is light, easy and crisp with a subtle touch of soft sweetness.
title: Piera Martellozzo 2012 Blu Giovello  (Prosecco)

description: This is a creamy and lush expression, with soft sweetness in the form of peach nectar and almond. The effervescence is soft and foamy.
title: Salatin 2012 Millesimato Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Zeta Dry, with a Zorro-style “Z” etched across the label, offers an easy-drinking sparkling wine experience with light shades of citrus, mineral and stone fruit.
title: Zardetto 2012 Millesimato Dry Zeta  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This is a base Prosecco sparkling wine with bright citrus and melon aromas followed by fresh sage and crushed mineral. There's a dry, flinty sensation to the finish.
title: Le Colture 2012 Sylvoz Brut  (Prosecco)

description: A bright pink colored rosé, this blend of Touriga Nacional and Syrah, has strawberry flavors and a touch of sweetness from the ripe fruits that is balanced with an attractive acidity. Enjoy with food rather than as an aperitif.
title: Falua 2012 Conde de Vimioso Colheita Selecionada Rosé (Tejo)

description: A fat, soft wine that isn't fresh enough. There are some sweet strawberry flavors, a touch of caramel and a metallic edge.
title: Quinta Vale do Armo 2013 Vila Jardim Rosé (Tejo)

description: A blend of Touriga Nacional and Aragonez, this is a soft wine, fruity with ripe red and white fruit flavors. It is a light wine with only a hint of tannin, much more in the way of gentle fruitiness.
title: Terras de Alter 2014 Terra d'Alter Rosé (Alentejano)

description: A fruity, young and crisp wine that is all about raspberry and red currant fruits. It is fresh with just a hint of caramel and with bright acidity at the end.
title: Wines & Winemakers 2014 Monta da Baía Rosé (Península de Setúbal)

description: Salmon pink in color, a wine that is soft and smooth with rich fruits, vanilla and some concentration. It is balanced with acidity while keeping the ripe fruit right to the fore.
title: Domaine de l'Eole 2010 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Pale salmon in color, this Brut Nature leads with clean, stony aromas that are more neutral than expressive. It's fresh, crisp and tight on the palate, with light, dry currant and raspberry flavors that feel clean on the finish.
title: Alta Alella 2015 Mirgin Rosé Reserva Brut Nature Sparkling (Cava)

description: Pink in the glass with the slightest yellow hue, this bottling offers broad nectarine, Pink Lady apple, soda and bubblegum aromas. It's clean and fresh on the palate, showing poached apple, citrus and wet slate flavors, with a citrusy acidity and decent grip that frame the finish.
title: Villa San Juliette 2016 Rosé (Paso Robles)

description: Fruity, lightly yeasty and with a caramel touch, this wine is rich and smooth. It has a generous red-fruit character as well as the right balanced acidity. The wine will be better from late 2017.
title: Château Trocard 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Notes of pear and strawberry create an inviting nose. The palate boasts the same lively fruit and adds lemony freshness in spades. This is lively, appetizing, light and dry. Just buy a case, a bottle will only last five minutes among friends.
title: Domaine G. Metz 2016 Cuvée Harmony L'Accord Parfait Rosé (Alsace)

description: The nose of this wine is full of violet, sweet cherry, strawberry jam and fig. The palate is reminiscent of a fresh strawberry covered in balsamic reduction and the satin-smooth tannins carry this along to the long finish.
title: Rosemont NV Virginia Red (Virginia)

description: This is a pretty and floral rosé, with attractive notes of strawberry, red cherry, sweet pea and white clover. The light-weight palate offers vibrant notes of red currant and lime peel that carry through to the bright and refreshing finish. Drink now.
title: M. Chapoutier 2015 Les Vignes de Bila-Haut Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: This Syrah-based rosé leads with a fruity mélange of aromas: watermelon, peach, white cherry and a touch of banana. The palate offers more of the same alongside additional notes of mango and tart currant. It's light weight and easy drinking, with ample acidity and a subtle peppery spice to the close. Drink now.
title: Les Costières de Pomerols 2015 Beau Vignac Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Pale onion skin in color, this is a soft fruity wine. It has attractive red-fruit flavors and light acidity. With a salty tang as well as some minerality, the wine is crisp and fruity right to the end.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2015 Les Jolies Filles Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: From the Treviso area of northeast Italy, this luminous Prosecco offers easygoing aromas of yellow flower and sweet peach. There's a zesty note of white pepper on the slightly sweet finish.
title: Perlage NV Sgàjo Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: There is light acidity on this fresh, gently fruity wine. It does have a textured edge with plum skin acidity and a fresh aftertaste.
title: Domaine de Pontefract 2010 Domaine du Vieux Moulin Rosé (Vin de Pays Var)

description: Although the label reads “Millesimato,” it does not carry a vintage date. The bouquet is redolent of spicy clove and white pepper and there's plenty of citrus and peach at the back. The finish is smooth and slightly sweet.
title: Dogarina NV Millesimato Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Initially, this Canary Islands rosado smells like a sweaty gym or a backpacker in need of a shower—it's that funky. In the mouth, it smacks down hard. Short, vegetal flavors turn bitter prior to a finish that tastes more like bitter greens than fruit.
title: El Grifo 2014 Rosado (Lanzarote)

description: Pale salmon color and slightly bricked, this wine displays aromas of geranium, dried herbs and strawberry. It drinks off dry, with lightly spritzy herb flavors.
title: 3 Horse Ranch Vineyards 2014 Rosé

description: The pure scent of freshly cut, ripe, green pear makes for a very appetizing, fruity nose. The palate adds a subtle white-pepper edge to this intense but juicily refreshing pear fruit. Green apple pops up, as well as bright and lively lemon. All this happens on a smooth and rounded body, full of charm but with a serious, savory core.
title: Anton Bauer 2016 Rosenberg Grüner Veltliner (Wagram)

description: After many years of singing the praises of Muga's rosé, this vintage seems lacking and sour. The nose is short and quiet, while the palate delivers lean, citric flavors and a sharp, scouring finish. Whets the whistle, but doesn't put a smile on your face.
title: Muga 2008 Rosé (Rioja)

description: Soft and on the sweet side of Brut, this wine is dominated by Pinot Noir grown in the Côte de Bar, in the Aube region. It is round, smooth and rich in character, ready to drink with a crisp aftertaste.
title: Montaudon NV Grande Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: This wine is rich and ripe with full strawberry and red currant fruits. A spice and pepper character adds a bite to the fruitiness. Acidity at the end gives lift.
title: Domaine du Clos du Fief 2014 Fleur de Gamay Rosé (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: An orange shade of pink, this wine leans toward dried lemon and orange peels with a slight bit of bubble gum and pomegranate on the nose. The flavors are more concentrated than bright, with iodine and dried fruit character, more reminiscent of an orange wine than a pink one.
title: Standing Sun 2013 Rosé of Syrah (Santa Barbara County)

description: Rounded and fruity, the wine has caramel, ripe red fruits and a touch of tannins. It's dry, although it's not as fresh as it should be, more ripe and full in the mouth. Drink in 2014.
title: François Millet 2012 Empreinte Rosé (Sancerre)

description: This soft wine shows a relatively high dosage, giving a ripe strawberry-fruit character. The acidity and fruit are gentle, hinting at a tannic edge from red wine in the blend.
designation: Rosé Vieilles Vignes Premier Cru Brut
title: Duménil NV Rosé Vieilles Vignes Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: Fashionably pale-colored, this Champagne features crisp acidity. Red-currant fruit and bright acidity have produced a wine that is lively but light in character. It is ready to drink.
title: Vranken NV Demoiselle Grande Cuvée Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Despite the bold statement of this rosé's cat-shaped bottle, it is fairly subdued, suggesting more mineral tones than fruit. It's brisk and lemony though, with a refreshingly clean finish.
title: Moselland 2014 Cat Bottle Rosé Pinot Noir (Nahe)

description: Obtuse aromas of chunky citrus fruits and mild-smelling vegetables open this Merlot rosé. Fat in feel, with just enough acidic offset, this tastes of pithy citrus with a green note thrown in. A grabby, blocky finish tastes mildly briny.
title: Otazu 2015 Merlot Rosado (Navarra)

description: This vigorous sparkler has flavors of red berry, bread crust, bitter walnut and a confectionary note. It's a bit on the lean side, with sharp vivacious bubbles that give it a bracing finish.
title: Bellavista 2011 Rosé Brut Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: A complex, rich and ripe wine. It shows both a tannic edge and full red fruit flavors. With acidity cutting through, this is finely balanced, a delicious and serious wine that would benefit from a few more months in bottle.
title: Château Vignelaure 2012 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: California rosé is awfully hard to get right. It's usually too sweet, too heavy or both. With this Grenache-Cinsault blend, Minassian-Young knocks it out of the park. The wine is dry, delicate, modest in alcohol, and complex, with subtle peach, rosehip tea, orange zest, watermelon and spice flavors. A great bargain, but only 64 cases were produced.
title: Minassian-Young 2011 Grenache-Cinsault Rosé (Paso Robles)

description: Celebrating 200 years under the same ownership, this ripe, full and fruity wine is all that a Provence rosé should be. It's dry, rounded yet with a great line of red berry acidity. There is just a touch of spice to give a final lift.
title: Mas de Cadenet 2012 Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: While this wine's moniker literally translates as “scantily dressed,” it is derived from the name of the vineyard. The wine is light and crisply fruity, with red-currant fruit and plenty of acidity. It is ready to drink.
title: J. Portugal Ramos 2015 Pouca Roupa Rosé (Alentejano)

description: A fifty-fifty blend of native grape Monica and Sangiovese, this fresh, fruity rosato is loaded with ripe cherry, juicy strawberry and crushed raspberry alongside a hint of white pepper. Zesty acidity lends balance and a bright, easy-drinking vibe.
title: Pala 2014 Silenzi Rosato (Isola dei Nuraghi)

description: This is made in a softer, sweeter style than most Pommery Champagnes. Strawberry flavors are ripe and integrated with the acidity, with a light tannic edge from the red wine in the blend. It is attractive and ready to drink.
title: Pommery NV Brut Rosé Royal  (Champagne)

description: The nose gives little away. The frothy palate charms with soft slight sweetness and lively froth: there is freshness even if there is not exactly distinguishable fruit. This is a very easy-drinking, unfussy sparkler with a rounded finish that's ideal for parties.
title: Schlumberger Wein- und Sektkellerei NV Rosé Secco Méthode Traditionelle Sparkling (Österreichischer Sekt)

description: This soft wine has red fruits attractively embedded in the bright texture. The relatively high dosage results in its fruity character. Simple in texture, the wine is ready to drink.
title: Chassenay d'Arce NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This is a crisp, fresh and red-currant flavored. It is lively, tight and fruity. A touch of perfume adds to the pleasure of this ready-to-drink wine.
title: Château de Bergun 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Crisp and fruity, this is a wine full of red currant and blackberry flavors. It does have a tannic structure that will allow the wine to develop along with the acidity. In the family for three-generations, the estate is now run by Denis Hazane. Drink from 2018.
title: Château la Roseraie 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A deepish pink blush signals full-fruited pleasure: indeed the palate has some body but also lovely balance between fresh red apple fruit and zesty citrus notes. Completely dry, this will be an ideal and versatile lunch or picnic wine. It is on the finish that all the strawberry notes burst through.
title: Tinhof 2015 Rosé (Burgenland)

description: Full-flavoured, almost heady notes of tart strawberry, crunchy red cherry and fresh lemon pervade nose and palate perfectly. This is a real mouthful of flavor, yet light and zippy. A very satisfying, grown-up rosé for countless summer days, lunches, picnics and parties. A real and delicious allrounder.
title: Winzerkeller Andau 2015 Rosé (Niederösterreich)

description: Based in Aix-en-Provence, this négociant company has sourced a beautiful wine from cool vineyards in the northern part of the Côtes de Provence region. The result is a lightly mineral wine with a crisp red-currant heart that is refreshing and good for an apéritif.
title: Hecht & Bannier 2015 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Very dry and delicate, this outstanding-quality, Euro-style wine has a transparent pink color, good crisp acidity, relatively light body, and fresh, charming flavors like pink grapefruit and white peach. Drink it as soon and as often as possible.
title: Klinker Brick 2015 Rosé (Lodi)

description: RosaMati opens with a bold pink color and follows up aromatically with bright raspberry, cassis and cranberry. The wine shows a cool, silky feel in the mouth with a crisp close.
title: Fattoria Le Pupille 2010 RosaMati Rosé (Maremma)

description: Pale blush on the glass, this Rhône-style blend has a pleasing bouquet of strawberry and lavender. It is very refreshing, with flavors of strawberry, honeysuckle, orange blossom and watermelon. There is a light sense of coolness towards the finish, but bright citrus notes outlast that sensation.
designation: Cotes de Galilee Village Cuvee Eva
title: Jacques Capsouto 2014 Cotes de Galilee Village Cuvee Eva Rosé (Galilee)

description: The wine is lean, with acidity rather than ripe fruit. It is also tough with tannins. It could come round, although it will always be tough and extracted.
title: Château La Rose du Pin 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This blend of Shiraz and Garnacha is simple on the palate, with modest acidity. Powdery berry and stone-fruit aromas are basic.
title: Vicente Gandia 2016 El Miracle 120 Aniversario Shiraz-Garnacha Rosé (Valencia)

description: This leads with lovely pink peony and carnation aromas, supported by a fruity blend of strawberry, nectarine and melon. The medium-weight palate offers ripe fruit flavors that are braced by ample acidity and a refreshing citrusy note on the close. Drink now.
title: Mas Janeil by Francois Lurton 2016 Les Hauts de Janeil Syrah Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: A reddish color and lean aromas of cherry skins and plum lead to a pinchy, high-acid mouthfeel. Tart flavors of red plum and citrus fruits are a touch foxy and broken, and seem punchy on the finish.
title: Monterebro 2016 Rosado (Jumilla)

description: This wine is pale peach in color. The 100% Grenache, the wood influence (100% new 500L French oak) is almost completely overwhelming, showing notes of vanillin, wood spice and cream. It lightens up a bit on the dry palate but still can't make up the difference.
title: Gård 2015 Lawrence Vineyards Rosé (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Earthen, savory tones of dusty mineral on the nose open to tart sour cherry and strawberry on the palate of this semi-dry rosé made from Merlot grapes. It's light bodied and zesty but balanced with a hint of sweetness.
title: Harbes Family Vineyard 2015 Semi-Dry Rosé (North Fork of Long Island)

description: This rosé is light in intensity on the nose, with delicate aromas of strawberry hull, white melon and underripe pear. The palate is similarly light and zippy, with prickly acidity and a mouthwatering finish. Drink now.
title: M. Chapoutier 2016 Les Vignes de Bila-Haut Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Medium-salmon in color, this sparkling rosé made from Marechal Foch offers raspberry and strawberry flavors and aromas, with a slightly toasted character. Creamy, nutty notes take over on the finish.
title: Illinois Sparkling Co. NV Heirloom Sparkling Rosé Sparkling (Illinois)

description: This is a crisp, fruity and perfumed rosé from Sciaccarellu. It has red-currant freshness, bright acidity and a delicious refreshing character. Drink now.
title: Domaine Poli 2015 Rosé (Ile de Beauté)

description: Deep mauve to light red in color, this bottling conveys rustic aromas of smoked berries, blood and leather on the nose. Smashed wild berries and dried strawberries show on the sip, which also shows some brick and meat flavors. The chalky tannins keep it intriguing.
title: Puma Road 2014 Pedregal Vineyard Estate Grown Rosé (Paicines)

description: Delicately perfumed, this is an attractive, fruity wine.It layers acidity and a light tannic edge with white fruits and red currants. There is a soft vanilla aftertaste.
title: Domaine de la Sauveuse 2011 Cuvée Château Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Light salmon in color, this has aromas of pineapple, passion fruit and tangerine. It feels tangy and zesty, with pithy, crisp flavors of citrus fruits and red berries. It's juicy, but not overly flavorful on the finish.
region_1: Vino de la Tierra de Castilla y León
title: François Lurton 2011 El Albar Rosado Rosé (Vino de la Tierra de Castilla y León)

description: This is very soft and rounded, with a caramel edge. Its warm, ripe mouthfeel is marked by fruity, light acidity and a splash of lime. Screwcap.
title: Château Routas 2011 Rosé (Coteaux Varois)

description: With its extra richness, this has lost some fruitiness and acidity, lending a fat feeling. The red fruits are still there, however, coupled with an orange zest note. Screwcap.
title: Domaine Houchart 2011 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Fresh whiffs of strawberry and blossom go hand-in-hand with more evolved complexities of mushroom and yeast in this invigorating rosé sparkling. While delicately moussed, it's Pinot-Noir heavy blend lends a satisfyingly voluminous feel to the palate.
title: Sparkling Pointe NV Topaz Impérial Rosé  (North Fork of Long Island)

description: A broad, rather soft example of rosé, this blend of Grenache, Syrah and Carignan should be consumed over the next few months.
title: Louis Bernard 2010 Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This medium-bodied blend of Cinsaut, Mourvèdre, Syrah and Grenache features bright raspberry and lime notes alongside a touch of apple. Very crisp; on the lean side for a Costières de Nîmes rosé.
title: Château Mas Neuf 2010 Rhône Paradox Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This light-bodied bubbly has a pale copper color, spicy aromas, bright cherry and peach flavors and a slight touch of sweetness that makes the texture quite plush. It's sophisticated, complex and just plain delicious.
designation: Brut Rosé Méthode Champenoise California Champagne
title: Korbel NV Brut Rosé Méthode Champenoise California Champagne Sparkling (California)

description: Rounded, balanced and harmonious flavors get top marks on this softly pink sparkler. Strawberries and cream, with shortbread and lemon, all unite in perfect unison. The dryness of the palate gives the flavors center stage and provides a fitting, structured autolytic background. This sparkler is classy and delicious, with an ultraclean and lasting finish.
title: Joseph Cattin NV Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: One of the earliest creators of rosé Champagne, Lanson produces a crisp style, very fruity while fresh and dry. The acidity is present, giving a great lift to the red-berry flavors and dash of lemon juice. It's a delicate, fruity wine that is ready to drink.
title: Lanson NV Rose Label Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A heady fragrance of wisteria, hawthorn and white peach aromas lead the way. The rich, creamy, palate doles out yellow apple, juicy pear and candied nectarine zest alongside crisp acidity and a foamy perlage.
title: Le Colture NV Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Tart red currant, rhubarb and strawberry come together in a very refreshing, rounded and appetizing fashion. The frothy, foaming mousse is exuberant and highlights these strawberry shortcake flavors brilliantly, while a totally dry palate makes sure that this stays classy. This is very satisfying, fun and fruit-driven, with a serious core and a bright, lemony finish.
title: Lucien Albrecht NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Floral aromas of wild flowers, wisteria and a whiff of white tree fruit float out of the glass. The vibrant, refined palate delivers crisp apple, succulent pear and a note of citrus zest alongside bright acidity and an elegant perlage. A light mineral touch marks the finish.
title: Terre di San Venanzio Fortunato 2014 Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Enticing aromas of wisteria, Spanish broom and a whiff of pear emerge in the glass. The crisp, creamy palate is loaded with finesse, delivering white peach, nectarine zest, apple and a mineral note. Vibrant acidity brightens the creamy flavors while a foamy mousse gives it a smooth texture.
title: Vettori NV Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: A traditional blend of Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre, this medium-bodied rosé offers delicate floral aromas as well as some slightly confected bubble-gum scents. It's less overtly fruity on the palate, then finishes with a welcome burst of lime zest.
title: Marrenon 2014 Roséfine Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: Citrus and soft red berry flavors are restrained on nose and palate of this pale, pink and slender rosé. But the bone-dry nature of the wine makes for great refreshment. Drink soon.
title: Fritsch 2014 Rosé vom Rosé (Wagram)

description: This is the winning Mourvèdre of the vintage for Ryan Pease, one of the few winemakers to do multiple bottlings of the Rhône varietal. Exotic olallieberies, black peppercorns, vanilla cookies, nutmeg and black rocks show on the nose, while the palate delivers tighter boysenberries, cracked pepper, Sichuan peppercorns, wet gravel and crushed asphalt. This one's built to last.
title: Paix Sur Terre 2014 The Other One Glenrose Vineyard Mourvèdre (Adelaida District)

description: There are so many unexpected joys in this 100% varietal wine, given the chance to shine in light-bodied wisps of tangerine, lemon and lime. Despite its delicate nature, it doesn't skimp on satisfaction nor complexity, delivering waves of flavor sip after sip.
title: Bodkin 2015 Hotspur Rosé of Syrah (Russian River Valley)

description: Musky aromas of red apple skins and stone fruits are mild but mostly clean. This Shiraz-Cabernet blend feels solid and full for rosé. Peppery, leafy flavors of spiced berry, apple and olive finish chunky, dry and slightly bitter.
title: Valle Hermoso 2015 Rosé (Central Valley)

description: This ripe wine is pale in color, with caramel and red-fruit flavors. It is rich, full of fruit with a hint of crispness at the end. Drink now.
title: Château Penin 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: In color, this is almost white. In flavor it is equally light. There is some attractive acidity and the soft wine will slip down easily. The aftertaste is crisp with just a touch of red currant.
title: Domaine de la Forêt 2015 Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: Forward scents of white raspberry, muddled cherry, pressed pink flowers and white chocolate suggest this is a ripe and rich rosé. The round palate is surprisingly juxtaposed by a sharp astringency that dominates through the finish.
title: Le Cirque 2015 Rosé (Côtes Catalanes)

description: This harkens back to the days of white Zinfandel, though it's not from that grape. But it offers similar simple, sweet, generic fruit, best for drinking chilled on a hot summer afternoon.
title: Melrose 2014 Two Dog Sweet Rosé (Umpqua Valley)

description: A blend of dominant Merlot with Grenache, this is a light, caramel flavored wine. It is full in the mouth with spice and red fruits cut by lemon acidity.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2015 Domaine le Grand Destré Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: This wine is fresh, crisp and fruity. With its almost-white color and green and citrus fruits, there is only the merest hint to suggest a rosé. It's an attractive wine, but hardly typical.
title: Château Malbat 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: A pioneer in rosé Vinho Verde, this producer makes a dry wine and one of the few rosés from the region that really make sense. It is balanced with crisp red fruits as well as tight acidity and a shot of lemon. Drink now.
title: Casa do Valle 2015 Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: A lively, crisp wine, packed with bright raspberries, red cherries and acidity. It has a touch of caramel, but no more. The freshness is much more important. Screwcap.
title: DFJ Vinhos 2008 Coreto Rosé (Estremadura)

description: Wild in barely ripe strawberry, grapefruit and a hint of mint, it hails from great ground, the Bucher Vineyard along Russian River Valley's Westside Road. A tinge of orange blossom and orange playfully intermingle on the nose and on the palate. Midweight and layered, it's a lovely wine.
title: Bucher 2013 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Russian River Valley)

description: This saignée-style wine is pale salmon in color, showing some bricking. It drinks dry with rounded suggestions of cherry and watermelon providing easy-drinking enjoyment.
title: Hamilton 2013 Rosé of Malbec (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Crisp and refreshing, this lovely sparkler offers sensations of white wild flowers, green apple, citrus and Bartlett pear. Vibrant acidity balances the creamy, elegantly foaming palate and gives it a dry, invigorating finish.
title: Nino Franco NV Brut  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: While this wine is rich, it is also well balanced with perfumed acidity and a tight, mineral edge. Ripe with red berry fruits, it is dry and full in the mouth. Both fresh and rich at the same time, it will be better with food.
title: Billecart-Salmon NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Strawberry hints and floral overtones promise pleasure that arrives on the dry, creamy palate. A lively froth accentuates lightness and ease, while dryness underlines the clean fruit flavors. Fine autolysis provides the creamy, textured background, all pervaded by a lively seam of bright acid.
title: Boeckel 2013 Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This terrific Rosato represents a dynamic blend of Pinot Nero, Lagrein, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. It opens with a bright pink color, a dry mouthfeel and spicy after notes of dried raspberry, cherry and cinnamon stick.
title: Kellerei Kaltern Caldaro 2011 Signé Rosato (Vigneti delle Dolomiti)

description: Modishly gray-pink in color, this is an attractive wine with fresh acidity and soft texture. The wine is off dry, giving it a gentle character that makes it an apéritif style.
title: Gabriel Meffre 2014 GM par Gabriel Meffre Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The 18th-century estate's second wine is bright, crisp and fresh with attractive acidity and a lively, juicy aftertaste. Drink immediately.
title: Château de Saint-Martin 2014 Eternelle Favorite Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a heavy wine, aromatic with fruit that is dense and concentrated. The freshness is missing and in its place there are super-ripe berry fruits and a peppery aftertaste.
title: Château la Tour Sainte Anne 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Does the devil (diable) sell wine? Obviously this producer think so. It's a very pale-colored wine, almost white, with light, stylish fruit that is as much about acidity as fruitiness. It's hardly devilish, but pleasant enough.
title: Domaine des Diables 2014 Les Petits Diables Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Old-style gin bottles are obviously popular in Provence. This pale salmon-pink colored wine comes in such a bottle. It's lightly fruity with attractive acidity that dominates the fruit and texture. Drink now.
title: Domaine Terre de Mistral 2014 Rosalie Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: This red-fruited, ripe wine has attractive bright acidity and some weight. It's dry and probably better suited to food than as an apéritif.
title: Mirabeau 2014 Classic Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: It's a light and fruity wine, with a delicate texture and bright acidity. Soft and crisp, it's fine for an apéritif.
title: Aimé Roquesante 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Strawberry cream on the nose and a subtle touch of lemon blended in with strawberry flavors gives this rosé a pretty balance of sweet and crisp. Fun, but with substance, it could be paired with everything from a light seafood salad to a heartier poultry dish.
title: Macari 2007 Rosé (North Fork of Long Island)

description: Ripe and Grenache-heavy, to judge by the black cherry and chocolate aromas and flavors. It's medium-bodied, with a tart finish that provides a refreshing counterpoint to the ripe fruit. Imported by Trinchero Vineyards.
title: Angove's 2007 Nine Vines Rosé Grenache-Shiraz (South Australia)

description: Aromatic notes of red rose, raspberry and blueberry shape the nose of this brilliantly pink rosé. The wine is intense and full of delicate spice and candied fruit nuances that promise an excellent pairing with fish couscous.
title: Fattoria Alois 2007 Nadhir Rosé (Campania)

description: A clean and refreshing rosé, this opens with attractive scents of red cherry, strawberry and a hint of clementine. The medium-bodied mouthfeel is balanced by a good cut of vibrant acidity and bright fruit flavors. Melon and citrus rind flavors kiss the fleeting finish. Drink now.
title: Penya 2014 Rosé (Côtes Catalanes)

description: Here's a bright rosé with a pretty peach color and mature aromas of berry and stone fruit. It has a flat but smooth mouthfeel with some notes of bitter almond on the close.
title: Fratta Pasini 2007 Chiaretto Rosé (Bardolino)

description: Overtly fruity upfront, with a green apple, pineapple, papaya and spiced orange character that trails off to a simple citrus note in the mouth. The dry, short-to-medium finish is shot through with tobacco notes. Drink up.
title: Baron Gassier 2008 Sainte Victoire Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: There's a touch of caramel or butterscotch at the open of the bouquet that gives this wine a thicker, fatter feel in the mouth. It ends with a savory note of chopped mint or dried oregano as well.
title: Cantina San Martino NV Brut  (Prosecco)

description: A tuna melt or easy platter of cold cuts and cheese would pair with this bright Italian sparkler. It's a Dry expression, which means it tastes sweetish in the mouth, and shows notes of peach and citrus.
title: La Jara 2010 Millesimato Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Ebullient with ripe cherry fruit, this intensely aromatic rosé is geared towards the white Zin drinker who's looking for a step up. While soft and a tad confectionery with a sweet, candied cherry palate, there's a crisp acidity throughout that keeps it from becoming too cloying.
title: Chateau Lafayette Reneau 2009 Pinot Noir Blanc Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: Baked pears, tangerine oil and wet-cement minerality show on the nose of this rich yet balanced wine from one of the region's premiere sites. The palate shows Gala apples, honeysuckle and blood-orange rinds, blending ripeness with grippy tartness.
title: Loring Wine Company 2014 Rosella's Vineyard Chardonnay (Santa Lucia Highlands)

description: This Syrah-based rosé, with just 4% Viognier, offers very clean lines of ripe cherry, strawberry, baking spice and brioche on the nose. There is a strong tactile grip to the palate, and then it smooths out very quickly, with a lemon juice acidity cutting through ripe red fruits.
title: Vina Robles 2016 Estate Rosé (Paso Robles)

description: Produced from Aragonez this is a soft wine, full of red-currant flavors as well as a touch of vanilla and caramel. It is an easy, refreshingly spicy wine, ready to drink now.
title: Adega Mãe 2016 Pinta Negra Rosé (Lisboa)

description: This wine is soft and ripe, with layers of rich red fruits fronting a caramel and tangy orange backdrop. It's full in the mouth, delivering a real burst of fruitiness, mineral texture and delicious acidity at the end.
title: Cellier Saint-Sidoine 2014 Coste Brulade Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This delicously crisp wine is light and full of fresh citrus and red fruits. It dances out of the glass, bright with acidity. The name says it all—it's ready to drink this instant.
title: Château Barbanau 2014 L'Instant Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wine comes from hills well inland in Provence, giving it a fresh, lively character. It is rich but the strawberry fruitiness is dominant and finishes the wine with delicious acidity. The blend is 50% Grenache, 35% Cinsault, 35% Syrah; there was no barrel aging.
title: Château Carpe Diem 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Galoupet's vineyards are close to the sea, giving the wine a delicious freshness. It is crisp with layers of fruits and acidity. Full in the mouth, this is a wine with a great place at the table.
title: Château du Galoupet 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Crisp cherry aromas come with smoke and dryness. The palate is healthy, smooth and offers a good bubble bead in front of toasty raspberry and chocolate flavors. Dry and spicy on the finish; fresh and lively as a whole.
title: Freixenet NV Cordon Rosado Brut Sparkling (Cava)

description: Simple, light strawberry aromas form a good opening. The palate is juicy and bright, with citrus and nectarine flavors. There's nothing complicated or overreaching here; it's easygoing, clean and finishes with pepper and brown sugar.
title: Segura Viudas NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Cava)

description: This is three-quarters Pinot Noir, 15% Pinot Meunier and 10% Chardonnay. It's a thoroughly captivating rosé, with Champagne-like finesse. Concentrated flavors deftly mingle cherry, green citrus and herb, with a lovely mineral base.
title: Argyle 2012 Brut Rosé Sparkling (Willamette Valley)

description: This opens with aromas of blue and red flower, underbrush and mature, dark-skinned berry. The tense palate offers black cherry, crushed raspberry, star anise tobacco and mocha alongside firm, fine-grained tannins and bright acidity. A note of chopped herb closes the finish. Drink 2018–2028.
title: Bric Cenciurio 2011 Coste di Rose  (Barolo)

description: The showpiece chateau of Berne has produced this later bottling of rosé, a wine that is ready to drink. Crisp red fruits are underlined by acidity and a bitter orange edge. The wine is lightly structured, zesty and fruity right the way through.
title: Château de Berne 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Floral in rose petal, this mouthwatering wine is awash in light beams of watermelon and grapefruit—its soul infinitely crisp. Refreshingly memorable, it sparks in orange and cherry on the finish.
title: Keller 2016 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Sonoma Coast)

description: Bouvet Ladubay's rosé is a soft in style with a light fruit flavor dominated by fresh raspberries. There's also a touch of tannin in the texture, resulting in a sparkling wine that is more for food than an aperitif.
title: Bouvet-Ladubay NV Rosé Excellence Brut Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: With a fluorescent pink color, this Syrah-based rosé opens with cherry, raspberry and plum aromas. As a whole, it's basic but spunky on the palate, with adequate structural support. Raspberry, plum and citrus flavors finish firm and fresh.
title: Viña Casablanca 2014 Cefiro Reserva Syrah Rosé (Casablanca Valley)

description: Rich and ripe with blackberry and cherry tones, this off-dry rosé is luxuriously plush in style. While a touch candied on the palate, it balances out nicely on the finish with a vibrant kick of sour cherry acidity.
title: Glenora 2013 Pinot Noir Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: Bright, fresh strawberries combine with a hint of green herbs for an attractive nose. But the flavors of this 50-50 blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot are less effusive. Still, it finishes lemony and tart, making it a fine summer sipper.
title: Malesan 2001 Rose Red (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Pretty peach in color, this 50-50 sparkling blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, with a small percentage of the Pinot added to the blend before secondary fermentation, is a light, high-toned, flinty bubbly rich in strawberry aromas and a savory, herbal streak.
title: Mumm Napa 2008 DVX Rosé Sparkling (Napa Valley)

description: A slightly pungent aroma appears on first sniff but is soon followed by more enticing notes of stone fruit and melon. This bright sparkling wine offers clean effervescence and a slightly sweet aftertaste.
title: Case Bianche NV Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Very pale in color, this is a lightly fruity wine that feels fresh, light in flavor, with a final caramel note.
title: Château Roubine 2010 Inspire Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Ripe wine with light acidity and flavors of red currants, caramel and spice. There is a full-bodied feel to the finish.
title: Domaine du Jas d'Esclans 2010 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Very light in flavor and texture, the wine has hints of strawberry flavors with acidity and a crisp, clean character.
title: Miradou 2010 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This pale, cotton candy hued wine contains muted aromas of strawberry hull and raspberry. The flavors are ripe and fruity, with a hint of orange blossom. It's light bodied, but the ripe-fruit sweetness is almost textural.
title: New Kent 2014 White Merlot Rosé (Virginia)

description: This is an interesting rosé, with a light burnt-orange hue and an orange theme throughout. It's evident from wild, sweet orange on the nose to clementine, orange blossom and orange candy flavors on the palate. There are other aromas such as cherry cough drops and raspberries, while the palate is fruit forward, with flabby acidity.
title: New Kent 2014 White Norton Rosé (Virginia)

description: This light pink rosé has aromas of lemongrass, mango and eucalyptus. On the palate there are strawberries and cream and raspberry. There is a slight touch of creaminess and roundness to the body with a crisp finish.
title: Purcari 2015 Rose de Purcari Rosé (Moldova)

description: There is much buzz about this new Steve and Chrystal Clifton (of Palmina and Brewer-Clifton) project that finds inspiration for wine from music. This orange-mauve-pink rosé is redolent with the familiar Pinot components of cherry, sagebrush and clove. On the palate, iron, graphite and wild herbs spice up the pomegranate fruit. It's very varietally pure.
title: La Voix 2014 She's Crafty Rosé of Pinot Noir (Sta. Rita Hills)

description: Pale peach in color, this wine brings aromas of green pepper and jalapeño pepper that are quite strong. The palate is dry and brings more of the same. It just doesn't work.
designation: Ascent One-Half Mile Closer to the Moon
title: Stemilt Creek 2016 Ascent One-Half Mile Closer to the Moon Rosé (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: This is a fat wine with ripe fruits and a strawberry flavors. The palate is dry, with a soft texture. Drink now.
title: Adega Vila Real 2016 Colheita Rosé (Douro)

description: Interestingly released after the softer 2009 version of this wine, this 2008 vintage is beautifully balanced between crisp fruit and ripe maturity. With its red fruits still in place, it also has a toasty yeasty edge that is sophisticated and enticing. It is a superb wine, delicious to drink now although because of the quality of the vintage it will age for many more years, certainly into the 2020s.
title: Louis Roederer 2008 Cristal Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Brilliantly fresh wine, with vivid acidity, and attractive apple skin texture and final mouth-watering crispness.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2009 Note Bleue Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This is one of the darker, fuller-bodied, richer rosés on the market. It almost has the weight of a red wine. Dry and zesty in acidity, it features powerful flavors of cherries, strawberries, cola and spices. A great wine for beef, pork and tuna. Don't drink it too cold.
title: Fort Ross 2010 Fort Ross Vineyard Rosé of Pinot Noir (Sonoma Coast)

description: Ideal Spanish rosé in every way, from color to aromas to flavors to the price tag. The nose is inviting, with delicate, crisp fruit aromas. The feel is just right, propelled by bright acids. Tastes of raspberry and watermelon, while the finish is long and lightly spicy. What a quaffing rosado should be.
title: Marqués de Cáceres 2010 Rosé (Rioja)

description: This light-bodied wine made from Grenache has a deep pink color with a hint of orange, light cherry and raspberry aromas and a touch of spicy-earthy flavor among the fruit nuances. It feels very smooth and easy in the mouth and has a soft finish.
title: Rock Wall 2014 Uncle Roget's Rosé (Yolo County)

description: Very pale in color, this spice and red-fruit flavored wine is refreshing and crisp. It's a light wine, cut through by acidity and floral undertones. Drink this attractive wine now.
title: Domaine François Schmitt NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This rosé is a blend of Tinta Roriz and Tinta Francisca. Its wood aging has smoothed out the bright fruit, replacing it with a rich, creamy, warm character. With firm acidity and ripe raspberry touches, it's a full wine that is ready to drink.
title: Quinta Nova de Nossa Senhora do Carmo 2015 Reserva Rosé (Douro)
winery: Quinta Nova de Nossa Senhora do Carmo

description: From a small family estate named for the fireflies that live around the vineyard, this is crisp, with enough fruitiness to balance the acidity. It's light, refreshing and ready for warm-weather enjoyment.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2016 Domaine des Bellugues Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: Tart, citrusy fruit flavors with some herbal overtones contrast with this wine's ample weight, while the finish is crisp and zesty. Drink now.
title: Streicker 2016 Bridgeland Block Rosé (Margaret River)

description: Produced from old vines, this is a crisp, bright wine. Its caramel and perfumes give it an exotic edge while acidity keeps everything lively. It is ready to drink.
title: Wines & Winemakers 2016 Lua Cheia em Vinhas Velhas Rosé (Douro)

description: This wine is very soft ,with only light acidity to balance the raspberry fruitiness. What makes this wine is its aftertaste with a final crisp bite. Drink now.
title: Herdade do Rocim 2016 Mariana Rosé (Alentejano)

description: Light pink in color, this wine offers laser-sharp, zesty aromas, with pink limeade, pink grapefruit and crushed white-rock scents. There's lots of life to the palate, where a cement minerality unites ripe flavors of watermelon, tart nectarine, white peach and strawberry.
title: Malene Wines 2015 Rosé (Central Coast)

description: Floral notes play about the tart berry fruit of this harmonious and generously fruited fizz. The palate is exuberant with lively red-berry fruit while creamy notes of biscuit and oatmeal provide a wonderful balance. This is fresh and frothy, creamy and utterly irresistible. The lasting finish is wonderfully dry.
title: Ridgeview Estate 2014 Fitzrovia Rosé Sparkling (England)

description: Sought-after vineyard grower Charles Heintz has teamed with stellar Sonoma County winemaker Hugh Chappelle (Lynmar, Quivira) to make this divine estate-grown Rosé, pale pink in the glass with hugely inviting floral aromatics. From there is a bolt of electricity, the wine juicy and alive in peach, citrus and strawberry, mouthwatering and light.
title: Charles Heintz 2013 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Sonoma Coast)

description: Melon aromas are a touch mealy and suggest cantaloupe that's past its peak. A foamy palate is coarse, while tastes of burnt orange and red plum. On the finish, this dissipates quickly.
title: Vicente Gandia NV El Miracle Brut Rosé Sparkling (Cava)

description: Fun and quenching, this crisp, informal sparkler delivers ripe green apple and pear flavors. Vibrant acidity gives it a clean finish.
title: Villa Sandi NV Il Fresco Brut  (Prosecco Treviso)

description: This fresh simple sparkler opens with aromas of jasmine and a whiff of citrus. On the soft palate, tangy acidity lifts apple, white peach and a hint of glazed lemon peel.
title: Bocelli NV Terre Gaie Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Aromas of acacia, bitter almond and mature yellow apple carry over to the easygoing off-dry palate along with a candied lemon drop note. It's soft and simple, with a light mousse.
title: Canella NV Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Opening with subtle aromas of white flower, this lively straightforward sparkler doles out yellow apple and citrus zest. Crisp acidity gives it a refreshing finish.
title: Caposaldo NV Brut  (Prosecco)

description: Aromas of green apple and Bartlett pear take center stage on this soft easygoing sparkler. The foaming off-dry palate mirrors the nose, offering white orchard fruit and a hint of citrus drop.
title: Col di Rocca NV Extra Dry  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Aromas of exotic fruit carry over to the off-dry palate along with white stone fruit, candied citrus peel and a note of glazed pastry. Fresh acidity lifts the rich flavors.
title: Andreola NV Vérv Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: Here's a crisp, no-frills sparkler that offers yellow apple and pear flavors. It's invigorating, with brisk acidity and vivacious bubbles.
title: Ruggeri & C. NV Argeo Brut  (Prosecco Treviso)

description: Fragrant raspberries are the attraction of this ripe medium-sweet and fruity wine. It has acidity and a crisp edge to balance the sugary fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Bougrier 2016 Pure Loire  (Rosé d'Anjou)

description: Simple and fresh, this informal sparkler has light aromas of citrus and apple. The aromas carry over to the crisp palate along with brisk bubbles.
title: Voga NV  Prosecco

description: Light pink in the glass, this Pinot Noir-based wine shows pink lemonade, lime and watermelon on the nose alongside wet cement. There is lots of tangy power and fresh energy on the palate, with lemon-zest flavors making the tongue sizzle and cleaning the mouth perfectly.
title: Bernardus 2014 Rosé (Santa Lucia Highlands)

description: Enticing scents of jasmine, wisteria and white stone fruit lead the way. The vibrant palate doles out green apple, juicy pear and white peach accompanied by a soft mousse. A white almond note closes the crisp finish.
designation: Rive di Santo Stefano Brut Millesimato
title: Mionetto 2014 Rive di Santo Stefano Brut Millesimato  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Made entirely from Pinot Nero, this fragrant Metodo Classico offers tantalizing red berry, citrus, rose and cake spice scents. It's bright and elegantly sparkling, delivering juicy strawberry, tart cherry, tangerine and pastry cream flavors, framed by crisp acidity. A hint of cinnamon closes the quenching finish, calling for a second bottle.
title: Marchesi de' Frescobaldi 2012 Leonia Rosé Metodo Classico Pinot Nero (Pomino)

description: Delicate and dry, this offers lightly spicy strawberry fruit and supporting acids. It's pretty and pale, light but not dilute, and would be an ideal match to a pork dish with a fruit sauce.
title: Rainstorm 2014 Silver Linings Pinot Noir Rosé (Oregon)

description: This is the casual sipper of the Château de Nages rosé pair, offering slightly briny, fumé notes on the nose, but following them up with peach and melon fruit flavors that finish long, crisp and dry.
title: Château de Nages 2014 Buti Nages Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This is a stony, savory style of rosé, with its ample weight backed by firm acids and only modest melon fruit. It's a style better suited to food than casual sipping on its own.
title: Château de Nages 2014 Vieilles Vignes Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: There is a vivid pink color on this caramel and ripe fruit-flavored wine. It has weight, probably too much, losing the freshness and acidity. Vanilla and super-ripe strawberries dominate.
title: Château Ramage la Batisse 2012 La Rosée de Ramage Red (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: With its day-glo pink color, this smells stalky and lacks the aromatic freshness one seeks in rosé. The mouthfeel is reasonably lively and grabby, with briny, pickled citrus flavors in front of a briny tasting finish.
title: Dinastía Vivanco 2011 Vivanco Tempranillo-Garnacha Rosé (Rioja)

description: With almost no color, this spritzy rosado is prickly and feline on the nose, like Sauvignon Blanc or Verdejo. The palate is lightly bubbly, with bounce and tart tangerine and herbal flavors. Txomin Etxaníz has never made a commercial rosé prior to this. This makes you wonder why they did.
title: Txomín Etxaníz 2011 Getaria Rosé (Getariako Txakolina)

description: Coming in one of the more beautifully shaped bottles on the market, which enhances the pretty light-pink color, this wine shows light, brisk raspberry fruit and a rain-on-cement minerality. The flavors are expectedly light, with just a touch of strawberry fruit, slight lime bitterness and a tongue-exciting texture.
title: McIntyre Vineyards 2014 Estate Rose of Pinot Noir (Santa Lucia Highlands)

description: Slightly dusty, herbal notes distract from pleasant peach and strawberry flavors in this dry rosé made from Pinot Noir along with a splash of Chardonnay. It's delicate in concentration but refreshing on the palate.
title: Atwater 2012 Dry Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: Crafted from a mix of 48% Syrah, 45% Grenache and 7% Mourvèdre, this aromatic rosé is spicy and bursting with star fruit, citrus, apple, pear, apricot and more. It's a lively full-bodied wine with a smooth finish.
title: Quady North 2016 Rosé (Rogue Valley)

description: This expression of Chardonnay from Basilicata delivers aromas of butterscotch, apricot and pear. The wine tastes rich and dense and ends on a bright, menthol-like note.
title: Bisceglia 2007 Bosco delle Rose Chardonnay (Basilicata)

description: This brightly colored rosé from northeastern Italy offers aromas of small berry fruit and delicate floral tones. It tastes clean and crisp and leaves a cheerful endnote of fresh berry flavors.
title: Blason 2007 Rosato Rosé (Venezia Giulia)

description: This wine does a good job of transforming ripe Pinot grapes, with all their raspberry and cherry fruit, into a rosé that's ethereal and delicate. The wine is dry and the alcohol level is moderate, making it delicate and crisp in the mouth.
title: Cartograph 2012 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Russian River Valley)

description: Crisp and spicy, this blush has slightly sweet flavors of raspberries, red currants, lavender and vanilla.
title: JCB 2007 No. 69 Pinot Noir Rosé (Russian River Valley)

description: Fairly deep in color for a sparkling rosé, Sparr's Brut Rosé offers bold, berry-like aromas with hints of spring flowers and a plump, slightly corpulent feel in the mouth. The flavors are a bit rustic, with hints of underbrush and scorched earth.
title: Pierre Sparr NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Alsace)

description: Red in color, and definitely smelling and tasting like Malbec. And while you want to like it more, there are some glaring flaws here, namely a weak bead that turns it flat. Furthermore, there's rhubarby sourness at the core. Has its moments but needs more work.
title: Reginato 2007 Celestina Rosé of Malbec Sparkling (Mendoza)

description: A little sweet and one-dimensional, with candied flavors of raspberries and limes.
title: Korbel NV Brut Rose Sparkling (California)

description: With its beautiful pale pink color and bright fruitiness, this delicious wine also has a good depth of texture, mineral strength and tight acidity. Even though it is now six years old, it is showing no sign of maturity, so drink from 2016.
title: Mailly Grand Cru 2008 L'Intemporelle Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This rich, reddish-orange wine has aromas like sour-cherry candy. Tasty, dry and complex fruit flavors suggest cherry, cranberry and tamarind, with a smooth texture and full body. It's made from 74% Grenache and 25% Mourvèdre.
title: Longevity 2015 Rose of Deb-ru-vée Rosé (Livermore Valley)

description: A just off-dry rosé with great fresh fruit, attractive red currants and vanilla flavor. This is bright, clean, delicious as a food rosé. Screwcap.
title: Bacalhôa Wines of Portugal 2010 JP Rosé (Setubal)

description: Producer of one of the first rosé Vinho Verde, Casa do Valle continues to make one of the best. Full of delicious strawberry flavors with great acidity, deliciously fruity.
title: Casa do Valle 2010 Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: For a Bordeaux rosé, this is fresh and delicious in a light, fruity style, and immediately appealing. Not for aging, of course, but with a good touch of acidity as well as vanilla. Screwcap.
title: Château Suau 2010 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: With a pale copper color, this is a full-bodied sparkler whose orange, raspberry and vanilla flavors offer plenty of satisfaction. It's a little sweet, but fine acidity and a scour of bubbles provide clean balance.
title: Korbel NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (California)

description: Pale salmon rosé, with peach and melon aromas. It's dry and minerally on the palate, with mouthwatering acids that linger on the finish.
title: Marrenon 2010 Grand Toque Rosé (Luberon)

description: Candied slightly cooked strawberry and cherry notes permeate through this ripe ruddy off-dry rosé. Made from Pinot Meunier, it finishes with a whisper of dried savory thyme and lavender notes. Drink now.
title: Blümel 2013 Pinot Meunier Rosé (Rheinhessen)

description: This luminous non-DOC Prosecco opens with bright floral notes of white flower and rose backed by sweet pear and white peach. The wine offers creamy foam and a thick, sweet impression in the mouth backed by just the right measure of cooling acidity.
title: Pitars NV Pitars Extra Dry  (Prosecco del Veneto)

description: Bright fruit notes of stone fruit, citrus and honey appear in an immediate and direct way and are followed by jasmine and chopped white pepper. Pair this luminous sparkler with fried fish sticks or breaded green olives.
title: Ruggeri & C. NV Gold Label Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: This sparkling wine boasts a dark pink color and intensely fragrant tones of raspberry, cranberry, fresh flowers, cut grass and dandelions. It is executed in a light, easy style and makes for a fun afternoon-with-friends sipping wine.
title: Colutta NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Friuli)

description: Peach-pink in color, this vibrant rosé sparkler offers unique aromas of cut grass, dried flowers and forest berries. It's an easy-going wine that would pair well with appetizers thanks to its crisp, fresh feel.
title: Costaripa NV Brut Rosé  (Lugana)

description: A sweet, candy-like note appears at first and is followed by slight tones of yellow fruit and butterscotch. Yet this is a compact and linear sparkler that is pulled tightly together by the mineral notes that define it. It ends on a fruity but acidic note.
title: Cà Vittoria NV Costa dei Peschi Brut  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: Fresh notes of citrus, lime and kiwi open this bright and tonic sparkler made from the popular Prosecco grape. This wine in particular offers an extremely fresh mouthfeel and you can taste peach and lemon flavors over its crisp, slightly sweet finish.
title: Viticoltori Ponte NV Brut  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: Expanding from his Provence château, Sacha Lichine's new rosé is a blend from across the south of France. It's crisp, fruity, with a touch of sweetness, giving a soft, red berry fruit texture and light, fresh acidity.
title: Sacha Lichine 2013 SLS Single Blend Rosé (Vin de France)

description: Light and fruity, this wine is soft, with a sweeter touch than is sometimes found in Provence rosés. The blend includes Cabernet Sauvignon, giving a tannic edge as well as caramel and sweet raspberry flavors.
region_1: Vin de Pays de la Méditerranée
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2013 Le Petit Gueissard Rosé (Vin de Pays de la Méditerranée)

description: Red-currant, strawberries and a touch of passion fruit almost give this a summer-cocktail vibe. It's very refreshing, with frothy, lively fizz. This wine spells party mood and is ideal for informal gatherings with its fun, off-dry and utterly fruit-driven nature.
title: Muenzenrieder 2013 Rosecco Der Rosenfrizzante Zweigelt (Österreichischer Perlwein)

description: With its bold aromas of cotton candy and two-cent bubblegum, this is just too tutti-frutti to rate higher. That said, if you like the style, it's a solid, well-made example, filled with bouncy fruit while finishing dry and refreshing.
title: Dauvergne & Ranvier 2013 Domaine des Muretins  (Tavel)

description: Ripe flavors of apple and pear highlight this expressive and easy-drinking wine. It's medium bodied and solidly built, with a hint of graham cracker running through the finish.
title: Melrose 2015 Chardonnay (Umpqua Valley)

description: Young and spicy, this is bursting with bright fruit flavors of cranberry and cherry. Flavors of cola and Dr. Pepper come through also, and the up-front freshness carries throughout. Enjoy this lovely wine now through 2018.
title: Melrose 2015 Syrah (Umpqua Valley)

description: This interesting and complex rosé—made from 65% Grenache, 25% Mourvèdre, 7% Vermentino and 3% Viognier—is aged for six months in oak. The resulting wine is a cellar-worthy selection that boasts upfront notes of toasted spice, lemon custard, vanilla bean and ripe red berries. The oak influence currently dominates the plush and generous palate, while the creamy texture and lingering smoky spice are enticingly decadent. While you can enjoy this rich wine now, give it some time for the oak to mellow and further integrate with the fruit; drink now–2017.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2014 Château La Sauvageonne GMVV Rosé (Coteaux du Languedoc)

description: Soft and full of red fruit, with balanced acidity, this is a rich style of rosé. Its generous texture has a crisp edge that lifts its full, creamy character. Drink now.
title: Clos Teddi 2016 Rosé (Patrimonio)

description: A very pale flamingo-pink rosé, this is moderately confected in style, but vibrant and fresh. Cotton candy notes are balanced by peachy fruit and some floral elements, while the finish is mouthwatering. Drink up.
title: Louis Bernard 2012 Rosé (Côtes du Rhône)

description: The attractive new label design introduces this clean, simple, pleasant rosé, a blend of Pinot Noir and 7% Pinot Meunier. Quite foamy, it subsides into a pale pink wine with hints of strawberry fruit.
title: Michelle NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Despite its unusual, five-grape blend, this is a well-balanced rosé with a fruity mix of cranberry, cherry, raspberry and watermelon flavors. It's light, forward, a little on the soda pop side, but quite nice for sipping or accompanying something as substantial as your holiday turkey.
title: Milbrandt 2012 Traditions Rosé (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: This is a very fresh and fragrant style of Tavel, which can often be a bit weightier in style. Bubble gum and passion fruit aromas give way to citrus and berry flavors on the palate, finishing soft and easy. It should easily last at least well into the spring.
title: Château de Trinquevedel 2012  Tavel

description: Creamy and frothy, here is a fruit-forward Prosecco Dry with pretty aromas of fresh apple and cherry blossoms. The wine has a delicate, feminine disposition and a generous texture in the mouth that recalls peaches and cream.
title: La Tordera NV Dry  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: Here's a dryer, more mineral-driven take on a Prosecco Dry with pretty floral notes and subdued notes of stone fruit and pear. The wine is easy and streamlined in the mouth with a full palate of fruit flavors.
title: Le Colture NV Cruner Dry  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: Made from grapes picked early specifically for rosé, this bone-dry wine keeps alcohol low and flavors rich. A pale copper hue, it offers flavors that mimic a cava, without the bubbles. Racy minerality underscores a juicy, fruit-driven palate of lemon, lime and orange. A hint of coffee and crème brulée pokes through the refreshing finish.
title: Cayuse 2012 Edith Armada Vineyard Grenache Rosé (Walla Walla Valley (OR))

description: This is Mordorée's top cuvée of Tavel, and it earns that distinction by virtue of its length and stoniness on the finish. There's a hint of garrigue to the cherry aromas and a plump, complex midpalate as well. Drink it over the next year or two.
title: Domaine de la Mordorée 2013 La Reine Des Bois  (Tavel)

description: This nonvintage rosé, modeled after a Bandol, is a blend of grapes and vintages, yet retains superb freshness and offers unusual complexity. Rich and tart, with a creamy strawberry core, it also shows sandalwood highlights and a hint of barrel toast.
title: Domaine Serene NV R Dry Rosé (Oregon)

description: From entirely estate-grown Pinot Noir (70%) and Chardonnay (30%), this dry sparkling is vivacious and fun, crisp in apple, pear and raspberry. Lively, lemony acidity lifts the palate. Complementing the freshness is the rounded plushness of ripe fruit and an earthy accent.
title: Balletto 2012 Brut Rosé Méthode Traditionelle Sparkling (Russian River Valley)

description: Syrah (61%), Mourvèdre and Gre-nache make up the bulk of this appealing wine. Bright aromas of strawberry candy, watermelon and orange rind are followed by mouthwatering citrus and cherry flavors.
title: Charles & Charles 2015 Rosé (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Musky aromas of lychee and orange are easy to peg as Torrontés. On the palate, there's zest and acid but not much substance. Tangy and tropical in flavors, and shallow in body, this is just o.k. Includes 5% Malbec for color.
title: El Esteco 2014 Amaru High Vineyards Torrontés Rosé (Calchaquí Valley)

description: This is hardly a fashionable color for rosé, deep and almost like a light red wine. It tastes heavy, although the red fruits are cut by ample acidity. The finish is rich and ripe.
title: Casa do Valle 2014 Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: This crisp and fruity wine has intense raspberry flavors along with equally dominant acidity. It's tangy, tight and just off dry, with a bright, perfumed aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Casca Wines 2014 Cascas Winemaker Selection Rosé (Lisboa)

description: A murky appearance, earthy aromas and mineral-like flavors add up to an eccentric wine. The balance is soft rather than crisp and the body light. Since the winemaker leaves a good portion of lees in the bottle, it's best to stand it up for a few hours before pouring slowly.
title: La Clarine Farm 2014 Rosé (Sierra Foothills)

description: Made from 80% Pinot Noir and 20% Chardonnay, this dances in cherry and orange brightness within a construct of white peach. The pretty-in-pink color gives way to buzzing acidity and freshness before a medium-strength creaminess flows through on the finish.
title: Mumm Napa NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Napa County)

description: Crisp peach and red-fruit flavors combine with vibrant acidity and energizing, fine bubbles to create a balanced and rich sparkling wine. A spicy, crisp fruit character lingers long on the finish.
title: Roederer Estate NV Estate Bottled Brut Rosé Sparkling (Anderson Valley)

description: Made from 50% Grenache, 30% Cinsault and 20% Syrah, this is a vibrant, floral rosé, offering upfront aromas of iris, lavender and laurel that complement the raspberry and strawberry-hull core. The fruity palate is bright and refreshing, with ample acidity and just a hint of orange blossom on the finish.
title: Côté Mas 2012 Rosé Aurore Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: This restrained, salmon-tinged rosé teases with riper fruit, even with a red-berry compote of red currant and strawberry. The plump fruit is held in a dry frame and tempered by freshness. Equally tempting with or without food.
title: Unger 2013 Q Rosé (Niederösterreich)

description: Salmon-pink in color, this 100% Chambourcin rosé is alive with watermelon Jolly Ranchers and tart peach. Bright, citrusy and fruity, it's a perfect sipper for hot summer days.
title: Rosemont 2014 Rosé (Virginia)

description: Bonheur—happiness—is an appropriate name for this fresh and crisp wine that comes in a flute à corset bottle. It is fruity, lively with orange and apricot over raspberries. Bright acidity finishes it all in good humor.
title: Thomas Carteron 2014 Le Bonheur Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Dusty mineral and herbal aromas contrast against a palate that's chock full of raspberry and cherry flavor. It's forward with fruit, but a bit strikingly acidic, spiked by a razor-like edge of cranberry and lemon.
title: Knapp 2014 Dry Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: From an estate in the hills above Saint-Tropez, this wine is soft, aromatic and gently fruity. It is as light as a breath of wind, but crisp at the end, with hints of red berry fruitiness.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2014 Château des Launes Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This wine is packed with red fruits, crisp apples and oranges. It is so fresh and bright, with good acidity that gives everything a total lift.
title: Domaine de la Croix 2014 iirrrésistible Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This has a delicious tang of citrus and acidity to go with the crisp red currant fruitiness. It is bright and ready to drink, with refreshing acidity at the end.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2014 Breezette Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Open and ripely fruity, this has fresh acidity, with tight and tangy flavors of lemon zest. A warm, rounded character to the wine puts it firmly as an apéritif.
title: Château Roubine 2014 R de Roubine Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This very pale rosé from Syrah master Andrew Murray shows Pink Lady apple, cantaloupe and spun sugar scents on the nose. It's very fresh on the palate, with lively acidity that cuts through the riper cantaloupe and other melon flavors on the midpalate. Chalky texture raises it above many other rosés.
title: Andrew Murray 2016 Esperance Curtis Vineyard Rosé (Santa Ynez Valley)

description: This is classy in every way, from the label to the aromatics to the mouthfeel to the elegant finish. It's a New World take on a Sancerre rouge: delicate and bone dry, yet substantial and utterly delicious. Citrus rind, persimmon, strawberry and a hint of chocolate combine, with a lingering graceful finish.
title: Domaine Divio 2016 Rosé (Willamette Valley)

description: Hot, soft and uninteresting. It's not a bad wine, being clean and somewhat dry, but that softness results in a serious absence of structure, and there's not enough fruity essence to compensate.
title: Rosenblum 2005 Richard Sauret Vineyard Zinfandel (Paso Robles)
