description: The nose offers minor essences of apple core and more pronounced notes of wet minerality. On the palate, more refreshingly acidic characteristics shine with flavors of ripe rhubarb and red cherry. A rosé perfectly designed for enjoying with food.
title: Domaine de Nizas 2007 Rosé (Coteaux du Languedoc)

description: Offers heady aromas of mashed peaches, banana, blueberry and walnut. The palate matches the nose in flavors and intensity, but is lifted by the vibrant acidity and somewhat prickly texture. Finishes clean with moderate length.
designation: Famille Grassa Rosé de Pressée Merlot-Syrah-Tannat
region_1: Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne
title: Domaine du Tariquet 2007 Famille Grassa Rosé de Pressée Merlot-Syrah-Tannat Rosé (Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Fresh and lively with flavors of strawberry, cherry, raspberry and red plum pulp. The acidity subdues the stronger fruit flavors on the palate, balancing everything out nicely. Moderate weight with a full texture and a zingy, lingering finish.
title: Les Jamelles 2007 Rosé Cinsault (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: A crisp, fresh, intensely dry wine that is balanced by some ripe caramel and red currant flavors. This is a rosé in the Provence tradition, dry, designed for food.
title: Moulin de Gassac 2006 Le Mazet Rosé Red (Vin de Pays de L'Herault)

description: This otherwise fruity wine has a rustic edge. It gives an unattractive herbal character that may come from underripe grapes.
title: Château Haut Mouleyre 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Whole berry pressed with 11% saignee from Syrah and Primitivo rounding out the blend, it's a very pretty, pale salmon color with notes of strawberry, watermelon and mineral. It drinks medium sweet with abundant cherry flavors.
title: Gecko 2012 Barbera Rosé (Wahluke Slope)

description: A full and rounded wine, touched by caramel as well as red plum and ripe strawberries. It is generous, with a soft, open aftertaste. There is a light texture from the acidity that creeps in at the end.
title: Château Saint-Sernin 2012 Domaine Saint-Sernin Fare Saint-Sernin Rosé (Côtes du Lot)

description: A rare Pinot Noir rosé from Washington state, this is unabashedly ripe and pink, but not at all sugary. It offers a burst of strawberry and watermelon candy flavors, like a good, long lasting taste of saltwater taffy.
title: J Bell Cellars 2012 Pino Rosé (Yakima Valley)

description: Red cherry, clove, cola and a touch of pepper make for an intriguing nose on this rosé. The palate is a touch viscous, lacking the expected brisk acidity, but it's quite flavorful—more cherry and spice flavors with a hint of wild game.
title: De Tierra 2015 Rosé (Monterey)

description: Named after Léonie Duchêne, one of the founders of the company, this is a toasty bottling. It has an onion-skin pink color and delicate aromas of red fruits which show on the palate, along with a crisp and dry acidity. Ready to drink.
title: Canard-Duchêne NV Cuvée Léonie Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This rosé opens with a floral and fruity fragrance of orange blossom and strawberry. The palate delivers white cherry, creamy berry, Alpine herb, clove and cinnamon notes. The wine is fresh and elegantly sparkling.
title: Cola NV Athena Rosé Sparkling (Franciacorta)

description: Bright, crisp raspberry flavors on a bone-dry wine. It is fresh and vibrant, a light touch of caramel and powerful acidity.
title: Campelo 2009 Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: There are enticing notes here of caramel and butterscotch that are so minute and delicate they come across as accents. Beyond those notes is Granny Smith apple and chopped fruit, over a smooth, soft texture.
title: Cirotto NV Extra Dry Prosecco (Montello e Colli Asolani)

description: This is a neutral wine with little in terms of aromatic intensity although it does not lack in definition. The goal here is to keep the palate refreshed as a before-dinner drink, and this well-priced sparkler definitely gets the job done.
title: Zardetto NV Brut  (Prosecco del Veneto)

description: A bone-dry, refreshing rosé, with tight acidity and crisp red berry and apple flavors. Classic summertime wine. Screwcap.
title: Gunter Triebaumer 2007 Rosé von der Blaufränkisch (Burgenland)

description: This is a simple, genuine Prosecco Brut with pretty tones of peach and apricot and drying mineral tones. It has a smooth creamy quality with stone fruit flavors on the close.
title: Malibràn NV Ruio Brut  (Prosecco di Valdobbiadene)

description: This is a neutral, mineral-driven Prosecco Extra Dry with a thin groundwork of peachy fruit at the forefront of sparking effervescence and pristine luminosity. It does offer lingering sweet peach flavors on the palate.
title: Montesel NV Vigna del Paradiso Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: This is a broad, round Prosecco that doesn't offer detailed aromatic highlights but instead delivers a steady dose of Golden Delicious apple, pear and honeysuckle. It's got character and grit and offers steely effervescence.
title: Vigneti Fantinel NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco del Veneto)

description: The nose of this luminous sparkler focuses on honey, acacia flower and a hint of almond nut. The bubbling is steady and direct, leaving soda-like effervescence in the mouth with little creaminess.
title: Casalnova NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco del Veneto)

description: Rubbery and spicy in the nose, with a hint of orange peel. In the mouth, a heavy flatness sets in fast. The wine seems old, and for a rosé, it is. It just sits on your palate, tasting o.k. but needing a poke in the ribs.
title: Château Ferry Lacombe 2000 Cuvee Lou Cascai Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Almost tan in color, with neutral aromas and a dull, almondy flavor profile. Round and smooth. but all in all it's boring and fading fast.
title: Domaine de la Courtade 2001 L'Alycastre Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This light but vibrant and dry wine smells like fresh peaches, tastes like white raspberries and wakes up the mouth with crisp acidity. A floral character comes out with the second sip, and the mouthfeel seems to broaden and smooth on the finish.
title: Holly's Hill 2014 Estate Rosé (El Dorado)

description: Pale salmon color with some copper hints. Somewhat muted nose with  subtle aromas of ripe red-berry fruit. Crisp with more lift on the palate, vigorous mousse and lively flavors of redcurrant, wild strawberry and cherry. Medium-bodied with some creaminess to the texture that persists on the finish. Well-made but not very complex.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Alsace)

description: A mix of smoke and toast blends with fresh, crisp citrus aromas on the nose. That's followed by a foamy, reactive palate with flavors of pink grapefruit, orange, pepper and caramel. This remains foamy on the finish, which is peppery and slightly bitter in flavor.
title: Sumarroca NV Yá Cuvée 23 Brut Rosé Sparkling (Cava)

description: An attractive yet fresh sparkling Pinot Noir rosé. It has a fine balance with its acidity well integrated into the raspberry fruit flavors. There's just an edge of bitterness that spoils the aftertaste.
title: Huber & Bléger NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This is quite dark, heavy and warm for a rosé, with orange zest, raspberry and vanilla flavors. The fruit is prominent, sacrificing some of the wine's potential elegance.
title: Bruliam 2012 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Sonoma County)

description: At a time when California rosés are marching toward dryness, this one hews to a richer path. It has flavors of raspberries, strawberries and white sugar.
title: Buena Vista 2012 The Count's Selection Pinot Noir Rosé (Sonoma Coast)

description: This is a fresh wine with caramel as well as ripe red-berry flavors. With its textured acidity and crisp, clean aftertaste, it's a wine to drink as an apéritif.
title: Domaine Alban Roblin 2014 Rosé (Sancerre)

description: A pale rosé from Pinot Noir, this is light and fresh, with an intense acidity that cuts through the fruitiness. It's a fine apéritif style with its crisp texture and lively aftertaste.
title: Jean-Michel Sorbe 2014 Rosé (Reuilly)

description: This wine is soft and creamy, although it does seem to miss out on fruit and freshness. It is smooth and ripe, with an aftertaste that is lightly off dry.
title: Monmousseau NV Brut Etoile Rosé Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: In the pale style made fashionable by Provence, this rosé is fruity, crisp and lightly textured. It's an attractive wine, fresh and ready to drink.
title: Philippe Girard 2014 Rosé (Sancerre)

description: This off-dry wine offers ripe strawberry flavors and refreshing acidity. It's a summer-evening drink, although it would do just as well round the fire
title: Marquis de la Tour NV Rosé Brut Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: This blend of Bobal and Garnacha is clean and neutral up front. A healthy feeling palate is highly regular but solid. Standard citrus and currant flavors end with moderate length.
title: Castillo de Liria 2014 Winemaker's Selection Rosé (Valencia)

description: Fruity, young and soft, this is an attractive Touriga Nacional-Syrah wine with strawberry flavors and just a touch of crisp red currant acidity. It's made for this summer, ready to drink.
title: Quinta do Casal Branco 2016 Terra de Lobos Rosé (Tejo)

description: Snappy but briny citrus aromas include pyrazines. In the mouth, this coastal product feels bouncy but regular. Citrusy flavors come with bell-pepper and celery notes, while this is fresh on the finish, but a touch green.
title: Santa Carolina 2016 Reserva Pinot Noir Rosé (Leyda Valley)

description: This is two consecutive vintages of sketchy to poor rosé from this label. This one smells a bit like a swimming pool, while the flavors are of tart nectarine and pickle. Doesn't much cut it.
title: Estancia Piedra 2007 Rosado Rosé (Toro)

description: This shows less intensity than displayed in past vintages. Instead of brawn and power, this is elegant and polished, with aromas of dried fruit, crushed stone and dried herb.
title: Bric Cenciurio 2008 Coste di Rose  (Barolo)

description: Each of Channing Daughter's eight 2011 vintage rosato express a distinct personality, but the Mudd Vineyard Merlot stands out with its seamless integration of ripe, supple fruit with intense minerality and a dewy, floral flair that's irresistible, sip after sip. This is bone dry and begs to be opened as soon as possible.
title: Channing Daughters 2011 Rosato Merlot Mudd Vineyard Rosé (North Fork of Long Island)

description: Definitely one of the better Dolcettos to emerge from Washington State, this includes both Barbera and Tempranillo in the blend. Rich, ripe aromas and flavors mix pie cherry and fresh-cut tobacco, with added layers of coffee, licorice and dark chocolate. A feast for the senses.
title: Wind Rose 2010 Dolcetto (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: This has a simple, streamlined mouthfeel backed by subtle tones of stone fruit and citrus. Overall, this feels fresh and easy.
title: Bele Casel NV Extra Dry  (Asolo Prosecco Superiore)

description: Aromas of peach blossom, red berry and sunbaked earth waft out of the glass. The luminous fruity palate doles out juicy raspberry, red cherry and a hint of Mediterranean herb while a white almond note gives it a pleasantly bitter close.
title: Marulli 2016 Tenuta Paraida Rosato (Copertino)

description: Made entirely with Aglianico, this has alluring delicate scents evoking wild rose and red berry. The vibrant palate offers juicy sour cherry, raspberry and tangerine zest alongside crisp acidity that leaves a bright refreshing finish.
title: Terredora 2016 Rosaenovae Rosato (Irpinia)

description: A terrific expression of its appellation, the 2007 La Dame Rousse from Domaine de la Mordorée starts off a bit tight and minerally on the nose, then explodes on the palate with layers of cherries, peaches, warm stones and dried spices. It's full-bodied and rich, with a long, spice-driven finish. Treat it like a light red, serving it with charcuterie or simple grilled meats, and drink it over the next year or so.
title: Domaine de la Mordorée 2007 La Dame Rousse  (Tavel)

description: This fruit-driven, medium-bodied rosé is a perennially worthy addition to the cooler of poolside staples. Hints of peach and raspberry are ripe but restrained, with just enough thirst-quenching acidity on the finish.
title: Famille Perrin 2015 Réserve Rosé (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A pretty shade of pink bordering on mauve, this bottling shows bright watermelon, fresh strawberry and even red-plum aromas on the nose. The palate is zesty, almost effervescent, with baking-soda texture and lots of energy on the sip but not tons of flavor, with light red-berry elements.
title: Zaca Mesa 2015 Z Gris Rosé (Santa Ynez Valley)

description: Pale in color, this is a drier than usual Rosé d'Anjou. It is fresh, soft with attractive wild strawberry fruits and a touch of orange peel. The wine has a tangy texture that makes it extra refreshing. Drink now.
title: Domaine du Petit Clocher 2015  Rosé d'Anjou

description: Made in a frankly sweet style, this blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay has jellied flavors of raspberries, cherries and toast. It's a little rough in texture.
title: Schramsberg NV Mirabelle Brut Rosé Sparkling (North Coast)

description: This blend of 87% Grenache and 13% Syrah shows red apple, deep strawberry and yeast touches on the fresh and lively nose. It hits the palate with brilliant, tactile energy, delivering rounded red fruit and bubblegum flavors that make it a certain summertime crowd pleaser.
title: Chronic Cellars 2016 Pink Pedals Rosé (Paso Robles)

description: Intensely fruity notes of red currant and raspberry abound on this fragrant full-bodied rosé. It's boldly concentrated on the palate as well, bursting of fresh berry and plum flavors. Primary and juicy in style, yet elegant and penetrating, it's an excellent rosé for year-round consumption—if you can still find a bottle.
title: Dr. Konstantin Frank 2015 Dry Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: While light coral in color, this unusually rich and mouth-filling wine is flavorful, dry and smooth-textured. It smells like watermelon and tastes like ruby grapefruit with just a hint of maple syrup. It is hefty in flavor while light in body, and will be perfect with ham or prosciutto.
title: Terra d'Oro 2015 Rosé (Amador County)

description: While just a touch ripe on the nose, this rosé is wonderfully dry with a bright red plum and cherry compote palate accented by deep, stony minerality. Full bodied, yet pleasantly astringent on the finish, it's the perfect accompaniment to seafood.
title: Korta Katarina 2009 Plavac Mali-Zinfandel Rosé (Peljesac)

description: Named after César the sculptor and not Caesar the Roman emperor, the wine has a strongly herbal character that seems to come from the superripe fruit as well as the landscape around Monte Sainte-Victoire. It is certainly rich, although the acidity balances out the spice and pepper character. Drink now.
title: Château Coussin 2016 César à Sumeire Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: This almost white rosé is produced from selected parcels of the estate. Citrus and pepper dominate, supported by ripe red fruits and delicate acidity. It is a beautiful wine, elegant and with a fine balance between the fruit and the crisp texture. Drink now.
title: Figuière 2016 Confidentielle Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Dating to 1740, this classed-growth estate has vines in the heartland of Côtes de Provence. This wine is lightly herbal, with crisp acidity. Apricot and green herb flavors give a lively character and bring out the crisp, tight texture at the end.
title: Château de Saint Martin 2015 Eternelle Favorite Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Tradition indeed with the traditional skittle bottle. The wine inside is structured with concentration as well as plenty of fruity acidity. It is crisp with red-currant flavors and a bright aftertaste.
title: Château Saint-Pierre 2015 Tradition Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Organic grapes go into this fresh, crisp and fruity wine. With raspberry flavors, it is bone-dry and full of acidity. The wine is refreshing—light and bright.
title: Château Sainte Marguerite 2015 L'Esprit de Sainte Marguerite Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Dominated by Syrah in the blend, this wine is full of red fruits. It comes from vineyards set at up to 1,200 feet, giving a cool edge to the acidity even though the wine is ripe. The aftertaste is full, packed with intense fruitiness.
title: Mirabeau 2015 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A fruity, lightweight wine made from Grenache, this is crisp and bright. With red-currant flavors, some pepper and an edgy tang of bitter oranges, it's totally refreshing. The wine comes from the same stable as the more expensive Château d'Esclans rosés.
title: Sacha Lichine 2015 Single Blend Rosé (Vin de France)

description: Made from a 50-50 combination of old vine Gamay and Charbono, both grown in Calistoga, this wine opens in a nondescript way and offers a thick texture of tannin and density, becoming shyly fruity in the glass, a mix of cherry and strawberry.
title: Tedeschi Family 2014 Rosé (Napa Valley)

description: Made from Grenache, this fresh and deliciously fruity wine has a soft side from its ripe berry fruits and warm acidity. Produced in Languedoc, the wine has a sunny character, full of life and lightness.
title: Le Val 2015 Rosé (Vin de France)

description: Made from organically grown grapes, this is crisp and clean. A straight line of bright red and citrus fruits is sharpened by acidity. It has a refreshing aftertaste.
title: Domaines Pierre Chavin 2015 Villa d'Ariane Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: An intensely fruity rosé, the palate is full with red berries and spirited acidity. It's very fruity, fresh and crisp with a cool-climate feel of bright, light texture. Screwcap.
title: Quinta da Lagoalva de Cima 2012 Espirito Rosé (Tejo)

description: A pretty shallot-skin pink, this fruity, crisp wine has red cherry freshness and a bright level of acidity. With its light mineral texture, it is obviously a food rosé.
title: Domaine Jean-Paul Balland 2014 Rosé (Sancerre)

description: This blend of Mourvèdre (78%) and Grenache is a very pretty pale peach color. Aged in a mixture of concrete, stainless steel and neutral French oak, it suggests aromas of citrus, strawberry, herb and spice. It tingles the palate with fresh, lively flavors, showing poise and presence with a citrus-filled finish that lingers.
title: Efeste 2015 Oldfield Estate Rosé (Yakima Valley)

description: This is an almost smoky, more sophisticated Prosecco with a nutty, almond feel, bigger structure and noticeable succulence. Aromas include Golden Delicious apple and roses. It's a stately rendition that would pair well with a pasta or white meat dish.
title: Astoria 2006 Millesimato Extra Dry  (Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene)

description: Here's a Cartizze Prosecco that favors yellow fruit, pear and mature peach. But this brilliant sparkler is not at all heavy or too ripe: In fact, its elegance and fine workmanship is clear. Mineral notes, kiwi and exotic fruit appear in the mouth.
title: Astoria NV Cartizze  (Prosecco Superiore di Cartizze)

description: A perennial best-of-show winner, this lush take on rosé bursts with pretty cherry fruit, light touches of brioche and fresh-baked rolls. It finishes with a kiss of spice.
title: Barnard Griffin 2012 Rosé of Sangiovese (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Spicy, dusty and juicy, this wine is a mix of black plum and black cherry, supported by whips of anise and bay leaf that give it an herbal element, possibly reflective of the cooler vintage. Medium acidity and firm tannins round out the experience.
title: Rosenblum 2011 Maggie's Reserve Zinfandel (Sonoma Valley)

description: A blend of 50% Grenache and 50% Cinsault from the 50-year-old Pointe de Diable vineyard, this is a soft and ripe wine. It has light acidity and rich red-berry fruits. It's a wine for apéritif drinking—gentle and fruity at the end (the road to the property is called “End of the World”). Drink now.
title: Château Malherbe 2016 Pointe du Diable Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a tangy, fruity wine, with orange and spice flavors. It is rich and full of citrusy acidity, with a tight structure. The wine needs a few more months, so drink from late 2017.
title: Chevalier de Lafoux Sainte Anne 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a warm rounded wine, very approachable with raspberry and damson flavors and crisp acidity. Well balanced, with a lively fruity aftertaste, it is ready to drink now.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2016 Breezette Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wine is dominated by Grenache, which makes up 80% of the blend. That gives the spice and pepper edge as well as bringing out delicious red-berry fruits and crisp acidity. The wine, with its bright aftertaste,is ready to drink now.
title: Domaine des Mapliers 2016 Préferences Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: With a dark enough color to be a red wine and ample cherry and plum flavors, this Grenache bottling is not simply an apéritif. It's full-bodied, rather rich in texture and will pair nicely with meats and cheeses.
title: Troika 2015 Rosé (Mendocino County)

description: Slight reduction dulls this wine's aroma. The palate is light-bodied and fresh, with loads of citrus and appetizing redcurrant notes. The finish is clean, dry and refreshing.
title: Müller-Grossmann 2016 Rosé vom Zweigelt (Niederösterreich)

description: This takes the color rosé to an extreme. Almost white, with only the palest hint of color, it comes from 80-year-old Grenache vines. That creates what little concentration this light and delicate wine has. There is an attractive spicy herbal character that lies at the back of this fruity wine.
title: Domaine Sainte-Marie 2016 VieVité Extraordinaire Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Made from Syrah grapes with purpose, not as a saignée, this is an alluring wine, its aromatics exuberant in wild strawberry and rhubarb, with a pithy, textured vibe. With just the right amount of power and body, it's vibrant and yet has body and weight, retaining substance through the long finish.
title: Cornerstone 2014 Corallina Rosé (Napa Valley)

description: A pretty pale-salmon color, this wine offers appealing aromas of orange peel, strawberry and wet stone. The palate is dry, crisp and clean with mouthwatering acids, a beautiful sense of texture and a lingering finish. It's thoroughly delicious.
title: Maison Bleue 2014 Lisette Rosé of Grenache (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Light, fruity and sweet, this is classic Rosé d'Anjou. Bright strawberry fruits are softly linked with a crisp texture and acidity to finish.
title: Barton & Guestier 2011  Rosé d'Anjou

description: Classic, medium sweet rosé from Anjou, bottled cherry flavors and lemon acidity. Screwcap.
title: Bougrier 2011  Rosé d'Anjou

description: There's a pleasantly light, silky texture on this pretty rose-gold colored blend. It has rich flavors of red cherries, persimmons and spices. One thing to know is that it's quite sweet, like sugared tea.
title: Girl Go Lightly 2011 Rosé (California)

description: Maderized and stalky smelling, with a scratchy palate and grassy, pickled flavors that lean toward strawberry and raspberry.
title: Bodegas Valdemar 2010 Conde de Valdemar Rosado Rosé (Rioja)

description: An awesome rosé, just a tremendous feat. Made from 11 vineyards in 4 counties, it shows a masterful art of the blend. Insanely rich in toasted bread and lees, showing the influence of six years in the bottle. A tremendous core of strawberries, raspberries, orange zest, roasted macadamia, roasted coconut, pear liqueur and honey lasts into the finish. Despite the richness, the wine is dry. So lovely now you can hardly keep your hands off, but it should age gracefully for the next 10–15 years.
title: Schramsberg 2004 J. Schram Rosé Sparkling (North Coast)

description: This is an intense rosé, pushing forward the pink fruit flavors, the rich texture and red berry fruits. Dry, still youthful, it has considerable acidity and a complex and concentrated mélange of flavors. Age for 3–5 years.
title: Louis Roederer 2006 Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: An elegant nose of strawberry, raspberry and lemon is the start of this poised rosé. Unfolding fruit and citrus flavors keep the wine balanced and clean, but the overall character is feminine and soft. A very pretty wine with a classic touch.
title: Juno 2008 Cape Maidens Rosé (Western Cape)

description: Earthy aromas of underbrush, tobacco and new leather lead the way while the structured, spicy palate offers Morello cherry, clove, ground pepper and licorice. Firm, refined tannins provide the framework.
title: Poderi Colla 2012 Bussia Dardi Le Rose  (Barolo)

description: Strawberry and pink grapefruit aromas mingle enticingly on the nose. But on the palate it seems a bit syrupy and heavy, finishing with a touch of cola.
title: Miguel Torres 2000 Rosé (Curicó Valley)

description: This rosé opens with a pretty shade of pink and offers aromas of forest berry, cherry, herbs and a touch of ash or white mineral. There's firm, crisp acidity that really keeps the palate refreshed. Shows loads of cheer and brightness in the mouth.
title: Paolo Calì 2008 Osa! Frappato Rosato Rosé (Sicilia)

description: Intensely floral aromatics distinguish this pure varietal wine. Those body powder scents linger in a soft, lightly floral palate, along with flavors of citrus flesh and rind.
title: Melrose 2013 Viognier (Umpqua Valley)

description: This wine has ripe red fruits, a touch of caramel and some spice. A definite mineral and tannic structure gives the wine a textured character. It needs food to show at its best.
title: Château Cantelaudette 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Light and fruity, the wine comes from the sandy soils of the Camargue Rhône-delta region, known for its rugged, indigenous horses. The wine is crisp with acidity and has a bright touch of red currants. The wine is dry, refreshing for an apéritif.
title: Domaine Royal de Jarras 2015 Pink Flamingo Rosé (Sable de Camargue)

description: Youthful raspberry and strawberry aromas bring a little cotton candy as well, while the palate is round, a touch soft and shows bouncy berry and citrus flavors. Solid and tastes just about right, but a bit cloying toward the end.
title: Melipal 2009 Malbec Rosé Malbec (Mendoza)

description: Simple and dull, with soft flavors of Lifesaver candy raspberries and vanilla.
title: Christine Andrew 2008 Rosé of Malbec (Lodi)

description: Matchstick sulfur and background red-fruit aromas lead into a simple palate that's wet and lively but doesn't offer a lot to latch onto. Generic citrus and cherry Lifesaver flavors finish with a note of briny salt.
title: Artadi 2014 Artazuri Rosado (Navarra)

description: Produced from Pinot Gris, this is so crisp and fresh. It has light red currant flavors that give an intensely fruity character to this attractive wine that is ready to drink now.
title: Denis Jamain 2014 Rosé (Reuilly)

description: Aromas of wet rock, chewing gum and mild citrus fruits are straight down the middle. This feels modest, while cottony flavors of citrus and watermelon finish short and easy.
title: Príncipe de Viana 2014 Edición Rosa Rosé (Navarra)

description: A whiff of red-apple skins, red plum and spice make for a reasonably clean and fresh nose. This feels plump but still vital. Pithy flavors of citrus and cantaloupe turn more pithy on the finish.
title: Despierta 2014 Rosé (La Mancha)

description: Reuilly has the peculiarity of having rosés from Pinot Gris, even though its reds are from Pinot Noir. This perfumed wine with its pale color brings out the slightly dusty character of the grape. That's contrasted with the intense acidity and black currant fruit flavors. Drink now.
title: Domaine Dyckerhoff 2014 Petit Gris Rosé (Reuilly)

description: While this foamy rosé is not elevated, it should appeal to those who like sweet Moscato bubblies. Candied flavors of raspberry, lychee and dried mango finish with a note of pineapple syrup.
title: Tussock Jumper 2013 Moscato Rosé (Valencia)

description: The wine is soft and gentle, with hints of strawberry fruits and freshness. It's light, but has a crisp and spicy aftertaste.
title: Barton & Guestier 2014 Passeport Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is soft, gentle, ripely fruity and immediately drinkable. Fresh raspberry flavors are cut with acidity and lemon zest. It is fresh, balanced and full of flavor.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2014 Domaine Carambole Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Intense acidity combines with spice and just the right amount of fresh fruitiness to give this lively wine that's full in the mouth. It's ripe and ready to drink.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2014 Saint-Roch-les-Vignes Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: A blend of 70% Grenache and 30% Mourvèdre, this is an invitingly juicy and spicy rosé, packed with strawberry-mint and pomegranate flavors and a long, savory finish. It's a great introduction to this winery and its talent for creating Rhône-inspired wines.
title: Baiocchi Wines 2011 Neophyte Rosé (Fair Play)

description: Made from Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, this is one of the winery's best Pompadours of the last four years. It's rich and delicious, with yeasty flavors of raspberries, strawberries, vanilla, toast and honey. It's beautiful to drink now with pâté, scrambled eggs and smoked salmon.
designation: Cuvée de la Pompadour Brut Rosé
title: Domaine Carneros NV Cuvée de la Pompadour Brut Rosé Sparkling (Carneros)

description: Sexy, luscious aromas of buttered plums and seared beef fat invite the nose on this blend of 70% Syrah and 30% Mourvèdre, which proves more delicate than brawny. Beef char and blackberry paste power the palate, but it coalesces around a focused line of licorice and graphite.
designation: Either Side of the Hill Glenrose Vineyard
title: Paix Sur Terre 2013 Either Side of the Hill Glenrose Vineyard Red (Adelaida District)

description: Marked by sugary orange, apricot, lemon and vanilla flavors, this Viognier is a bit simple on its own. Balanced with crisp acidity, it will pair well with slghtly sweet Asian fare.
title: Adelaida 2011 Glenrose & Anna's Vineyard Viognier (Paso Robles)

description: The pale, pretty salmon-pink color suggests this wine's delicacy of mouthfeel. It's nice and light, with raspberry, strawberry and vanilla flavors, but turns too sugary sweet on the finish for true balance.
title: Black Stallion 2012 Syrah Rosé (Napa Valley)

description: A pale onion-skin color sets the stage for this light, fresh and fruity wine. It has red-fruit flavors, lively acidity and a soft, ready-to-drink character. Refreshing without great depths.
title: Canard-Duchêne NV Authentique Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Ripe yellow plum and plump, red-cheeked apricot lead a merry dance. Light, clear honey fills any gaps while notions of passion fruit and lemony acid temper the richness. A very, very fresh-fruited TBA with immense liveliness.
title: Rosenhof 2012 Trockenbeerenauslese Welschriesling (Burgenland)

description: A lovely wine with a bright and polished bouquet, this delivers loads of dark fruit, licorice, moist earth, Spanish cedar and white truffle. Its complexity and endurance are impressive. Thanks to the tight tannins, this wine should easily evolve over the next 10–20 years.
title: Marchesi di Barolo 2007 Coste di Rose  (Barolo)

description: A blend of Syrah and Touriga Nacional , this has a vivid pink color, and a soft, aromatic character. It is ripe and crisp, packed with strawberry juice fruit.
title: Falua 2009 Conde de Vimioso Colheita Seleccionada Rosé (Tejo)

description: Cheerful, fragrant and bright, this opens with aromas of lemon blossom, white almond and stone fruit. It shows tonic, firm bubbling.
title: Botter NV Spago  (Prosecco)

description: This is made in a fruity style, with attractive red-fruit flavors. It is dry and laced with acidity. It has richness, a full body and refreshing final acidity.
title: Jaffelin NV Brut Rosé  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: With its red berry flavor and touch of citrus, this is very fruity. It's attractive, crisp and open.
title: Roland Champion NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A pale rosé in color, this light and fruity wine has a fresh raspberry flavor, with a zingy texture that gives attractive acidity. It's light and creamy, hinting at yeastiness on the finish.
title: Domaine Zinck NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: From Feudi di San Gregorio's Bolgheri estate, this blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah boasts heady aromas of chopped Mediterranean herb and wild berry. Elegant and expressive, the palate doles out juicy morello cherry, raspberry and a savory hint of ground pepper.
title: Campo alle Comete 2016 Rosato (Bolgheri)

description: This wine is a light red, but packaged like a rosé, and shows rich aromas of ripe black plum and red cherries, mouth-filling body and generous plummy, meaty flavors. It's very enjoyable to start an evening with and is full bodied enough to pair with big proteins.
title: Fifi 2014 Rosé of Sangiovese (California)

description: A nice blush wine. Made from 100% Pinot Noir, it's dryish and crisp, with pretty flavors of cherries, raspberries and vanilla. Nice with chicken pot pie or chicken enchiladas.
title: Bonneau 2009 Rosé (Carneros)

description: A great value and a good choice for barbecue or summer seafood dishes. Moderate notes of small red berries, wild strawberry and raspberry dominate the creamy mouth along with a hint of soft garrigue herbs on the finish.
title: Les Vignerons de la Méditerranée 2008 Réserve St. Martin Syrah Rosé (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: This is a light-colored wine with warm raspberry flavors and attractive acidity. Well balanced, it has a tangy orange-zest texture along with an herbal aftertaste. Drink this attractive wine now.
title: Mas de Cadenet 2016 Nuit Blanche en Provence Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Packaged in a sexy, Champagne-style bottle, this 100% Grenache is firm and substantial. It underscores fruit flavors of peach, apricot and melon with appealing minerality.
title: Gård 2013 Lawrence Vineyards Grand Klasse Rosé (Columbia Valley (WA))

description: Red in color, with grassy aromas of clover and cherry. The palate runs soft and a little cloying, with sweet, flat, grassy flavors of plum and cherry. Candied and a bit dull on the finish.
title: Juvé y Camps NV Pinot Noir Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Cava)

description: This Rosato is part of the natural wine movement, and it's apparent. Aromas of apple juice and citrus open the bouquet, with some evidence of volatility or instability. Fresh acidity is present, with notes of lemon and red raspberry.
title: Bonavita 2011 Rosato (Sicilia)

description: Lively strawberry-fruit flavors are at the heart of this gluggable wine. Bottled under screwcap to preserve freshness, it bears no indication of either vintage or grape. Enjoy it for what it is—a fruity forward near-dry summertime sipping wine.
title: Eola Hills NV Rosé (Oregon)

description: This is a rich style of rosé with caramel as well as red-fruit flavors. It has enough acidity to carry its ripe character, giving the wine a fresh, crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château Routas 2015 Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: A soft wine, with just a touch of sweetness. The ripe fruit lends a gentle, smooth texture, and it's balanced with attractive red-currant acidity.
title: Château de l'Escarelle 2011 iPink Rosé (Coteaux Varois)

description: Red in color, with sweet aromas of sugar beet, Red Delicious apple and cherry. It feels zesty, with simple flavors of red fruit and red apple. The finish is dry and a touch peppery. Drink immediately while it's fresh.
title: Pradorey 2011 Rosado Joven Tempranillo Rosé (Ribera del Duero)

description: Simple and fruity, this has tangy a tangy raspberry flavor. It's light and zesty, with a fine, fresh aftertaste.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2011 Provence One Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This is tightly crisp, with plenty of acidity to give it a mouthwatering character. It is balanced, with orange and caramel flavors. Great with food. Screwcap.
title: Winzer Krems 2011 Rosé (Niederösterreich)

description: Floral strawberry notes subtly perfume the nose on this taut and creamily fizzy sparkling brut. The slender, light-footed palate is enriched with some of that broader Pinot-structure and slips down rather easily. This makes for a classy, grown-up apéritif—its dryness lets the fruit and structure speak, offering an echo of beautiful floral overtones.
title: Malat 2011 Brut Reserve Rosé Sparkling (Österreichischer Sekt)

description: Reddish-pink and orange in color, this wine made from Cabernet Franc grapes works on every level, offering a taste of pomegranate and fresh-squeeed orange that keeps it dry and refreshing as it goes down. Given no time in new oak, it exhibits watermelon and cherry on the finish.
title: Ehlers Estate 2014 Sylviane Rosé (St. Helena)

description: This beautifully crisp and fresh wine has great red-berry acidity. Tight and textured, it is dry while balancing fruit and the more steely edge. The bottling is young, so could be aged for six months from purchase, although it is also refreshing to drink immediately.
title: A.R. Lenoble  NV Terroirs Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Not as darkly concentrated or marked by rancio as the Rare bottling (but considerably less expensive), this is still an excellent sweet wine. Earthy notes of caramel and mocha dominate, rounded out by candied dates and wrapped up by a long, coffee-tinged finish.
title: Chambers Rosewood Vineyards NV Grand Muscat (Rutherglen)

description: Lilac and violet hang with blackberries, black plums and sweet mocha on this purple chiffon-cake scented wine  from winemaker Ryan Pease. The blend of 55% Grenache, 30% Mourvèdre, 12% Syrah and and 3% Counoise is full and silky on the palate, with olallieberry fruits, proving juicy but not jammy or overpowering.
designation: Songs of Its Own Glenrose Vineyard
title: Paix Sur Terre 2013 Songs of Its Own Glenrose Vineyard Red (Adelaida District)

description: This opens with a soft, creamy texture and ripe aromas of spring flower, stone fruit and lemon blossom. There's a touch of sweetness on the close that would pair with light cocktail snacks.
title: Val d'Oca 2011 Millesimato Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: A small percentage of outside grapes is added to the blend for a creamier and richer expression of Prosecco Superiore. Creamy and rich, this delivers a distant softness. The mouthfeel is enhanced by flavors of peach, citrus and honey.
title: Drusian NV Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Simple and clean, with bright a bright fruit flavor and a pretty flower note, this should pair with Thai spring rolls or smoked salmon appetizers. The perlage is fine, soft and creamy.
title: Drusian NV Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Despite being an Extra Dry Prosecco Superiore, this shows more dryness than it does sweetness. The finish is tonic and firm, with notes of white flower, peach and honey.
title: Foss Marai NV Strada di Guia, 109 Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This is lightly fragrant, with pear and apple notes. There's a touch of tart sweetness on the finish as well a foamy texture and bright acidity. It should pair with Brie- or Gouda-based appetizers.
title: Gemin NV Brut  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Made with organically farmed fruit, this is redolent of honeydew, jasmine, white peach and rose. It has a soft, foamy quality to its effervescence.
title: La Jara 2011 Millesimato Dry  (Prosecco Treviso)

description: Widely available, this easy Prosecco offers fresh aromas of citrus, stone fruit and honey. It's elegantly packaged with a light blue label that would look gorgeous at a lunchtime table set by the pool.
title: La Marca NV  Prosecco

description: Full-bodied and a little forwardly sweet, this deeply colored blush bubbly has flavors of raspberries and cherries, accented with smoky yeast, vanilla cookie and peppery spice. Drink now through 2010.
title: Laetitia 2005 Brut Rosé Sparkling (Arroyo Grande Valley)

description: This is a stunner because it shows such minerally depth, which many strive for but few achieve on a pink wine. The classic shade of pink gives way to bubblegum, lime juice, orange rind and smashed raspberry aromas. The zesty, vibrant lime juice acidity cuts right through plum fruit, but it's the graphite and chalky tension that wins the palate.
title: Presqu'ile 2015 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Santa Maria Valley)

description: Fresh strawberry, raspberry, sweet pea, orange blossom and honeysuckle abound in the bouquet of this pretty, pale rosé. It has a bright and clean but not overly simple character, with hints of garrigue and peach pit that add interest to the palate. Enjoy this refreshing sip now.
title: Domaine Montrose 2014 Les Lezards Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Bright pink in color with orange highlights, this light-bodied wine tastes fresh, lightly fruity like raspberries and cranberries. It has a crispy tangy acidity for an appetizing texture.
title: Spicy Vines 2016 Rosé of Syrah (Sierra Foothills)

description: Muddled strawberry and watermelon aromas and flavors are partnered with an earthy streak reminiscent of wet leaves. The palate is similarly fruit forward, with ample acidity that lifts the fruity richness and results in a short but clean finish.
title: Domaine Sainte-Eugénie 2015 Rosé (Corbières)

description: Made from 40% Grenache Noir, 40% Syrah and 20% Cinsault, this coppery rosé is freshly fruited and quite floral, with aromas of ripe stone fruit, strawberry and orange blossom. The palate is approachable and balanced, with ample acidity and a short but clean finish.
title: Château Viranel 2015 Tradition Rosé (Saint-Chinian)

description: Orange-pink in color, this is ripe, full rosé. It has plenty of acidity as well as a crisp texture. The weight of the wine puts its firmly in the food category of rosé.
title: Domaine d'Arton 2015 Ysé Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: The pure scent of freshly picked strawberries is as enticing on the nose as it is on the palate. The gentle flavors are supported by bright lemony freshness and a frothy fizzy mousse that accentuates the purity of these primary flavors perfectly. All of this spells lightness and ease. The finish is dry and full of strawberry notes.
title: Wolfberger NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: A salmon-pink rosé, this wine is crisp with red cherry and raspberry flavors. Light and stylish, it offers a tangy texture that gives a bright aftertaste of acidity and crisp apples.
title: Thiénot NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: The scent of very fragrant ripe apples abounds on the nose: think both Red and Golden Delicious. This fruity note carries through the entire palate: from its fresh, sprightly opening through its dry, slender body to its frothy, lively finish.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Beautifully pale in color, this is the latest release of Cristal Rosé. It is ripe and full in the mouth, packed with fruit and also with intense acidity that cuts through the soft texture. There is a hint of bottle age, giving the wine a toasty complexity that brings a balance to this great wine. Drink now, although this vintage will certainly last to 2020 and beyond.
title: Louis Roederer 2007 Cristal Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This is a very fine wine with considerable bottle age. From its orange-pink color to its mature toast and almond flavors, this complex wine is much more than the fruit that has merged with the secondary flavors. Light tannins and a crisp texture are balanced by the softness that comes from the relatively high dosage. The wine, beautifully mature, is ready to drink.
title: Moët & Chandon 2004 Dom Pérignon Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Beautifully crisp and fresh, this is a young, tightly textured wine that is already so refreshing. Its red fruit character is just a part of the mineral and tannin texture and the pure line of fragrant acidity. Very pale in color, this sophisticated wine could do with some aging. Drink from 2018.
title: Louis Roederer 2010 Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This is a stylish wine. It has fine acidity and light poised fruity character. With plenty of orange zest and a herbal touch, this blend of Cinsault, Grenache and Syrah is a generous wine, ready to drink now.
title: Hecht & Bannier 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Dry and succulent, this brings tangy flavors of rhubarb and raspberry into focus. It's made for picnic foods—could anything be better with fried chicken? This is widely available and scores a bullseye if your target is a summer sipper.
title: Acrobat 2016 Rosé of Rosé (Oregon)

description: This small appellation is an enclave in the middle of Côtes de Provence. Its style is very similar and this wine, named after the owner, is a structured blend of Syrah and Grenache. The wine from organic grapes has a pepper and spice edge over the crisp acidity of the red fruits. Drink now.
title: Château la Calisse 2016 Patricia Ortelli Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: Pale salmon in color, this medium-bodied, vibrant and appetizing wine has canteloupe aromas, lemon and pink grapefruit flavors, and a tasty, tangy balance that lasts from the first sip through the finish.
title: Clif Family 2016 Rosé of Grenache (Mendocino)

description: Made in a deliberately trim and delicate style from Rhône grape varieties, this wine has a pleasant light pink-peach color and canteloupe aromas that lead to a crisp palate of light body and fresh, tart lemon and cranberry flavors.
title: Klinker Brick 2016 Bricks and Roses Rosé (Lodi)

description: This is a blend of Grenache and Cinsault from the organic vineyard of Château Gabriel. It is a lively, crisp wine with fine acidity and refreshing red-currant fruits. It is bone dry, packed with bright acidity as well as fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2016 Château Gabriel Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This is a deliciously fruity wine. It has fine red-currant and citrus fruits that give it a fresh crisp texture and flavor. The attractive wine is so bright with fruit right up front. Drink now.
title: Les Quatre Tours 2016 Classique Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This is a blend of Syrah and Cinsault. That gives the wine structure as well as bright fruits. It is an elegant fruity wine with a creamy ripe texture along with red-currant and raspberry fruits. Drink the wine now.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2016 Cuvée G Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Menthol and sweet grass are upfront on the nose of this herbal rosé, supported by notes of strawberry hull and black currant. There's a slight prickle to the palate, with a pithy astringency on the finish.
title: Pierrick Harang 2016 Le Petit Balthazar Cinsault Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: This pale rosé has subdued strawberry aromas and a hint of residual sugar. It comes off as quite generic, without a lot of flavor to bring it to life.
designation: Limited Edition Canyon Vineyard Ranch Cinsault
title: Canoe Ridge 2016 Limited Edition Canyon Vineyard Ranch Cinsault Rosé (Yakima Valley)

description: This is spicy with a strong floral character. Its red-berry fruits are shot through with acidity. The crispness and attractiveness of the wine are spoiled just by the hint of candy and caramel. Drink now.
title: Fabre en Provence 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This blend of Grenache, Syrah and Cinsault is light and fruity, with a touch of red-fruit candy. It has a soft aftertaste that suggests the wine is not bone dry. Drink now.
title: Marrenon 2016 Triniti Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: Pink in color, this is a full wine that misses out on freshness. It is clean with ripe strawberry fruits, but it feels fat and heavy. Screwcap.
title: Château de Beauregard-Ducourt 2012 Red (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Caramel and soft fruits in a wine that seems to be missing the zesty, crisp element. The wine feels flat.
title: Château Montaud 2012 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The wine seems flat. It has the red fruits and acidity, but they seem flabby and dull.
title: Bailli de Provence 2012 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This bright pink rosato opens with touches of apple skin and citrus, especially pink grapefruit. This exceedingly informal box wine could work at picnics or pool parties.
title: Cantina di Soave 2011 Volére Rosato (Delle Venezie)

description: Even with some bottle age, this is a ripe and fruity wine. With a good edge of toastiness, it has lost its initial freshness, while gaining a round, rich character. It has great acidity and crispness on the finish.
designation: Blin's Édition Limitée Extra Brut Rosé
title: H. Blin NV Blin's Édition Limitée Extra Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This is a full-bodied and fruity wine. It has ripe red berry fruits as well as layers of warm citrus and fresh acidity. It's the richness that shows most strongly here, from the fruit to the texture, very much a house style of Ruinart. Drink now.
title: Ruinart NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Luscious red cherries and raspberries abound from nose to finish in this buoyantly fruity yet dry, elegantly structured rosé. Made from Cabernet Franc and Lemberger, it's nuanced by faint whiffs of blossom and bramble. Revitalizing acidity makes it temptingly quaffable.
title: Keuka Spring 2015 Dry Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: This is a delicious expression of the genre, medium bodied and forcefully crisp, with delicate lacings of cherry, apricot and peach. The underlying hint of vanilla gives it a welcome succulence and touch of sweetness though the wine otherwise presents dry.
title: Kobler 2015 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Russian River Valley)

description: As the name of this cuvée indicates, the grapes for this bottling come from sandier parcels within the appellation. The result is a fruitier expression of Tavel, one that morphs ceaselessly between red plum, yellow peach and mixed berry flavors. Crisp and firm on the finish, this needs a little time to show its best; drink throughout 2017.
title: Les Vignerons de Tavel 2015 Terroir des Sables  (Tavel)

description: Light bodied and just ripe, this is a delightfully crisp, refreshing expression of the variety. Stainless steel fermentation preserves its core of candied orange and strawberry flavor.
title: Kenwood 2016 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Sonoma Coast)

description: Made from Tempranillo and Syrah grapes from Stagecoach Vineyard, this inaugural release is unctuous yet light. Six months of aging in mostly French oak has added complexity and a touch of weight. Its orange and peach flavors are juicy and substantial.
title: Krupp Brothers 2016 The Damsel Rosé (Napa Valley)

description: Hawthorn, acacia and stone fruit aromas mingle together on this lovely sparkler. Refreshing and refined, the vibrant foaming palate doles out citrus zest and yellow apple offset by crisp acidity and elegant mousse.
designation: Rive di Colbertaldo Vigneto Giardino Asciutto
title: Adami 2016 Rive di Colbertaldo Vigneto Giardino Asciutto  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: With its ripe texture and delicious red-fruit flavor, this wine has a tangy mineral edge and a fine balance. It offers softness (because of that balance) that veers towards dry. It is a fine apéritif style, rich and ready to drink.
title: Billecart-Salmon NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Delicate scents of wisteria, acacia, herb and beeswax lift out of the glass. It's both lively and ethereal, offering yellow apple, Bartlett pear and a citrus note framed in crisp acidity and silky perlage.
title: Borgoluce 2016 Rive di Collalto  (Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Cherry red, aromatic with scents of crushed roses, strawberries and cherries, this brings a gentle touch of sweetness to the lush fruit flavors. It's pretty as can be, bursting with strawberry fruit, and a very good value. Drink chilled with mild cheeses.
title: High Pass 2016 Pinot Noir Rosé (Willamette Valley)

description: A whole new generation of Italian rosé is finally gaining the attention it deserves. This is an exceptionally fresh and clean wine that would pair with smoked salmon, fish carpaccio or insalata di mare.
title: Carpineto 2011 Dogajolo Rosé (Toscana)

description: Lifted notes of wild, aromatic raspberry hover above a far earthier base of chestnut. But this wine is mutable: sniffed at another moment its red cherry and peony petal flavors come to the fore. The palate is light bodied and has a firm acidic backbone, destining it for the table. There are mystical edges of woodsmoke and pepper but what remains and lingers is pure cherry and raspberry fruit.
title: Pittnauer 2011 Rosenberg St. Laurent (Burgenland)

description: This is a refined and restrained Pinot from a reputable grape grower who has successfully made the transition to winemaker. Raspberry, cherry-vanilla and rhubarb interplay seamlessly, teasing with a taste of decadence and silky tannins. The finish offers highlights of orange zest and clove.
title: St. Rose 2012 Nunes Vineyard Ten Block Pinot Noir (Russian River Valley)

description: Made from both grapes directly pressed into wine as well as bled off, this crisply complex offering is springtime in a glass, a soft and supple evoking of fresh-cut pineapple that remains dry and delicious without ever overreaching. Medium in body, with a hint of dried herb on the back palate, it offers structure and just the right amount of weight.
title: Lynmar 2014 Rosé of Pinot Noir (Russian River Valley)

description: Despite the low abv, this is a dry rosé, made from 100% Sangiovese that was picked at 20.5 brix. It's delicate and satisfying—a pretty pale copper/rose color, with flavors of strawberry hinting at peach. There's a dusting of baking spices and cocoa, adding welcome highlights to the finish.
title: Paul O'Brien 2015 Rosato Rosé (Umpqua Valley)

description: Beautiful in peach color, this blends 73% Chardonnay and 27% Pinot Noir. Dry and crisp, it tangles together vibrant flavors of grapefruit, tangerine and cherry, as aromas of rose petal whisper by. A stony mineral component adds complexity and invitation to the texture.
title: Schramsberg 2013 Querencia Brut Rosé Sparkling (Napa Valley)

description: This is a simple rosé that could withstand some concentration. It was crafted from barrel-fermented Pinot Noir, and it shows very light flavors of watermelon and strawberry.
title: Methven Family Vineyards 2011 Rosé (Willamette Valley)

description: This lightly sparkling rosé opens with fragrant aromas of rose petal, candied cherry, honey and wild berry. As the label says, it scores an 8 on a sweetness scale of 1–10, with 10 being the highest.
title: Astoria NV Salvatore Principe Rosé Moscato (Veneto)

description: Orange-pink in color, this is a warm style of rosé. Its richness is contrasted with the tangy, orange-zest-like acidity. A blend of Tinta Roriz and Touriga Nacional, it will be ready to drink this winter.
title: Valle Pradinhos 2011 Rosé (Trás-os-Montes)

description: The Vinhão's red juice gives this rosé its orange-pink color. It also produces the high acidity that marks this as a wine from the cool north. Light and fruity, it's ready to drink now.
title: Casal Paço Padreiro 2011 Aphros Rosé Vinhão (Vinho Verde)

description: This bright pink wine is lightly sweet and full of strawberry flavor. It is crisp, clean and fragrant—delicious as an apéritif. Screwcap.
title: Conde Villar 2011 Rosé Espadeiro (Vinho Verde)

description: Persistent bubbles deliver lively aromas of kumquat, yeast, sharp lemon and wet slate on the tight, never opulent nose of this bottling. The palate's creamy bubbles are very pleasant in texture, delivering sharp, acid-driven flavors of citrus and a touch of brioche.
title: Presqu'ile 2012 Rosé Sparkling (Santa Maria Valley)

description: The cave cooperative in Tavel is hitting on all cylinders, turning out numerous consistent, top-rated examples. Différent doesn't have the spicy nuances of the very best Tavels, but it offers a bold, ripe mouthful of raspberry and cherry fruit, ample weight and richness and a long, slightly dusty-textured finish. Drink now–2018.
title: Les Vignerons de Tavel 2016 Différent  (Tavel)

description: This 100% Pinot Nero offers aromas of wild red berry, bread crust and a whiff of light spice. The crisp, linear palate doles out crunchy cherry, strawberry, vanilla, tangerine zest and a hint of hazelnut. An elegant perlage lends finesse.
title: Colombo 2011 Silvì Rosé Riserva Metodo Classico Pinot Nero (Alta Langa)

description: Soft, almost candied strawberry flavors dominate the nose and just off-dry palate. Fruit is in the foreground and plays beautifully against the light, softly bubbly backdrop of the palate. This is a summery apéritif or the style of wine to accompany berries and berry-based desserts.
title: Schlumberger Wein- und Sektkellerei NV Rosé Secco Sparkling (Österreichischer Sekt)

description: Made entirely from Pinot Noir grapes, this marks the first offering of this rosé from this ranch in the heart of Carneros. Dry and simple in approach, it delivers a crispness of lemon, lime and strawberry, becoming rich on the palate as it lingers.
title: Mumm Napa 2011 Devaux Ranch Rosé Sparkling (Napa Valley)

description: This is 100% varietal, quite pretty in shades of pale pink, and perfectly dry without turning sour. Flavors of watermelon, pink grapefruit, rosewater and Jonathan apples all come into play. Drink it while the wine retains its youthful freshness.
title: Abacela 2014 Grenache Rosé (Umpqua Valley)

description: Raspberry and lettuce aromas are fresh but a touch grassy. This rosé has a fresh, clean feel and dry flavors of citrus fruits and nectarine. Dryness is a repeated theme on the finish, which is long, pure and focused.
title: Alta Alella 2013 Privat Reserva Brut Nature Rosé Sparkling (Cava)

description: Fresh strawberry fruit with a bit of spice makes this an easy choice for warm-weather sipping. Tart, with lemony acidity, it's young and lively. Good as it is on its own, it would make an awesome punch.
title: Stoller 2014 Pinot Noir Rosé (Dundee Hills)

description: This unusual rosé blends Merlot rosé with substantial portions of Chardonnay, Cabernet Franc and Gewürztraminer, highlighting textural and flavor attributes from each. It's luscious in mouthfeel with a dense concentration of tropical fruit flavors, yet brisk and effortlessly quaffable. A delightful new take on a Hamptons classic.
title: Wölffer 2014 Summer in a Bottle Rosé (Long Island)

description: Aromatic and expressive, this wine starts with aromas of wildflower and peach, and it leads into balanced flavors of white fruit, orange peel and fresh berry. A pretty selection, with enough body to span the seasons.
title: Oenogenesis 2011 Enoeno Dry Rosé Cabernet Sauvignon Grenache (Drama)

description: Almost red in color, and maybe already past its prime. Crios was a standout in 2006, but the '07 is chunky and sweet smelling, with ripe but dull apple, melon and nectarine flavors. Soft and already in its late stages; probably best to wait for the 2008.
title: Susana Balbo 2007 Crios Rosé of Malbec (Mendoza)

description: Grapy and floral with loads of rose petal notes, this Moscato is perfumey on the nose and palate. Exuberantly frothy and mouth-filling, the palate is fleshy with sweet ripe grapes, with just a hint of stems and leaves on the finish.
title: Exclusiv NV Rose Spumos Moscato (Moldova)

description: Labors from the start via soft, punchless aromas of generic red fruit. Feels a little flabby, with dry, basic flavors of red apple and cantaloupe. Turns pithy and slightly bitter on the finish. Drink now.
title: Señorio de Uñuela 2010 Rosado Tempranillo (Rioja)

description: Creamy and bright, this Extra Dry Prosecco opens with soft notes of white flower and stone fruit. The wine shows a supple but lasting feel in the mouth with loads of fruity after flavors.
title: Angelo Bortolin 2010 Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Enhanced by an attractive bottle and packaging, Belcanto Extra Dry delivers the goods on the inside of the bottle as well. This fresh Prosecco is redolent of peach, citrus and honey.
title: Bellussi NV Belcanto Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: Bortolotti has a well-earned reputation for steady, classic expressions of Prosecco exemplified by this luminous Extra Dry. Aromas here include spring flower, melon and white peach.
title: Bortolotti NV Extra Dry  (Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore)

description: This starts off as a deceptively simple berry-cocktail sort of rosé, but then adds lime and crushed stone on the finish to provide added interest and refreshment. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Gournier 2010 Rosé (Vin de Pays des Cévennes)

description: This Brut expression of Prosecco is easy and tight in the mouth with fresh floral fragrances of jasmine and white rose as well as fruity tones of stone fruit and lemon. The mouthfeel is tight, sharp and compact.
title: Il Follo NV Cuvée Rustot Brut  (Prosecco)

description: This pink-colored wine is attractively fruity with crisp acidity and fresh red currant fruits. It's light, bright and soft with a lightly creamy texture.
title: Dão Sul NV Encontro Brut Rosé Touriga Nacional (Vinho Espumante de Qualidade)

description: A blend of Cabernet Franc and Pinot Noir, this pale pink rosé has really fresh acidity and crisp apple fruits. There are just hints of red-berry fruits and a touch of tannin that gives the wine an edge of dryness. The aftertaste, with the creamy mousse, is fresh and lively.
title: Monmousseau NV Rosé Brut Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: This medium-bodied rosé is a blend of 60% Grenache and 40% Syrah drawn from the estate's young vines. Like its big brother, the Vieilles Vignes, it's gently textured, easily balancing red berry fruit against citrusy elements. It's a clean, refreshing, but somewhat simple quaffer at a bargain price.
title: Château de Nages 2013 Buti Nages Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: A hint of reduction obfuscates this wine's nose. With a little air, it begins to show some of its red plum and red cherry notes. The palate is smooth, fresh and generous with fruit. Make sure to let it breathe.
title: Rosenhof 2015 Blaufränkisch (Burgenland)

description: Made from 100% Nerello Mascalese, this has delicate McIntosh apple, white pepper and eucalyptus scents. Fresh acidity balances raw red cherry, orange peel and clove flavors on the straightforward palate.
title: Terrazze dell'Etna 2015 Rosato Nerello Mascalese (Etna)

description: This soft and red-fruit-driven wine has attractive acidity and a crisp aftertaste. It is dry, all about bright raspberries and red currants. The aftertaste just carries on with fruit. Drink now.
title: Villa Nissarda 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: More mineral than fruit, this delicately concentrated rosé offers glimpses of tart cherry and citrus flavor augmented by a backbone of fresh acidity. It's invigorating and spry with a lean dry finish.
title: Wagner 2016 Rosé of Cabernet Franc (Finger Lakes)

description: This is a ripe, rich red-fruit-flavored wine. It has great concentration and a dense texture that spotlights bright fruit, plus a touch of tannin from the red wine used to give color. This bottling needs to age further, so drink from 2018.
title: Alfred Gratien 2007 Cuvée Paradis Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Made using Pinot Noir skins to color the wine, rather than the more usual Champagne trick of adding red wine, this is a well judged, ripe wine. With its red fruits and light tannins it still tastes young. Acidity and a balanced dosage make for a wine that will be better from 2017.
title: Pannier NV Egérie Rosé de Saignée Brut  (Champagne)

description: The musky scent of botrytis bathes everything in its gold-tinged flavor: there are hints of maple syrup, bitter honeycomb and candied orange peel. The mouthfeel is viscous and rich, the flavours almost decadent but balanced by deliciously bitter and tart notes of citrus zest.
title: Rosenhof 2015 Trockenbeerenauslese Blaufränkisch (Burgenland)

description: A blend of Sangiovese, Cinsault, Zinfandel and Syrah, this dry Rosé is dark pinkish-red. Otherwise it is light and straightforward, finishing quick.
title: Estate Crush 2012 Rosé (Lodi)

description: This salmon-colored rosé is past its peak. Gritty aromas are turning oily, while the feel is chunky and sticky, with a touch of lasting citric acidity. Flavors of melon and almond skins finish bitter.
title: Luigi Bosca 2012 Finca La Linda Malbec Rosé (Luján de Cuyo)

description: Pale copper in color, this was initially pressed for a sparkling wine program before making a rosé. Its flavors are thin and underripe, with little red fruit, delivering instead skin characteristics and tannins.
title: Coelho 2016 Delfina Vineyard Pinot Noir Rosé (McMinnville)

description: This wine comes from a large 300-acre estate on the island's east coast. It has subtle raspberry fruit and plenty of acidity. With its crisp aftertaste, filled out with a touch of caramel, it's ready to drink.
title: Domaine Vetriccie 2016 Rosé (Ile de Beauté)

description: This 100% Pinot Gris wine has a light-pink color. With its soft ripe red-berry fruitiness it is crisp and clean. There is a touch of spice from these pale-pink-skinned grapes which are more often used to make white wine.
title: Joseph Mellot 2016 Les Milets Rosé (Reuilly)

description: There's nothing subtle about this blush wine made from Zinfandel. It was barrel fermented and barrel aged for 15 months, giving it a full-bodied mouthfeel and even some dusty tannins, and it has robust flavors of cherries, cola, beef jerky and licorice. But it's dry and crisp and is something different.
title: D'Argenzio 2005 D'Loiodice Zinfandel Rosá Rosé (Russian River Valley)

description: The nose of juicy plum promises ripe fruit. The palate follows with a generous softness. There is ease on this light body and lots of freshness. Enjoy while aromas are at their peak.
title: Domaine Barmès-Buecher 2015 Rosenberg Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Pale yellow-pink in color, this sparkler shows watermelon rind and flesh, red pear skins, orange zest and plush nectarine on the very accessible nose, which will please veterans and neophytes alike. The palate combines a baking soda character with stone fruit and ripe Asian pear slices.
title: Riverbench 2015 Cork Jumper Brut Rosé Sparkling (Santa Maria Valley)

description: Dark pinkish-red, this wine comes from two blocks of the producer's Carneros estate, which are harvested at lower sugar ripeness to offer a dry refreshing experience, which this wine does. This exudes weighty and broad flavors of tangy watermelon, orange and cranberry, with a satisfying grip of power on the finish.
designation: Estate Grand Val Vineyard Pinot Noir
title: Clos du Val 2016 Estate Grand Val Vineyard Pinot Noir Rosé (Carneros)

description: This simple, soft and fruity wine has attractive acidity as well as red currant fruit flavors. With its final tang of acidity, it's well placed as an apéritif.
title: Château du Rouët 2014 Cuvée Réserve Tradition Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A quick extraction yielded a pale peach color for this Vin Gris made from Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot. Delicate aromas of candied banana and peach lead to a palate driven by pink grapefruit.
title: Chateau Morrisette 2014 Vin Gris Rosé (Virginia)

description: Lemon and orange peel are right at the front of this wine. It's fruity, tangy and completely ready to drink.
title: Domaine d'Astros 2014 Cuvée Prestige Rosé (Vin de Pays des Maures)

description: The flavors of this wine follow the same light character as its pale, almost-white color. It does have some fresh juiciness, light acidity and a cut of lemon at the end. Crisp and clean, it's ready to drink.
title: Château Réal d'Or 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Intense red berry and cherry notes shine through this Cabernet Franc rosé. Brisk acidity refreshes, but eight months of barrel aging and lees stirring lend an unusually lactic feel to the palate.
title: Domaine LeSeurre 2013 Cabernet Franc Barrel Select Rosé (Finger Lakes)

description: Poised, stylish and very fruity, this wine is fresh with acidity, showing lemon and red currant, with a touch of pepper on the finish. It's just right as an apéritif.
title: Domaines Bunan 2014 Bunan Selection Rosé (Var)

description: This lightly fruity wine brings in layers of the freshest acidity before broadening out with citrus and green fruits. The wine is all about crisp, light fruitiness. A blend of Grenache, Syrah and Cinsault, it benefits from warm days and cool nights from vineyards at nearly 1,200 feet.
title: Pure Provence 2014 L'Opaline Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: Soft and light just off dry, this is an attractive and fruity wine. Strawberry flavors give a crispness to the background of the wine, finishing with a light, dancing aftertaste.
title: Le Charmel 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Soft and so easy to drink, this is a fresh and fruity wine with gentle red fruits and light acidity. Attractive, it's crisply ready to enjoy.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2014 Cep d'Or Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: Full bodied and rich, this has flavors of spice, red plum and caramel. It's quite heavy and dense, so drink it with food.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2011 Pigmentum Rosé Malbec (Lot)

description: A caramel aroma sets the scene for a ripe, smooth wine. It has ripe red fruits that have a nutty, toasty character that balances with the crisp acidity and tight texture. Drink now.
title: Domaine Roger Champault 2014 Les Pierris Rosé (Sancerre)

description: The Grenache and Cinsault in this rosé are from the Jura and other vineyards. The result is a soft, smooth and creamy wine. Fresh red-berry fruits give it a round, almost off-dry character. It's fresh at the end, and definitely in an apéritif style.
title: François Montand NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: This Merlot-based rosé smells cheesy and not all that fruity. Chunky and obtuse on the palate, this tastes of generic citrus and berry fruits. An adequate finish is par for the course.
title: Otazu 2014 Rosado Merlot (Navarra)

description: Here's a well-priced wine that offers drying tones of crushed stone and flint, with background notes of green apple and citrus. The wine is tonic and crisp overall.
title: Bellussi NV Enrico Brut  (Prosecco)

description: A wine that shows firm tannins, fruit and wood acidity. It is now ready to drink, a wine that will remain firm and dry.
title: Château Bellerose Figeac 2007 Prestige  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Notes of dark cherry and berry, toast and Indian spice are a bit blurred, remaining relatively static as the wine is allowed to breathe. Light to medium bodied, it shows some elegance, and the pliant tannins add a soft, dusty grip.
title: Rosemont 2010 Cabernet Franc (Virginia)

description: A pretty pale salmon color, this 100% varietal wine is direct and appealing with notes of watermelon rind and strawberry. It drinks with a sweet-tart finish that shows a bit of heat.
title: Abacela 2012 Estate Grown Grenache Rosé (Umpqua Valley)

description: This full, ripe wine is rich with strawberry and red plum fruit. It's weighty on the palate with flavors of orange zest and a touch of spice. Brisk acidity cuts through the palate adding freshness on the finish.
title: Bernard Magrez 2012 Les Muraires Douce Vie Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: fruits touched with caramel and soft tannin. It's well balanced, with fruit and acidity integrating richly on the finish. It's a fine summer wine but also good for Thanksgiving turkey.
title: Château Castel des Maures 2012 Cuvée Jeanne Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A smooth and soft wine this is fruity, fresh and forward in style. Red-cherry flavor and gentle acidity dominate on the palate. It's rounded and ready to drink now. Finshes with a hint of sweetness.
title: Vollereaux NV Rosé de Saignée Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: This clean, simple and tasty sparkling wine is a Chardonnay/Pinot Noir cuvée, done in the traditional methode Champenoise. Pale straw in color, it brings flavors of green apple and pink grapefruit, with a clean finish.
title: Wetzel Estate 2011 Rosé Sparkling (Willamette Valley)

description: This cheerful Prosecco opens with foamy bubbles and soft perlage and then segues to low-key aromas of honey and citrus. The mouthfeel is lean and watery but the wine does offer attractive crispness on the close.
title: Tenuta Cà Bolani NV Brut Prosecco (Friuli)

description: Peach, citrus, lemon-lime meringue, nectarine and drying white minerals appear first on the nose and are followed by bright fruit flavors. This luminous sparkler (packaged in a neon blue bottle) tickles the tongue thanks to its combination of fruit versus acidity.
title: Antonini Ceresa NV Extra Dry  (Prosecco)

description: This luminous bubbly hits such a light shade of pink, it only hints at being a rosé sparkler. It is incredibly delicate down to the smallest detail and would pair with salmon canapé appetizers.
title: Canella NV Rosé Brut Pinot Nero (Veneto)

description: This is a cheerful and easygoing rosé sparkling wine that offers measured aromas of wild berry and chalky white mineral. The wine is creamy and smooth in the mouth and ends with a playful sweet-against sour-note. Made with Corvina and other grapes found near Verona.
title: Monte del Frá NV Extra Dry Rosé Sparkling (Veneto)

description: Large bubbles and sharp flavors of peach, wild berry and white almond characterize the nose of this well-focused rosé sparkler made from Prosecco and Raboso grapes. The wine is tart and focused on the palate with lingering citrus notes.
title: Pizzolato NV Violette Brut Rosé Sparkling (Veneto)

description: A direct-pressed rosé, cotton-candy pink in color, this wine is dry, light and under 13% alcohol. It offers touches of grass and herby minerality, faint swirls of white peach playful on the tongue. Served chilled, this makes for a delightful apéritif to go with oysters on the half shell.
title: Virage 2013 Rosé of Cabernet Franc (Napa Valley)

description: This off-dry rosé is a blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. A light copper hue, it offers simple strawberry flavors, with some supporting acidity.
title: Henry Estate NV Veraison Rosé (Umpqua Valley)

description: This is a bold-flavored, medium-bodied rose. It starts with a bright pink color, then shows effusive floral and fruity aromas and jammy but dry flavors.
title: Las Positas 2015 Estate Rosé (Livermore Valley)

description: This is a fruity, crisp wine. Red currant and candied red-berry fruits fit into a balanced, just off-dry character. The wine is bright with a light sparkle at the end.
title: Obrigado 2015 Nortico Rosé (Vinho Verde)

description: There's a hint of rusticity to the baked red berry aromas in this wine. Vanilla rooibos and brown sugar hover over a red-currant core. The palate is a bit flabby and jammy, with acidity struggling to snap everything into shape.
title: Rosemont 2013 Cabernet Franc (Virginia)

description: Fresh Anjou pear mixes with candied banana on the nose of this straight-forward Pinot Grigio. Light and zippy, the palate is green-apple focused, finishing on a creamy lemon note.
title: Rosemont 2014 Pinot Grigio (Virginia)

description: A ripe, fruity wine that is bone-dry but so full of red fruits that it seems soft. It's a delicious, lightly textured wine with a good touch of minerality at the end. Drink now.
title: Vignobles Berthier 2013 Domaine des Clairneaux Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Nearly garnet in color, this offers a very strong strawberry sauce aromas, with appealing hints of shortcake. Fruit flavors suggest pressed raspberry, but there is a shiso leaf bitterness as well.
title: Coquelicot 2013 Rosé (Santa Ynez Valley)

description: Tight, dry, minerally aromas of citrus and wet stones set up a snappy, alert palate with bright flavors of citrus fruits and nectarine. A long, racy, citric finish is crisp and refreshing. Drink now.
region_1: Vino de la Tierra de Castilla
title: Dominio de Punctum 2014 Lobetia Rosado (Vino de la Tierra de Castilla)

description: This is a pale colored, attractively perfumed wine. With red berry fruit flavors, bright acidity and a lively orange zest texture, it is fruity and ready to drink.
title: Casa Santos Lima 2015 Lab Rosé (Lisboa)

description: Fresh, fruity aromas center around red apple and cherry. This pink-colored rosé is fairly full in body, with ample acidity. Slightly salty but fruity plum flavors end steady and level.
title: Bodegas Faustino 2016 VII Tempranillo Rosé (Rioja)

description: The faintest hint of red berry marks this wine's nose. Its palate, on the other hand, brims with zesty citrus. It's very light but also refreshing and dry, with enlivening spritz and citrus flavors.
title: Höpler 2016 Pannonica Rosé (Weinland Österreich)

description: This is a delicious and fruity wine with attractive acidity and bright, ebullient character—it's just waiting for summer. The up-front red fruits and acidity are well in balance. This is ready to drink.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2016 Les Papilles Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: While not as blossomy in perfume as previous vintages, there's plenty of fresh watermelon and sour-cherry refreshment here. Exceptionally light bodied and dry, it's an invigoratingly crisp summer sip. The finish is brisk but crystalline and mineral.
title: Lieb 2016 Bridge Lane Rosé (North Fork of Long Island)

description: This soft wine has attractive red-berry flavors. They are given a lift by the bright acidity. It is a gentle wine, ideal for an apéritif with just the lightest tang at the end.
title: Mas de Cadenet 2016 Arbaude Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A deliciously ripe and soft wine, this is also fruity and with a fine tang of clementine. There is a refreshing side to the red-currant fruitiness and intense acidity. It is lightly perfumed and finished with a touch of pepper. Drink now.
title: Mirabeau 2016 Pure Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
